<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/Database.php';

class CashShiftModel {
    private $conn;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->conn = Database::getConnection();
    }

    public function getConnection() {
        return $this->conn;
    }

    public function getCurrentOpenShift($cashier_id = null) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->query("
            SELECT cs.*, u.full_name AS cashier_name 
            FROM cash_shifts cs 
            LEFT JOIN users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id 
            WHERE cs.status = 'Open' 
            ORDER BY cs.id DESC LIMIT 1
        ");
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function openShift($cashier_id, $opening_cash, $note = '') {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("
            INSERT INTO cash_shifts (cashier_id, opened_at, opening_cash, expected_closing_cash, note, status)
            VALUES (?, NOW(), ?, ?, ?, 'Open')
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$cashier_id, $opening_cash, $opening_cash, $note]);
    }

    public function closeShift($shift_id, $actual_closing_cash, $note = '') {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM cash_shifts WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$shift_id]);
        $shift = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$shift) return false;

        $expected = (float)$shift['opening_cash'] + (float)$shift['total_cash_sales'] + (float)$shift['total_cash_in'] - (float)$shift['total_cash_out'];
        $discrepancy = (float)$actual_closing_cash - $expected;
        $finalNote = trim(($shift['note'] ?? '') . ($note ? ' | Chốt ca: ' . $note : ''));

        $upd = $this->conn->prepare("
            UPDATE cash_shifts 
            SET closed_at = NOW(),
                expected_closing_cash = ?,
                actual_closing_cash = ?,
                discrepancy = ?,
                note = ?,
                status = 'Closed'
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $upd->execute([$expected, $actual_closing_cash, $discrepancy, $finalNote, $shift_id]);
    }

    public function recordSaleTransaction($cashier_id, $amount, $type = 'sales') {
        $shift = $this->getCurrentOpenShift($cashier_id);
        if (!$shift) return false;

        $upd = $this->conn->prepare("
            UPDATE cash_shifts 
            SET total_cash_sales = total_cash_sales + ?,
                expected_closing_cash = opening_cash + (total_cash_sales + ?) + total_cash_in - total_cash_out
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $upd->execute([$amount, $amount, $shift['id']]);
    }

    public function createTransaction($cashier_id, $type, $amount, $note = '') {
        $shift = $this->getCurrentOpenShift($cashier_id);
        if (!$shift) return false;

        $this->conn->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $creator = $_SESSION['user']['full_name'] ?? 'Thu ngân';
            $ins = $this->conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO cash_transactions (shift_id, type, amount, note, creator, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
            ");
            $ins->execute([$shift['id'], $type, $amount, $note, $creator]);

            if ($type === 'IN') {
                $upd = $this->conn->prepare("
                    UPDATE cash_shifts 
                    SET total_cash_in = total_cash_in + ?,
                        expected_closing_cash = opening_cash + total_cash_sales + (total_cash_in + ?) - total_cash_out
                    WHERE id = ?
                ");
                $upd->execute([$amount, $amount, $shift['id']]);
            } else {
                $upd = $this->conn->prepare("
                    UPDATE cash_shifts 
                    SET total_cash_out = total_cash_out + ?,
                        expected_closing_cash = opening_cash + total_cash_sales + total_cash_in - (total_cash_out + ?)
                    WHERE id = ?
                ");
                $upd->execute([$amount, $amount, $shift['id']]);
            }

            $this->conn->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $this->conn->rollBack();
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function getTransactionsByShift($shift_id) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM cash_transactions WHERE shift_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC");
        $stmt->execute([$shift_id]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getShiftHistory($limit = 20) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("
            SELECT cs.*, u.full_name AS cashier_name 
            FROM cash_shifts cs 
            LEFT JOIN users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id 
            ORDER BY cs.id DESC LIMIT :limit
        ");
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', (int)$limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }
}

<?php

require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/Database.php';

class CustomerModel
{
    private PDO $db;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
    }

    // Quy Ä‘á»•i háº¡ng thÃ nh viÃªn theo tá»•ng chi tiÃªu
    private function calculateTier(float $totalSpent): string
    {
        if ($totalSpent >= 50000000) {
            return 'Diamond';
        }

        if ($totalSpent >= 20000000) {
            return 'Gold';
        }

        if ($totalSpent >= 5000000) {
            return 'Silver';
        }

        return 'Standard';
    }

    // Láº¥y danh sÃ¡ch khÃ¡ch hÃ ng
    public function getAllCustomers(string $keyword = ''): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                id,
                full_name,
                phone,
                email,
                tier,
                points,
                total_spent,
                created_at
            FROM customers
        ";

        $params = [];

        if ($keyword !== '') {
            $sql .= "
                WHERE full_name LIKE ?
                   OR phone LIKE ?
                   OR email LIKE ?
            ";

            $search = '%' . $keyword . '%';
            $params = [$search, $search, $search];
        }

        $sql .= "
            ORDER BY total_spent DESC, id DESC
        ";

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    // Thá»‘ng kÃª há»™i viÃªn
    public function getCustomerStatistics(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
                SUM(CASE WHEN tier = 'Standard' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standard_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN tier = 'Silver' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS silver_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN tier = 'Gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN tier = 'Diamond' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diamond_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) AS total_points,
                COALESCE(SUM(total_spent), 0) AS total_revenue
            FROM customers
        ";

        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    // Láº¥y thÃ´ng tin má»™t khÃ¡ch hÃ ng
    public function findCustomer(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id = ?"
        );

        $stmt->execute([$id]);

        $customer = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return $customer ?: null;
    }

    // ThÃªm hoáº·c cáº­p nháº­t khÃ¡ch hÃ ng
    public function saveCustomer(array $data, ?int $id = null): bool
    {
        $name = trim($data['full_name'] ?? '');
        $phone = trim($data['phone'] ?? '');
        $email = trim($data['email'] ?? '');

        if ($name === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p há» tÃªn.');
        }

        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9]{9,11}$/', $phone)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }

        if ($email !== '' && !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }

        // Kiá»ƒm tra sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»­ dá»¥ng
        $check = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT id FROM customers WHERE phone = ? AND id != ?"
        );

        $check->execute([$phone, $id ?? 0]);

        if ($check->fetch()) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                'Sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.'
            );
        }

        if ($id !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
                "UPDATE customers
                 SET full_name = ?, phone = ?, email = ?
                 WHERE id = ?"
            );

            return $stmt->execute([
                $name,
                $phone,
                $email !== '' ? $email : null,
                $id
            ]);
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO customers (full_name, phone, email)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?)"
        );

        return $stmt->execute([
            $name,
            $phone,
            $email !== '' ? $email : null
        ]);
    }

    // Cáº­p nháº­t háº¡ng há»™i viÃªn
    public function updateCustomerTier(int $customerId): bool
    {
        $customer = $this->findCustomer($customerId);

        if (!$customer) {
            return false;
        }

        $tier = $this->calculateTier(
            (float)$customer['total_spent']
        );

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "UPDATE customers SET tier = ? WHERE id = ?"
        );

        return $stmt->execute([$tier, $customerId]);
    }

    // Ghi nháº­n chi tiÃªu vÃ  cá»™ng Ä‘iá»ƒm sau thanh toÃ¡n
    public function recordPurchase(
    int $customerId,
    float $amount
): bool {
    if ($amount <= 0) {
        return false;
    }

    // Náº¿u Ä‘ang náº±m trong transaction thanh toÃ¡n thÃ¬ dÃ¹ng chung transaction.
    $ownTransaction = !$this->db->inTransaction();

    if ($ownTransaction) {
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
    }

    try {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT total_spent
             FROM customers
             WHERE id = ?
             FOR UPDATE"
        );

        $stmt->execute([$customerId]);
        $customer = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$customer) {
            throw new RuntimeException('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y khÃ¡ch hÃ ng.');
        }

        // 10.000 Ä‘á»“ng = 1 Ä‘iá»ƒm
        $points = (int) floor($amount / 10000);

        $newTotal = (float)$customer['total_spent'] + $amount;
        $newTier = $this->calculateTier($newTotal);

        $update = $this->db->prepare(
            "UPDATE customers
             SET total_spent = total_spent + ?,
                 points = points + ?,
                 tier = ?
             WHERE id = ?"
        );

        $update->execute([
            $amount,
            $points,
            $newTier,
            $customerId
        ]);

        if ($ownTransaction) {
            $this->db->commit();
        }

        return true;

    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        if ($ownTransaction && $this->db->inTransaction()) {
            $this->db->rollBack();
        }

        throw $e;
    }
}
    
}

    const COURSE_PRIORITY = ['Appetizer' => 1, 'Soup_Salad' => 2, 'Main_Course' => 3, 'Dessert' => 4, 'Beverage' => 1, 'Set_Menu' => 3];

    public function __construct() {
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
    }

    private function err($msg) { return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => $msg]; }

    private function fail($e) {
        if ($this->db->inTransaction()) $this->db->rollBack();
        if ($e instanceof PDOException) {
            error_log('[POS] ' . $e->getMessage());
            return $this->err('Lá»—i cÆ¡ sá»Ÿ dá»¯ liá»‡u, vui lÃ²ng thá»­ láº¡i hoáº·c bÃ¡o quáº£n trá»‹.');
        }
        return $this->err($e->getMessage());
    }

    private function one($sql, $params = []) {
        $st = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $st->execute($params);
        return $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    private function all($sql, $params = []) {
        $st = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $st->execute($params);
        return $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    private function recalcSubtotal($order_id) {
        $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET subtotal = (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 0)
                FROM order_details WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status <> 'Cancelled') WHERE id = ?")
            ->execute([$order_id, $order_id]);
    }

    private function addLog($order_id, $user_id, $type, $desc) {
        $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO order_logs (order_id, user_id, action_type, description) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)")
            ->execute([$order_id, $user_id, $type, $desc]);
    }

    private function dateRange($col, $from, $to) {
        if ($from && $to) return [" AND $col >= ? AND $col < DATE_ADD(?, INTERVAL 1 DAY)", [$from, $to]];
        return ['', []];
    }


    public function createOrAddOrder($table_id, $waiter_id, $items) {
        $table_id = (int)$table_id;
        if (!$table_id || !is_array($items) || !$items) return $this->err('ChÆ°a chá»n bÃ n hoáº·c chÆ°a cÃ³ mÃ³n nÃ o.');
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
           
            $table = $this->one("SELECT id, table_name, status FROM dining_tables WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE", [$table_id]);
            if (!$table) throw new Exception('BÃ n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i!');

            $order = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code FROM orders WHERE table_id = ? AND status = 'Open' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE", [$table_id]);
            if (!$order) {
                if (!in_array($table['status'], ['Available', 'Reserved'], true)) {
                    throw new Exception("BÃ n {$table['table_name']} Ä‘ang á»Ÿ tráº¡ng thÃ¡i {$table['status']}, chÆ°a thá»ƒ má»Ÿ Ä‘Æ¡n má»›i!");
                }
                $order_code = 'ORD-' . strtoupper(uniqid());
                $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO orders (order_code, table_id, waiter_id, status, opened_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Open', NOW())")
                    ->execute([$order_code, $table_id, $waiter_id]);
                $order = ['id' => $this->db->lastInsertId(), 'order_code' => $order_code];
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Occupied' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$table_id]);
                $this->addLog($order['id'], $waiter_id, 'CreateOrder', "Táº¡o Ä‘Æ¡n má»›i: {$order_code} táº¡i bÃ n {$table['table_name']}");
            }

            $ins = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO order_details (order_id, menu_item_id, quantity, unit_price, modifier_notes, course_priority, kds_status)
                                       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Waiting')");
            foreach ($items as $it) {
                $qty = (int)($it['quantity'] ?? 0);
                if ($qty < 1 || $qty > 99) throw new Exception('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng mÃ³n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ (1â€“99).');
                $mi = $this->one("SELECT mi.id, mi.name, mi.price, mi.status, c.course_type
                                  FROM menu_items mi JOIN categories c ON mi.category_id = c.id WHERE mi.id = ?", [(int)($it['menu_item_id'] ?? 0)]);

            }
            $this->recalcSubtotal($order['id']);
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'order_id' => (int)$order['id'], 'message' => 'Gá»i mÃ³n thÃ nh cÃ´ng!'];

        }

    public function cancelOrderItem($order_detail_id, $user_id, $reason) {

        if (mb_strlen($reason) < 3) return $this->err('Báº¯t buá»™c nháº­p lÃ½ do há»§y mÃ³n (Ã­t nháº¥t 3 kÃ½ tá»±).');

            $this->addLog($it['order_id'], $user_id, 'CancelItem', "Há»§y mÃ³n ID {$it['id']} ({$it['quantity']}Ã— {$it['name']}, BÃ n {$it['table_name']}). LÃ½ do: {$reason}");
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'message' => 'ÄÃ£ há»§y mÃ³n thÃ nh cÃ´ng'];
        } catch (Exception $e) {

    public function getKDSList() {
        return $this->all("SELECT od.id, od.order_id, od.kds_status, od.quantity, od.modifier_notes, od.ordered_at,
                                  mi.name AS item_name, dt.table_name, c.course_type,
                                  IF(c.course_type = 'Beverage', 'Bar', 'Kitchen') AS station,
                                  TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, od.ordered_at, NOW()) AS wait_minutes
                           FROM order_details od
                           JOIN menu_items mi ON od.menu_item_id = mi.id
                           JOIN categories c ON mi.category_id = c.id
                           JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id AND o.status = 'Open'
                           JOIN dining_tables dt ON o.table_id = dt.id
                           WHERE od.kds_status IN ('Waiting', 'Cooking', 'Ready')
                           ORDER BY od.ordered_at ASC, od.course_priority ASC, od.id ASC");
    }

    // Waiting -> Cooking -> Ready -> Served. Chá»‰ chuyá»ƒn Ä‘Ãºng thá»© tá»±.
    public function updateKdsStatus($order_detail_id, $new_status, $takeaway = false) {
        $prev = ['Cooking' => 'Waiting', 'Ready' => 'Cooking', 'Served' => 'Ready'];
        if (!isset($prev[$new_status])) return $this->err('Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡');
        $set = 'od.kds_status = ?';
        if ($takeaway && $new_status === 'Served') {
            $set .= ", od.modifier_notes = LEFT(CONCAT_WS(' Â· ', NULLIF(od.modifier_notes, ''), 'Mang vá»'), 255)";
        }
        $st = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id
                                  SET $set WHERE od.id = ? AND od.kds_status = ? AND o.status = 'Open'");
        $st->execute([$new_status, (int)$order_detail_id, $prev[$new_status]]);
        if ($st->rowCount() === 0) return $this->err('MÃ³n Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘á»•i tráº¡ng thÃ¡i hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ há»§y. HÃ£y táº£i láº¡i mÃ n hÃ¬nh.');
        return ['status' => 'success', 'message' => "ÄÃ£ chuyá»ƒn tráº¡ng thÃ¡i sang: {$new_status}"];
    }


    // TÃ­nh hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n
    private function qrUrl($amount, $order_code) {
        return 'https://img.vietqr.io/image/' . self::BANK_ID . '-' . self::BANK_ACCOUNT . '-compact2.png'
            . '?amount=' . (int)round($amount)
            . '&addInfo=' . rawurlencode('THANH TOAN HD ' . $order_code)
            . '&accountName=' . rawurlencode(self::BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME);
    }

    public function calcBill($order_id, $phone = '', $voucher = '') {
        $o = $this->one("SELECT o.id, o.order_code, o.status, o.customer_id, dt.table_name, a.name AS area_name, a.surcharge_percent
                         FROM orders o JOIN dining_tables dt ON o.table_id = dt.id JOIN areas a ON dt.area_id = a.id
                         WHERE o.id = ?", [(int)$order_id]);
        if (!$o) return null;

        $items = $this->all("SELECT mi.name, od.quantity, od.unit_price, od.modifier_notes
                             FROM order_details od JOIN menu_items mi ON od.menu_item_id = mi.id
                             WHERE od.order_id = ? AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled' ORDER BY od.ordered_at, od.id", [$o['id']]);
        $subtotal = 0;
        foreach ($items as $i) $subtotal += $i['quantity'] * $i['unit_price'];

        $unf = $this->one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_details WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status IN ('Waiting', 'Cooking')", [$o['id']]);
        $rdy = $this->one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_details WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status = 'Ready'", [$o['id']]);

        $surcharge = round($subtotal * (float)$o['surcharge_percent'] / 100);
        $service   = round(($subtotal + $surcharge) * self::SERVICE_RATE);

        // KhÃ¡ch hÃ ng vÃ  háº¡ng tháº»: tra theo sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i trong báº£ng customers 
        $cust = null; $phoneErr = null;
        $digits = preg_replace('/\D/', '', (string)$phone);
        if ($digits !== '') {
            $cust = $this->one("SELECT id, full_name, tier FROM customers WHERE phone = ?", [$digits]);
            if (!$cust) $phoneErr = 'KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y khÃ¡ch hÃ ng vá»›i sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i nÃ y.';
        } elseif ($o['customer_id']) {
            $cust = $this->one("SELECT id, full_name, tier FROM customers WHERE id = ?", [$o['customer_id']]);
        }
        $tier = $cust['tier'] ?? 'Standard';
        $tierDisc = round(($subtotal + $surcharge) * (self::TIER_DISCOUNT[$tier] ?? 0));

        // Voucher
        $voucherDisc = 0; $voucherErr = null;
        $code = strtoupper(trim((string)$voucher));
        if ($code !== '') {
            $p = $this->one("SELECT *, (NOW() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date) AS in_range FROM promotions WHERE code = ?", [$code]);
            if (!$p || !$p['is_active']) $voucherErr = 'MÃ£ voucher khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ ngá»«ng Ã¡p dá»¥ng.';
            elseif (!$p['in_range']) $voucherErr = 'Voucher chÆ°a Ä‘áº¿n hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ quÃ¡ háº¡n sá»­ dá»¥ng.';
            elseif ($subtotal < (float)$p['min_order_value']) $voucherErr = 'ÄÆ¡n tá»‘i thiá»ƒu ' . number_format($p['min_order_value'], 0, ',', '.') . 'â‚« má»›i dÃ¹ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c voucher nÃ y.';
            elseif ((self::TIER_RANK[$tier] ?? 0) < (self::TIER_RANK[$p['min_tier']] ?? 0)) $voucherErr = 'Voucher chá»‰ dÃ nh cho háº¡ng ' . $p['min_tier'] . ' trá»Ÿ lÃªn.';
            else {
                $base = $subtotal + $surcharge - $tierDisc;
                $d = $p['discount_type'] === 'Percent' ? $base * (float)$p['discount_value'] / 100 : (float)$p['discount_value'];
                if ($p['discount_type'] === 'Percent' && $p['max_discount'] !== null) $d = min($d, (float)$p['max_discount']);
                $voucherDisc = round(max(0, min($d, $base)));
            }
        }

        $discount = $tierDisc + $voucherDisc;
        $taxable  = $subtotal + $surcharge + $service - $discount;
        $vat      = round($taxable * self::VAT_RATE);
        $total    = $taxable + $vat;

        return [
            'order_id' => (int)$o['id'], 'order_code' => $o['order_code'], 'status' => $o['status'],
            'table_name' => $o['table_name'], 'area_name' => $o['area_name'], 'surcharge_percent' => (float)$o['surcharge_percent'],
            'items' => $items, 'unfinished' => (int)$unf['n'], 'ready_unserved' => (int)$rdy['n'],
            'subtotal' => $subtotal, 'surcharge' => $surcharge, 'service' => $service,
            'tier' => $tier, 'tier_discount' => $tierDisc, 'voucher_code' => $code, 'voucher_discount' => $voucherDisc,
            'discount' => $discount, 'vat' => $vat, 'total' => $total,
            'customer_id' => $cust['id'] ?? null, 'customer_name' => $cust['full_name'] ?? null,
            'phone_error' => $phoneErr, 'voucher_error' => $voucherErr,
            'vietqr_url' => $this->qrUrl($total, $o['order_code']),
        ];
    }

    // Thanh toÃ¡n   
    public function checkoutOrder($order_id, $cashier_id, $payment_method, $phone = '', $voucher = '', $ref = '') {
        if (!in_array($payment_method, ['Cash', 'VietQR', 'CreditCard'], true)) return $this->err('PhÆ°Æ¡ng thá»©c thanh toÃ¡n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $o = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code, status, table_id FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE", [(int)$order_id]);
            if (!$o) throw new Exception('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng!');
            if ($o['status'] === 'Paid') throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n hÃ ng Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c thanh toÃ¡n trÆ°á»›c Ä‘Ã³.');
            if ($o['status'] !== 'Open') throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ thanh toÃ¡n!');

            $b = $this->calcBill($o['id'], $phone, $voucher);
            if ($b['unfinished'] > 0) throw new Exception("CÃ²n {$b['unfinished']} mÃ³n Báº¿p/Bar chÆ°a lÃ m xong, chÆ°a thá»ƒ thanh toÃ¡n.");
            if ($b['phone_error'])    throw new Exception($b['phone_error']);
            if ($b['voucher_error'])  throw new Exception($b['voucher_error']);
            if ($b['subtotal'] <= 0)  throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n chÆ°a cÃ³ mÃ³n nÃ o Ä‘á»ƒ thanh toÃ¡n. HÃ£y dÃ¹ng chá»©c nÄƒng ÄÃ³ng bÃ n.');

            $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET customer_id = COALESCE(?, customer_id), subtotal = ?, area_surcharge_amount = ?, service_charge_amount = ?,
                    discount_amount = ?, deposit_deducted = 0, vat_amount = ?, total_amount = ?, status = 'Paid', closed_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?")
                ->execute([$b['customer_id'], $b['subtotal'], $b['surcharge'], $b['service'], $b['discount'], $b['vat'], $b['total'], $o['id']]);

            
            $this->db->prepare("UPDATE order_details SET kds_status = 'Served' WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status = 'Ready'")->execute([$o['id']]);

            $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO payments (order_id, cashier_id, payment_method, amount, transaction_ref) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")
                ->execute([$o['id'], $cashier_id, $payment_method, $b['total'], trim((string)$ref) !== '' ? mb_substr(trim((string)$ref), 0, 100) : null]);

            $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Available' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$o['table_id']]);

            if ($payment_method === 'Cash') {
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE cash_shifts SET total_cash_sales = total_cash_sales + ? WHERE cashier_id = ? AND status = 'Open'")
                    ->execute([$b['total'], $cashier_id]);
            }

            $note = 'Thanh toÃ¡n thÃ nh cÃ´ng: ' . number_format($b['total']) . ' VND (' . $payment_method . ')';
            if ($b['tier_discount'] > 0)    $note .= ", háº¡ng {$b['tier']} -" . number_format($b['tier_discount']);
            if ($b['voucher_discount'] > 0) $note .= ", voucher {$b['voucher_code']} -" . number_format($b['voucher_discount']);
            $this->addLog($o['id'], $cashier_id, 'Checkout', $note);

            $this->db->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'order_id' => (int)$o['id'], 'total_amount' => $b['total'], 'vietqr_url' => $b['vietqr_url']];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return $this->fail($e);
        }
    }

    // ÄÃ³ng bÃ n: Ä‘Æ¡n Ä‘Ã£ há»§y háº¿t mÃ³n (0Ä‘) thÃ¬ Ä‘Ã³ng Ä‘Æ¡n, tráº£ bÃ n         
    
    public function closeEmptyOrder($order_id, $user_id) {
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $o = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code, status, table_id FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE", [(int)$order_id]);
            if (!$o) throw new Exception('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng!');
            if ($o['status'] !== 'Open') throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng.');
            $n = $this->one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_details WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status <> 'Cancelled'", [$o['id']]);
            if ($n['n'] > 0) throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n váº«n cÃ²n mÃ³n, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘Ã³ng bÃ n. HÃ£y thanh toÃ¡n hoáº·c há»§y mÃ³n trÆ°á»›c.');

            $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET status = 'Cancelled', subtotal = 0, total_amount = 0, closed_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?")->execute([$o['id']]);
            $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Available' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$o['table_id']]);
       
            $this->addLog($o['id'], $user_id, 'Checkout', "ÄÃ³ng bÃ n khÃ´ng phÃ¡t sinh doanh thu (Ä‘Æ¡n {$o['order_code']} Ä‘Ã£ há»§y háº¿t mÃ³n)");
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'message' => 'ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng bÃ n, bÃ n sáºµn sÃ ng Ä‘Ã³n khÃ¡ch má»›i'];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return $this->fail($e);
        }
    }

    // Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n / Gá»™p bÃ n                                             
    public function transferTableByTableId($from_table_id, $to_table_id, $user_id, $mode = '') {
        $from_id = (int)$from_table_id; $to_id = (int)$to_table_id;
        if (!$from_id || !$to_id || $from_id === $to_id) return $this->err('BÃ n má»›i pháº£i khÃ¡c bÃ n hiá»‡n táº¡i!');
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $tsql = "SELECT dt.id, dt.table_name, dt.status, a.name AS area_name, a.surcharge_percent
                     FROM dining_tables dt JOIN areas a ON dt.area_id = a.id WHERE dt.id = ? FOR UPDATE";
       
            if ($from_id < $to_id) { $fromT = $this->one($tsql, [$from_id]); $toT = $this->one($tsql, [$to_id]); }
            else                   { $toT = $this->one($tsql, [$to_id]);     $fromT = $this->one($tsql, [$from_id]); }
            if (!$fromT || !$toT) throw new Exception('BÃ n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i!');

            $fromOrder = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code, guest_count, customer_id FROM orders WHERE table_id = ? AND status = 'Open' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE", [$from_id]);
            if (!$fromOrder) throw new Exception('BÃ n nguá»“n hiá»‡n khÃ´ng cÃ³ Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng nÃ o Ä‘ang má»Ÿ!');
            $toOrder = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code FROM orders WHERE table_id = ? AND status = 'Open' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE", [$to_id]);
            if ($mode === '') $mode = $toOrder ? 'merge' : 'transfer';

            if ($mode === 'merge') {
                if (!$toOrder) throw new Exception('BÃ n Ä‘Ã­ch chÆ°a cÃ³ Ä‘Æ¡n Ä‘ang má»Ÿ Ä‘á»ƒ gá»™p. HÃ£y dÃ¹ng Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n.');
                // dá»“n toÃ n bá»™ mÃ³n giá»¯ nguyÃªn tráº¡ng thÃ¡i báº¿p, giÃ¡, ghi chÃº, giá» gá»i
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE order_details SET order_id = ? WHERE order_id = ?")->execute([$toOrder['id'], $fromOrder['id']]);
                // Ä‘Æ¡n Ä‘Ã­ch nháº­n thÃªm sá»‘ khÃ¡ch vÃ  khÃ¡ch hÃ ng (náº¿u Ä‘Æ¡n Ä‘Ã­ch chÆ°a cÃ³)
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET guest_count = guest_count + ?, customer_id = COALESCE(customer_id, ?) WHERE id = ?")
                    ->execute([(int)$fromOrder['guest_count'], $fromOrder['customer_id'], $toOrder['id']]);
                // Ä‘Ã³ng Ä‘Æ¡n nguá»“n (khÃ´ng cÃ³ doanh thu), tráº£ bÃ n nguá»“n
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET status = 'Cancelled', subtotal = 0, total_amount = 0, closed_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?")->execute([$fromOrder['id']]);
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Available' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$from_id]);
                //tÃ­nh láº¡i tiá»n Ä‘Æ¡n Ä‘Ã­ch
                $this->recalcSubtotal($toOrder['id']);
                $msg = 'Gá»™p bÃ n thÃ nh cÃ´ng!';
                $this->addLog($toOrder['id'], $user_id, 'MergeTable',
                    "Gá»™p bÃ n {$fromT['table_name']} (Ä‘Æ¡n {$fromOrder['order_code']}) vÃ o bÃ n {$toT['table_name']} (Ä‘Æ¡n {$toOrder['order_code']}). Phá»¥ thu tÃ­nh theo khu vá»±c {$toT['area_name']} (" . (float)$toT['surcharge_percent'] . '%)');
            } else {
                if ($toOrder || $toT['status'] !== 'Available') {
                    throw new Exception("BÃ n {$toT['table_name']} khÃ´ng trá»‘ng (" . ($toOrder ? 'Ä‘ang cÃ³ khÃ¡ch' : $toT['status']) . '), chá»‰ chuyá»ƒn Ä‘áº¿n bÃ n trá»‘ng!');
                }
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET table_id = ? WHERE id = ?")->execute([$to_id, $fromOrder['id']]);
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Available' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$from_id]);
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Occupied' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$to_id]);
                $msg = 'Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n thÃ nh cÃ´ng!';
                $this->addLog($fromOrder['id'], $user_id, 'TransferTable',
                    "Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n {$fromT['table_name']} ({$fromT['area_name']}, phá»¥ thu " . (float)$fromT['surcharge_percent'] . "%) sang {$toT['table_name']} ({$toT['area_name']}, phá»¥ thu " . (float)$toT['surcharge_percent'] . '%)');
            }
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'message' => $msg];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return $this->fail($e);
        }
    }

    // Dá»¯ liá»‡u in hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n                                              
   
    public function getBillData($order_id) {
        $order = $this->one("SELECT o.*, dt.table_name, a.name AS area_name, u.full_name AS waiter_name, c.full_name AS customer_name
                             FROM orders o
                             JOIN dining_tables dt ON o.table_id = dt.id
                             JOIN areas a ON dt.area_id = a.id
                             LEFT JOIN users u ON o.waiter_id = u.id
                             LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
                             WHERE o.id = ?", [(int)$order_id]);
        if (!$order) return null;
        $details = $this->all("SELECT od.*, mi.name AS item_name, mi.unit
                               FROM order_details od JOIN menu_items mi ON od.menu_item_id = mi.id
                               WHERE od.order_id = ? AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled' ORDER BY od.ordered_at, od.id", [$order['id']]);
        return ['order' => $order, 'details' => $details];
    }

    
    // BÃ¡o cÃ¡o 

    public function getReportByPaymentMethod($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('paid_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT payment_method, COUNT(id) AS transaction_count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_revenue
                           FROM payments WHERE 1=1 $w GROUP BY payment_method", $p);
    }

    public function getTimeShiftReport($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('paid_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(paid_at) < 14 THEN 'Ca sÃ¡ng (Ä‘áº¿n 14h)' WHEN HOUR(paid_at) < 18 THEN 'Ca chiá»u (14hâ€“18h)' ELSE 'Ca tá»‘i (tá»« 18h)' END AS shift_name,
                                  COUNT(id) AS transaction_count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_revenue
                           FROM payments WHERE 1=1 $w GROUP BY shift_name ORDER BY MIN(HOUR(paid_at))", $p);
    }

    public function getCancelLogsReport($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('ol.created_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT ol.id, ol.order_id, o.order_code, dt.table_name, u.full_name AS staff_name, ol.description, ol.created_at
                           FROM order_logs ol
                           LEFT JOIN users u ON ol.user_id = u.id
                           LEFT JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
                           LEFT JOIN dining_tables dt ON o.table_id = dt.id
                           WHERE ol.action_type = 'CancelItem' $w ORDER BY ol.id DESC", $p);
    }

    public function getMoveLogsReport($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('ol.created_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT ol.id, ol.action_type, o.order_code, u.full_name AS staff_name, ol.description, ol.created_at
                           FROM order_logs ol
                           LEFT JOIN users u ON ol.user_id = u.id
                           LEFT JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
                           WHERE ol.action_type IN ('TransferTable', 'MergeTable') $w ORDER BY ol.id DESC", $p);
    }

    // Doanh thu tá»«ng ca thu ngÃ¢n tÃ­nh trá»±c tiáº¿p tá»« payments trong khoáº£ng má»Ÿ-Ä‘Ã³ng ca
    public function getShiftRevenueReport($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('cs.opened_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT cs.id AS shift_id, u.full_name AS cashier_name, cs.opened_at, cs.closed_at, cs.opening_cash, cs.total_cash_sales, cs.status,
                  IFNULL((SELECT SUM(x.amount) FROM payments x WHERE x.cashier_id = cs.cashier_id AND x.paid_at >= cs.opened_at AND x.paid_at <= IFNULL(cs.closed_at, NOW())), 0) AS total_revenue,
                  IFNULL((SELECT SUM(x.amount) FROM payments x WHERE x.cashier_id = cs.cashier_id AND x.payment_method = 'Cash' AND x.paid_at >= cs.opened_at AND x.paid_at <= IFNULL(cs.closed_at, NOW())), 0) AS cash_revenue
                           FROM cash_shifts cs JOIN users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id
                           WHERE 1=1 $w ORDER BY cs.id DESC", $p);
    }

    public function getAllPromotions(string $keyword = ''): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM promotions";
        $params = [];

        if ($keyword !== '') {
            $sql .= " WHERE code LIKE ? OR name LIKE ?";
            $params = ["%$keyword%", "%$keyword%"];
        }

        $sql .= " ORDER BY id DESC";

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function findPromotion(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM promotions WHERE id = ?"
        );
        $stmt->execute([$id]);

        $promotion = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return $promotion ?: null;
    }

    public function savePromotion(array $data, ?int $id = null): bool
    {
        $code = strtoupper(trim($data['code'] ?? ''));
        $name = trim($data['name'] ?? '');
        $type = $data['discount_type'] ?? '';
        $value = (float)($data['discount_value'] ?? 0);
        $maxDiscount = $data['max_discount'] ?? null;
        $minOrder = (float)($data['min_order_value'] ?? 0);
        $minTier = $data['min_tier'] ?? 'Standard';
        $startDate = $data['start_date'] ?? '';
        $endDate = $data['end_date'] ?? '';
        $isActive = isset($data['is_active']) ? 1 : 0;

        if ($code === '' || $name === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Vui lòng nhập mã và tên voucher.');
        }

        if (!preg_match('/^[A-Z0-9_-]{3,30}$/', $code)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Mã voucher phải có 3-30 ký tự, chỉ gồm chữ, số, dấu gạch ngang hoặc gạch dưới.');
        }

        if (!in_array($type, ['Percent', 'Fixed'], true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Loại giảm giá không hợp lệ.');
        }

        if ($value <= 0 || ($type === 'Percent' && $value > 100)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Giá trị giảm giá không hợp lệ.');
        }

        if ($maxDiscount !== null && $maxDiscount !== '' && (float)$maxDiscount < 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Mức giảm tối đa không hợp lệ.');
        }

        if ($minOrder < 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Đơn tối thiểu không hợp lệ.');
        }

        if (!in_array($minTier, ['Standard', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Diamond'], true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Hạng thành viên không hợp lệ.');
        }

        if (!$startDate || !$endDate || strtotime($endDate) < strtotime($startDate)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Ngày kết thúc phải sau hoặc bằng ngày bắt đầu.');
        }

        $checkSql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotions WHERE code = ?";
        $checkParams = [$code];

        if ($id !== null) {
            $checkSql .= " AND id <> ?";
            $checkParams[] = $id;
        }

        $check = $this->db->prepare($checkSql);
        $check->execute($checkParams);

        if ((int)$check->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Mã voucher đã tồn tại.');
        }

        $maxDiscount = ($maxDiscount === '' || $maxDiscount === null)
            ? null
            : (float)$maxDiscount;

        if ($id !== null) {
            $sql = "UPDATE promotions SET
                    code = ?, name = ?, discount_type = ?,
                    discount_value = ?, max_discount = ?,
                    min_order_value = ?, min_tier = ?,
                    start_date = ?, end_date = ?, is_active = ?
                    WHERE id = ?";

            $params = [
                $code, $name, $type, $value, $maxDiscount,
                $minOrder, $minTier, $startDate, $endDate,
                $isActive, $id
            ];
        } else {
            $sql = "INSERT INTO promotions
                    (code, name, discount_type, discount_value,
                     max_discount, min_order_value, min_tier,
                     start_date, end_date, is_active)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

            $params = [
                $code, $name, $type, $value, $maxDiscount,
                $minOrder, $minTier, $startDate, $endDate,
                $isActive
            ];
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function deletePromotion(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "DELETE FROM promotions WHERE id = ?"
        );

        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function togglePromotion(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "UPDATE promotions
             SET is_active = IF(is_active = 1, 0, 1)
             WHERE id = ?"
        );

        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function validateVoucher(
        string $code,
        float $orderValue,
        string $customerTier = 'Standard'
    ): array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM promotions
             WHERE code = ?
             AND is_active = 1
             AND start_date <= CURDATE()
             AND end_date >= CURDATE()
             LIMIT 1"
        );

        $stmt->execute([strtoupper(trim($code))]);
        $voucher = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$voucher) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'message' => 'Voucher không tồn tại, hết hạn hoặc đã bị tắt.'];
        }

        if ($orderValue < (float)$voucher['min_order_value']) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'message' => 'Đơn hàng chưa đạt giá trị tối thiểu.'];
        }

        $tiers = ['Standard' => 0, 'Silver' => 1, 'Gold' => 2, 'Diamond' => 3];

        if (($tiers[$customerTier] ?? 0) < ($tiers[$voucher['min_tier']] ?? 0)) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'message' => 'Hạng thành viên chưa đủ điều kiện sử dụng voucher.'];
        }

        if ($voucher['discount_type'] === 'Percent') {
            $discount = $orderValue * (float)$voucher['discount_value'] / 100;

            if ($voucher['max_discount'] !== null) {
                $discount = min($discount, (float)$voucher['max_discount']);
            }
        } else {
            $discount = (float)$voucher['discount_value'];

            if ($voucher['max_discount'] !== null) {
                $discount = min($discount, (float)$voucher['max_discount']);
            }
        }

        $discount = min($discount, $orderValue);

        return [
            'valid' => true,
            'message' => 'Áp dụng voucher thành công.',
            'voucher' => $voucher,
            'discount' => $discount
        ];
    }
}

public function createCustomerReservation(array $data): string

public function updateReservationStatus(
    int $id,
    string $status
): bool {
    $this->db->beginTransaction();

    try {
        $allowed = [
            'Confirmed',
            'CheckedIn',
            'Cancelled'
        ];

        if (!in_array($status, $allowed, true)) {
            $this->db->rollBack();
            return false;
        }

        // KhÃ³a vÃ  láº¥y thÃ´ng tin Ä‘áº·t bÃ n
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT id, table_id, booking_time, status
             FROM reservations
             WHERE id = ?
             FOR UPDATE"
        );

        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $reservation = $stmt->fetch();

        if (!$reservation) {
            $this->db->rollBack();
            return false;
        }

        // Kiá»ƒm soÃ¡t luá»“ng tráº¡ng thÃ¡i
        $transitions = [
            'Pending' => ['Confirmed', 'Cancelled'],
            'Confirmed' => ['CheckedIn', 'Cancelled']
        ];

        $current = $reservation['status'];

        if (
            !isset($transitions[$current]) ||
            !in_array($status, $transitions[$current], true)
        ) {
            $this->db->rollBack();
            return false;
        }

        // KhÃ´ng cho check-in trÆ°á»›c giá» Ä‘áº·t bÃ n
        if ($status === 'CheckedIn') {
            $bookingTime = new DateTimeImmutable(
                $reservation['booking_time']
            );

            $now = new DateTimeImmutable();

            // Cho phép Check-in sớm khi khách đến trước giờ hẹn

            // Booking pháº£i cÃ³ bÃ n
            if (empty($reservation['table_id'])) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
                return false;
            }

            // KhÃ³a bÃ n Ä‘á»ƒ kiá»ƒm tra tráº¡ng thÃ¡i
            $tableStmt = $this->db->prepare(
                "SELECT status
                 FROM dining_tables
                 WHERE id = ?
                 FOR UPDATE"
            );

            $tableStmt->execute([$reservation['table_id']]);
            $table = $tableStmt->fetch();

            if (
                !$table ||
                !in_array(
                    $table['status'],
                    ['Available', 'Reserved'],
                    true
                )
            ) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
                return false;
            }

            // Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n thÃ nh Ä‘ang phá»¥c vá»¥
            $updateTable = $this->db->prepare(
                "UPDATE dining_tables
                 SET status = 'Occupied'
                 WHERE id = ?"
            );

            $updateTable->execute([$reservation['table_id']]);
        }

        // Cáº­p nháº­t tráº¡ng thÃ¡i Ä‘áº·t bÃ n
        $update = $this->db->prepare(
            "UPDATE reservations
             SET status = ?
             WHERE id = ?"
        );

        $update->execute([$status, $id]);

        $this->db->commit();
        return true;

    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
            $this->db->rollBack();
        }

        throw $e;
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/Database.php';

class StockModel {
    private $conn;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->conn = Database::getConnection();
    }

    public function getIngredients($search = '', $group_filter = '', $unit_filter = '', $status_filter = '', $limit = 10, $offset = 0) {
        $query = "SELECT ingredients.*, suppliers.name AS supplier_name 
                  FROM ingredients 
                  LEFT JOIN suppliers ON ingredients.supplier_id = suppliers.id 
                  WHERE (ingredients.name LIKE :search1 OR ingredients.ingredient_code LIKE :search2)";
        
        $params = [
            ':search1' => "%$search%",
            ':search2' => "%$search%"
        ];

        if (!empty($group_filter)) {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.group_name = :group";
            $params[':group'] = $group_filter;
        }

        if (!empty($unit_filter)) {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.unit = :unit";
            $params[':unit'] = $unit_filter;
        }

        if ($status_filter === 'low') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity <= ingredients.min_stock_level AND ingredients.stock_quantity > 0";
        } elseif ($status_filter === 'safe') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity > ingredients.min_stock_level";
        } elseif ($status_filter === 'out_of_stock') {
        $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity <= 0";
        }

        $query .= " ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(ingredients.ingredient_code, 4) AS UNSIGNED) ASC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($query);
        
        foreach ($params as $key => $val) {
            $stmt->bindValue($key, $val, PDO::PARAM_STR);
        }
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', (int)$limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':offset', (int)$offset, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

            ':search1' => "%$search%",
            ':search2' => "%$search%"
        ];

        if (!empty($group_filter)) {
            $query .= " AND group_name = :group";
            $params[':group'] = $group_filter;
        }
        
        if (!empty($unit_filter)) {
            $query .= " AND unit = :unit";
            $params[':unit'] = $unit_filter;
        }
        
        if ($status_filter === 'low') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity <= ingredients.min_stock_level AND ingredients.stock_quantity > 0";
        } elseif ($status_filter === 'safe') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity > ingredients.min_stock_level";
        } elseif ($status_filter === 'out_of_stock') {
        $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity <= 0";
        }

        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($query);
        foreach ($params as $key => $val) {
            $stmt->bindValue($key, $val, PDO::PARAM_STR);
        }
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['total'];
    }

            'today_receipts' => 0
        ];
        
        $stmt = $this->conn->query("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ingredients");
        $kpis['total_ingredients'] = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['count'];
        
        $stmt = $this->conn->query("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ingredients WHERE stock_quantity <= min_stock_level AND stock_quantity > 0");
        $kpis['low_stock'] = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['count'];
        
        $stmt = $this->conn->query("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ingredients WHERE stock_quantity <= 0");
        $kpis['out_of_stock'] = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['count'];
        
        $stmt = $this->conn->query("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM stock_receipts WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()");
        $kpis['today_receipts'] = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['count'];
        
        return $kpis;

    public function getRecentActivities($limit = 5, $offset = 0) {
        $query = "SELECT id, receipt_code, receipt_type, created_at, user_id 
                  FROM stock_receipts

    public function generateNextIngredientCode() {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(ingredient_code, 4) AS UNSIGNED)) as max_id FROM ingredients WHERE ingredient_code LIKE 'NVL%'");
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        $nextId = ($row['max_id'] ? (int)$row['max_id'] : 0) + 1;
        
        return 'NVL' . str_pad($nextId, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }

    public function countReceiptHistory($search = '', $type = '', $date_filter = '') {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as total 
                FROM stock_receipts r 
                LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id 
                WHERE 1=1";
                
        if (!empty($search)) { 
            $sql .= " AND (r.receipt_code LIKE :search_code OR u.full_name LIKE :search_name)"; 
        }
        
        if (!empty($type)) {
            if ($type === 'Import') {
                $sql .= " AND r.receipt_type = 'Import'";
            } elseif ($type === 'Export' || strtolower($type) === 'export') {
                $sql .= " AND r.receipt_type IN ('Export_Sale', 'Export_Damage')";
            } elseif ($type === 'Audit_Adjust') {
                $sql .= " AND r.receipt_type = 'Audit_Adjust'";
            } else {
                $sql .= " AND r.receipt_type = :type";
            }
        }

        if ($date_filter === 'today') {
            $sql .= " AND DATE(r.created_at) = CURDATE()";
        }
        
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        
        if (!empty($search)) { 
            $stmt->bindValue(':search_code', "%$search%"); 
            $stmt->bindValue(':search_name', "%$search%"); 
        }
        
        if (!empty($type) && $type !== 'Import' && $type !== 'Export' && strtolower($type) !== 'export' && $type !== 'Audit_Adjust') { 
            $stmt->bindValue(':type', $type); 
        }
        
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['total'];
    }

            $this->conn->beginTransaction();

            $sqlReceipt = "INSERT INTO stock_receipts (receipt_code, supplier_id, user_id, receipt_type, total_amount, note, created_at)

            ]);
            $receiptId = $this->conn->lastInsertId();

            $sqlUpdateStock = "UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = :actual_qty WHERE id = :ingredient_id";
            $stmtUpdateStock = $this->conn->prepare($sqlUpdateStock);

            $sqlDetail = "INSERT INTO stock_receipt_details (stock_receipt_id, ingredient_id, quantity, unit_cost, reason) 
                          VALUES (:stock_receipt_id, :ingredient_id, :quantity, :unit_cost, :reason)";

            foreach ($auditDetails as $detail) {
                $stmtUpdateStock->execute([
                    ':actual_qty'    => $detail['actual_qty'],
                    ':ingredient_id' => $detail['ingredient_id']
                ]);

                $stmtDetail->execute([
                    ':stock_receipt_id' => $receiptId,
                    ':ingredient_id'    => $detail['ingredient_id'],
                    ':quantity'         => $detail['difference'], 
                    ':unit_cost'        => $detail['unit_cost'],
                    ':reason'           => $detail['reason'] ?? '' 
                ]);
            }

            $this->conn->commit();
            return $receiptId; 
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $this->conn->rollBack();
            error_log("Lá»—i LÆ°u Phiáº¿u Kiá»ƒm KÃª: " . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function deductStockByOrder($order_id, $user_id = 2) {
        $dbConn = $this->conn ?? Database::getConnection(); // Sá»­ dá»¥ng chung káº¿t ná»‘i
        
        try {
            $dbConn->beginTransaction();

            $stmtOrder = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT menu_item_id, quantity FROM order_details WHERE order_id = :order_id");
            $stmtOrder->execute([':order_id' => $order_id]);
            $orderDetails = $stmtOrder->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (empty($orderDetails)) {
                $dbConn->rollBack();
                return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'ÄÆ¡n hÃ ng nÃ y trá»‘ng hoáº·c khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.'];
            }

            $ingredientsToDeduct = [];

            $stmtBom = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT ingredient_id, quantity_required FROM recipes_bom WHERE menu_item_id = :menu_item_id");
            
            foreach ($orderDetails as $item) {
                $stmtBom->execute([':menu_item_id' => $item['menu_item_id']]);
                $boms = $stmtBom->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                
                foreach ($boms as $bom) {
                    $ing_id = $bom['ingredient_id'];
                    $total_req = $bom['quantity_required'] * $item['quantity'];
                    
                    if (isset($ingredientsToDeduct[$ing_id])) {
                        $ingredientsToDeduct[$ing_id] += $total_req;
                    } else {
                        $ingredientsToDeduct[$ing_id] = $total_req;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (empty($ingredientsToDeduct)) {
                $dbConn->rollBack();
                return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'CÃ¡c mÃ³n trong Ä‘Æ¡n khÃ´ng cáº§n trá»« Ä‘á»‹nh lÆ°á»£ng nguyÃªn liá»‡u.'];
            }

            $receipt_code = 'VX' . date('ymdHis') . rand(10, 99);
            $note = "Xuáº¥t kho tá»± Ä‘á»™ng cho hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n bÃ¡n hÃ ng #" . $order_id;
            
            $stmtReceipt = $dbConn->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_receipts (receipt_code, user_id, receipt_type, total_amount, note, created_at) 
                                             VALUES (:code, :user_id, 'Export_Sale', 0, :note, NOW())");
            $stmtReceipt->execute([
                ':code'    => $receipt_code,
                ':user_id' => $user_id,
                ':note'    => $note
            ]);
            $receipt_id = $dbConn->lastInsertId();

            $stmtInsertDetail = $dbConn->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_receipt_details (stock_receipt_id, ingredient_id, quantity, unit_cost) VALUES (:receipt_id, :ingredient_id, :quantity, (SELECT cost_price FROM ingredients WHERE id = :ing_cost_id))");
            $stmtUpdateStock = $dbConn->prepare("UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - :deduct_qty WHERE id = :ingredient_id");
            $stmtCheckAlert = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT name, stock_quantity, min_stock_level, unit FROM ingredients WHERE id = :ingredient_id");

            $warnings = []; 

            foreach ($ingredientsToDeduct as $ing_id => $deduct_qty) {
                $stmtInsertDetail->execute([
                    ':receipt_id'    => $receipt_id,
                    ':ingredient_id' => $ing_id,
                    ':quantity' => $deduct_qty, ':ing_cost_id' => $ing_id]);

                $stmtUpdateStock->execute([
                    ':deduct_qty'    => $deduct_qty,
                    ':ingredient_id' => $ing_id
                ]);

                $stmtCheckAlert->execute([':ingredient_id' => $ing_id]);
                $ingData = $stmtCheckAlert->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                
                if ($ingData && $ingData['stock_quantity'] <= $ingData['min_stock_level']) {
                    $warnings[] = "âš  NguyÃªn liá»‡u [{$ingData['name']}] sáº¯p háº¿t! (Chá»‰ cÃ²n: {$ingData['stock_quantity']} {$ingData['unit']})";
                }
            }

            $dbConn->commit();
            return [
                'success'      => true, 
                'receipt_code' => $receipt_code,
                'warnings'     => $warnings
            ];

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $dbConn->rollBack();
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Lá»—i há»‡ thá»‘ng khi trá»« kho: ' . $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
    public function getInventoryAndProfitReport($startDate, $endDate) {
        $dbConn = $this->conn ?? Database::getConnection();

        $start = !empty($startDate) ? date('Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime($startDate)) : '2020-01-01 00:00:00';
        $end = !empty($endDate) ? date('Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime($endDate)) : '2030-12-31 23:59:59';

        $sqlXNT = "SELECT 
                    i.id, i.name, i.unit, i.cost_price,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.receipt_type = 'Import' AND sr.created_at BETWEEN :start1 AND :end1 THEN srd.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_imported,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.receipt_type LIKE 'Export%' AND sr.created_at BETWEEN :start2 AND :end2 THEN srd.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_exported
                   FROM ingredients i
                   LEFT JOIN stock_receipt_details srd ON i.id = srd.ingredient_id
                   LEFT JOIN stock_receipts sr ON srd.stock_receipt_id = sr.id
                   GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.unit, i.cost_price";
        
        $stmt = $dbConn->prepare($sqlXNT);
        $stmt->execute([
            ':start1' => $start, 
            ':end1'   => $end,
            ':start2' => $start, 
            ':end2'   => $end
        ]);
        $reportData = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $totalCostOfGoodsSold = 0;
        foreach ($reportData as $row) {
            $consumedCost = $row['total_exported'] * $row['cost_price'];
            $totalCostOfGoodsSold += $consumedCost;
        }

        $sqlRevenue = "SELECT SUM(total_cash_sales) as total_revenue FROM cash_shifts WHERE opened_at BETWEEN :start AND :end";
        $stmtRev = $dbConn->prepare($sqlRevenue);
        $stmtRev->execute([':start' => $start, ':end' => $end]);
        $revData = $stmtRev->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $totalRevenue = $revData['total_revenue'] ?? 0;

        $grossProfit = $totalRevenue - $totalCostOfGoodsSold;
        $foodCostPercentage = ($totalRevenue > 0) ? ($totalCostOfGoodsSold / $totalRevenue) * 100 : 0;

        return [
            'items' => $reportData,
            'summary' => [
                'total_revenue' => $totalRevenue,
                'total_cogs' => $totalCostOfGoodsSold,
                'gross_profit' => $grossProfit,
                'food_cost_percentage' => round($foodCostPercentage, 2)
            ]
        ];
    }
    public function deleteReceiptWithRevert($receiptId, $receiptType) {
        try {
            $this->conn->beginTransaction();

            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT ingredient_id, quantity FROM stock_receipt_details WHERE stock_receipt_id = :id");
            $stmt->execute([':id' => $receiptId]);
            $details = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            $sqlUpdateStock = "";
            if ($receiptType === 'Import') {
                $sqlUpdateStock = "UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - :qty WHERE id = :ing_id";
            } elseif (strpos($receiptType, 'Export') === 0) {
                $sqlUpdateStock = "UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + :qty WHERE id = :ing_id";
            }

            if (!empty($sqlUpdateStock)) {
                $stmtUpdate = $this->conn->prepare($sqlUpdateStock);
                foreach ($details as $detail) {
                    $stmtUpdate->execute([
                        ':qty' => $detail['quantity'],
                        ':ing_id' => $detail['ingredient_id']
                    ]);
                }
            }

            $stmtDelDetails = $this->conn->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_receipt_details WHERE stock_receipt_id = :id");
            $stmtDelDetails->execute([':id' => $receiptId]);

            $stmtDelReceipt = $this->conn->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_receipts WHERE id = :id");
            $stmtDelReceipt->execute([':id' => $receiptId]);

            $this->conn->commit();
            return true;

        } catch (Exception $e) {
            $this->conn->rollBack();
            error_log("Lá»—i Há»§y Phiáº¿u: " . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

{

    );

    $stmt->execute([$id]);

    if ((int)$stmt->fetchColumn() > 0) {
        throw new InvalidArgumentException(
            'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a khu vá»±c Ä‘ang cÃ³ bÃ n liÃªn káº¿t.'
        );
    }

    $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
        "DELETE FROM areas WHERE id = ?"
    );

    return $stmt->execute([$id]);
}

    public function addTable(
        int $areaId,
        string $name,
        int $capacity
    ): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO dining_tables (area_id, table_name, capacity, status)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Available')"
        );

        return $stmt->execute([$areaId, $name, $capacity]);
    }

    public function updateTable(
        int $id,
        int $areaId,
        string $name,
        int $capacity
    ): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "UPDATE dining_tables
             SET area_id = ?, table_name = ?, capacity = ?
             WHERE id = ?"
        );

        return $stmt->execute([$areaId, $name, $capacity, $id]);
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $id, string $status): bool
    {
        $allowedStatuses = [
            'Available', 'Occupied', 'Reserved', 'Cleaning'
        ];

        if (!in_array($status, $allowedStatuses, true)) {
            return false;
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "UPDATE dining_tables SET status = ? WHERE id = ?"
        );

        return $stmt->execute([$status, $id]);
    }

    public function findTable(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT * FROM dining_tables WHERE id = ?"
        );

        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $table = $stmt->fetch();

        return $table ?: null;
    }
}

<script>
(function () {
    const root = document.querySelector('.rd-floorplan');

    if (!root) {
        return;
    }

    const searchInput = root.querySelector('#rd-search');
    const rooms = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.rd-map-room'));
    const tables = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.rd-map-table'));
    const noResults = root.querySelector('#rd-no-results');

    const detail = root.querySelector('#rd-map-detail');
    const detailTitle = root.querySelector('#rd-detail-title');
    const detailInfo = root.querySelector('#rd-detail-info');
    const closeButton = root.querySelector('#rd-detail-close');
    const bookingLink = root.querySelector('#rd-detail-booking');

    // TÃ¬m bÃ n theo tÃªn bÃ n hoáº·c khu vá»±c.
    if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
            const keyword = this.value
                .trim()
                .toLocaleLowerCase('vi');

            let visibleRoomCount = 0;
            let visibleTableCount = 0;

            rooms.forEach(function (room) {
                const roomArea = (
                    room.dataset.area || ''
                ).toLocaleLowerCase('vi');

                let roomHasVisibleTable = false;

                room.querySelectorAll('.rd-map-table').forEach(
                    function (table) {
                        const tableName = (
                            table.dataset.nameSearch || ''
                        ).toLocaleLowerCase('vi');

                        const tableArea = (
                            table.dataset.areaSearch || ''
                        ).toLocaleLowerCase('vi');

                        const matched = keyword === ''
                            || tableName.includes(keyword)
                            || tableArea.includes(keyword)
                            || roomArea.includes(keyword);

                        table.classList.toggle(
                            'rd-hidden',
                            !matched
                        );

                        if (matched) {
                            roomHasVisibleTable = true;
                            visibleTableCount++;
                        }
                    }
                );

                // Khu vá»±c khÃ´ng cÃ³ bÃ n váº«n hiá»‡n khi Ã´ tÃ¬m kiáº¿m rá»—ng.
                const hasTables = room.querySelectorAll(
                    '.rd-map-table'
                ).length > 0;

                const shouldShowRoom = keyword === ''
                    ? true
                    : roomHasVisibleTable
                        || (!hasTables && roomArea.includes(keyword));

                room.classList.toggle(
                    'rd-hidden',
                    !shouldShowRoom
                );

                if (shouldShowRoom) {
                    visibleRoomCount++;
                }
            });

            noResults.classList.toggle(
                'visible',
                keyword !== '' && visibleTableCount === 0
                    && visibleRoomCount === 0
            );

            if (keyword !== '' && visibleTableCount === 0) {
                const hasEmptyAreaMatch = rooms.some(function (room) {
                    return room.querySelectorAll('.rd-map-table').length === 0
                        && (room.dataset.area || '')
                            .toLocaleLowerCase('vi').includes(keyword);
                });

                noResults.classList.toggle(
                    'visible',
                    !hasEmptyAreaMatch
                );
            }
        });
    }

    // Báº¥m bÃ n Ä‘á»ƒ xem thÃ´ng tin.
    tables.forEach(function (table) {
        table.addEventListener('click', function () {
            detailTitle.textContent =
                'BÃ n ' + this.dataset.name;

            detailInfo.textContent =
                'Khu vá»±c: ' + this.dataset.areaName
                + ' | Sá»©c chá»©a: ' + this.dataset.capacity + ' khÃ¡ch'
                + ' | Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i: ' + this.dataset.statusLabel
                + ' | Phá»¥ thu khu vá»±c: ' + this.dataset.surcharge + '%';

            bookingLink.href =
                'index.php?c=booking&a=vip&table_id='
                + encodeURIComponent(this.dataset.id);

            detail.classList.add('open');

            detail.scrollIntoView({
                behavior: 'smooth',
                block: 'nearest'
            });
        });
    });

    if (closeButton) {
        closeButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
            detail.classList.remove('open');
        });
    }
})();
</script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<script>
const dailyLabels   = <?= json_encode($dailyLabels) ?>;
const dailyRevenue  = <?= json_encode($dailyRevenue) ?>;
const monthlyLabels = <?= json_encode($monthlyLabels) ?>;
const monthlyRevenue= <?= json_encode($monthlyRevenue) ?>;

// 1. Khởi tạo Biểu đồ Doanh thu (Line / Bar kết hợp)
const ctxRev = document.getElementById('revenueChart').getContext('2d');
let revenueChart = new Chart(ctxRev, {
    type: 'bar',
    data: {
        labels: dailyLabels,
        datasets: [{
            label: 'Doanh thu (VNĐ)',
            data: dailyRevenue,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.75)',
            borderColor: '#b8860b',
            borderWidth: 2,
            borderRadius: 6
        }]
    },
    options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: {
            legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: {
                callbacks: {
                    label: function(ctx) {
                        return ' Doanh thu: ' + Number(ctx.raw).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' đ';
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        scales: {
            y: {
                beginAtZero: true,
                ticks: {
                    callback: function(value) {
                        return (value / 1000000).toFixed(0) + ' Tr';
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
});

function switchRevenueMode(mode) {
    const btnDaily = document.getElementById('btnRevDaily');
    const btnMonthly = document.getElementById('btnRevMonthly');
    const title = document.getElementById('revChartTitle');

    if (mode === 'monthly') {
        revenueChart.config.type = 'line';
        revenueChart.data.labels = monthlyLabels;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].data = monthlyRevenue;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].fill = true;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = 'rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2)';
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].tension = 0.35;
        title.innerText = '📈 Biểu Đồ Xu Hướng Doanh Thu 6 Tháng Gần Nhất (VNĐ)';
        btnMonthly.className = 'btn btn-dark text-warning fw-bold';
        btnDaily.className = 'btn btn-outline-dark';
    } else {
        revenueChart.config.type = 'bar';
        revenueChart.data.labels = dailyLabels;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].data = dailyRevenue;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].fill = false;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = 'rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.75)';
        title.innerText = '📈 Biểu Đồ Doanh Thu 7 Ngày Gần Nhất (VNĐ)';
        btnDaily.className = 'btn btn-dark text-warning fw-bold';
        btnMonthly.className = 'btn btn-outline-dark';
    }
    revenueChart.update();
}

// 2. Khởi tạo Biểu đồ Tỷ lệ lấp đầy bàn (Doughnut Chart)
const ctxOcc = document.getElementById('occupancyChart').getContext('2d');

        }]
    },
    options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        cutout: '65%',
        plugins: {
            legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { boxWidth: 12, font: { size: 11 } } }
        }
    }
});

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.2/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
const bomData = <?= json_encode($bomByItem, JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>;
const modData = <?= json_encode($modByItem, JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>;

function openAddMenuItem() {
    document.getElementById('menuItemModalTitle').innerText = '➕ Thêm Món Ăn / Set Menu 5 Sao';
    document.getElementById('form_item_id').value = '0';
    document.getElementById('form_item_code').value = '';
    document.getElementById('form_name').value = '';
    document.getElementById('form_unit').value = 'Phần';
    document.getElementById('form_price').value = '';
    document.getElementById('form_status').value = 'Available';
}

function openEditMenuItem(item) {
    document.getElementById('menuItemModalTitle').innerText = '✏️ Cập Nhật Món Ăn: ' + item.name;
    document.getElementById('form_item_id').value = item.id;
    document.getElementById('form_item_code').value = item.item_code;
    document.getElementById('form_category_id').value = item.category_id;
    document.getElementById('form_name').value = item.name;
    document.getElementById('form_unit').value = item.unit;
    document.getElementById('form_price').value = parseFloat(item.price);
    document.getElementById('form_status').value = item.status;
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('menuItemModal')).show();
}

function openBomModal(itemId, itemName) {
    document.getElementById('bom_menu_item_id').value = itemId;
    document.getElementById('bom_item_title').innerText = itemName;
    const tbody = document.getElementById('bom_table_body');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    const list = bomData[itemId] || [];

    if (list.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted py-3">Chưa có nguyên liệu nào trong công thức của món này.</td></tr>';
    } else {
        list.forEach(row => {
            tbody.innerHTML += `
                <tr>
                    <td class="fw-semibold">${row.ingredient_name}</td>
                    <td class="text-center fw-bold text-success">${row.quantity_required}</td>
                    <td class="text-center"><code>${row.unit}</code></td>
                    <td class="text-center">
                        <a href="index.php?c=menu&a=deleteBom&menu_item_id=${itemId}&ingredient_id=${row.ingredient_id}" 
                           class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger py-0">✖</a>
                    </td>
                </tr>`;
        });
    }
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('bomModal')).show();
}

function openModModal(itemId, itemName) {
    document.getElementById('mod_menu_item_id').value = itemId;
    document.getElementById('mod_item_title').innerText = itemName;
    const tbody = document.getElementById('mod_table_body');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    const list = modData[itemId] || [];

    if (list.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted py-3">Chưa có sở thích phục vụ nào cho món này.</td></tr>';
    } else {
        list.forEach(row => {
            const priceText = parseFloat(row.extra_price) > 0 
                ? '+' + Number(row.extra_price).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' đ' 
                : '<span class="text-muted">Miễn phí</span>';
            tbody.innerHTML += `
                <tr>
                    <td><span class="badge bg-dark">${row.modifier_group}</span></td>
                    <td class="fw-semibold">${row.modifier_name}</td>
                    <td class="text-end fw-bold text-danger">${priceText}</td>
                    <td class="text-center">
                        <a href="index.php?c=menu&a=deleteModifier&id=${row.id}&menu_item_id=${itemId}" 
                           class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger py-0">✖</a>
                    </td>
                </tr>`;
        });
    }
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('modModal')).show();
}

// Tự động mở lại Modal BOM hoặc Modifiers sau khi vừa Thêm/Xóa xong để thao tác liên tục
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (params.has('open_bom')) {
        const id = params.get('open_bom');
        openBomModal(id, 'Món #' + id);
    } else if (params.has('open_mod')) {
        const id = params.get('open_mod');
        openModModal(id, 'Món #' + id);
    }
});
</script>

function openAddUser() {
    document.getElementById('userModalTitle').innerText = '➕ Thêm Nhân Viên Mới';
    document.getElementById('modal_user_id').value = '0';
    document.getElementById('modal_full_name').value = '';
    document.getElementById('modal_username').value = '';
    document.getElementById('modal_username').readOnly = false;
    document.getElementById('modal_phone').value = '';
    document.getElementById('password_group').style.display = 'block';
}

function openEditUser(user) {
    document.getElementById('userModalTitle').innerText = '✏️ Cập Nhật Hồ Sơ & Phân Quyền: ' + user.full_name;
    document.getElementById('modal_user_id').value = user.id;
    document.getElementById('modal_full_name').value = user.full_name;
    document.getElementById('modal_username').value = user.username;
    document.getElementById('modal_username').readOnly = true;
    document.getElementById('modal_phone').value = user.phone || '';
    document.getElementById('modal_role_id').value = user.role_id;
    document.getElementById('password_group').style.display = 'none';
    var modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('userModal'));
    modal.show();
}

function closeTable(orderId) {

function kdsItems() {
    const out = [];
    S.orders.forEach(o => { const t = S.tables.find(x => x.id == o.table_id);
        o.items.forEach(i => { if (['Waiting', 'Cooking', 'Ready'].includes(i.kds_status))
            out.push({...i, table_name: t ? t.table_name : '?', station: i.course_type == 'Beverage' ? 'Bar' : 'Kitchen'}); }); });
    return out.sort((a, b) => a.ts - b.ts || a.id - b.id);
}

    const L = all.filter(i => stn == 'ALL' || i.station == stn);
    const col = (st, title, btn, to) => {
        const l = L.filter(i => i.kds_status == st);
        return `<div class="rd-card"><h3>${title} (${l.length})</h3>` + (l.length ? l.map(i => {
            const late = i.wait >= 15 && st != 'Ready';
            return `<div class="rd-tk ${late ? 'late' : ''}"><div class="tt"><span>BÃ n ${esc(i.table_name)}</span><span>${i.wait} phÃºt</span></div>
                <div class="qty">${i.quantity}Ã— ${esc(i.name)}</div>

                <button class="rd-btn rd-btn-gold" onclick="adv(${i.id},'${to}')">${btn}</button>

        const id = payId;
        const w = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=450,height=700');  
        const r = await api('checkout', {order_id: id, payment_method: pm, customer_phone: PH, voucher_code: VC, transaction_ref: REF});
        if (r.status != 'success') { if (w) w.close(); return r.message || 'Thanh toÃ¡n tháº¥t báº¡i'; }
        toast('ÄÃ£ thu ' + money(r.total_amount));
        if (w) w.location = `index.php?c=pos&a=printBill&order_id=${id}`;
        else toast('TrÃ¬nh duyá»‡t Ä‘ang cháº·n cá»­a sá»• in. HÃ£y cho phÃ©p popup rá»“i má»Ÿ láº¡i hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n tá»« trang BÃ¡o cÃ¡o.', 1);
        payId = null; PB = null; PH = ''; VC = ''; REF = ''; curId = null;
        await refreshAll(); showPane('pos');
    });
}
