}
function exportCsv() {
    const D = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('rpt').textContent);
    const cell = v => { v = String(v ?? ''); if (/^[=+\-@]/.test(v)) v = "'" + v; return '"' + v.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; };
    const line = a => a.map(cell).join(',') + '\n';
    let c = '\uFEFF' + line(['BÃO CÃO DOANH THU VÃ€ NHáº¬T KÃ Há»¦Y MÃ“N']) + line(['Tá»« ngÃ y', D.from, 'Äáº¿n ngÃ y', D.to]) + '\n';
    c += line(['DOANH THU THEO PHÆ¯Æ NG THá»¨C']) + line(['PhÆ°Æ¡ng thá»©c', 'Sá»‘ giao dá»‹ch', 'Doanh thu (VND)']);
    D.pay.forEach(r => c += line([r.payment_method, r.n, r.total]));
    c += '\n' + line(['DOANH THU THEO CA']) + line(['Ca', 'Sá»‘ giao dá»‹ch', 'Doanh thu (VND)']);
    D.time.forEach(r => c += line([r.shift_name, r.n, r.total]));
    c += '\n' + line(['NHáº¬T KÃ Há»¦Y MÃ“N']) + line(['Thá»i gian', 'NhÃ¢n viÃªn', 'BÃ n', 'MÃ£ Ä‘Æ¡n', 'MÃ³n', 'LÃ½ do']);
    D.cancel.forEach(r => c += line([r.time, r.staff, r.table, r.order, r.item, r.reason]));
    c += '\n' + line(['CHUYá»‚N BÃ€N / Gá»˜P BÃ€N']) + line(['Thá»i gian', 'NhÃ¢n viÃªn', 'MÃ£ Ä‘Æ¡n', 'Ná»™i dung']);
    D.moves.forEach(r => c += line([r.time, r.staff, r.order, r.description]));
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([c], {type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'}));
    a.download = `BaoCao_RoyalDine_${D.from}_${D.to}.csv`;

<script>
const rowsPerPage = 10;
const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.audit-row');
const totalPages = Math.ceil(rows.length / rowsPerPage);
let currentPage = 1;

function renderTable(page) {
    if (page < 1 || page > totalPages) return;
    currentPage = page;
    let start = (page - 1) * rowsPerPage;
    let end = start + rowsPerPage;

    rows.forEach((row, index) => {
        row.style.display = (index >= start && index < end) ? '' : 'none';
    });

    let endInfo = end > rows.length ? rows.length : end;
    document.getElementById('pageInfo').innerText = `Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ ${start + 1} Ä‘áº¿n ${endInfo} trÃªn tá»•ng ${rows.length} máº·t hÃ ng`;
    renderPagination();
}

function renderPagination() {
    const ul = document.getElementById('paginationControls');
    ul.innerHTML = '';
    ul.innerHTML += `<li class="page-item ${currentPage === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}"><a class="page-link" onclick="renderTable(${currentPage - 1})">TrÆ°á»›c</a></li>`;
    for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
        ul.innerHTML += `<li class="page-item ${currentPage === i ? 'active' : ''}"><a class="page-link" onclick="renderTable(${i})">${i}</a></li>`;
    }
    ul.innerHTML += `<li class="page-item ${currentPage === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''}"><a class="page-link" onclick="renderTable(${currentPage + 1})">Sau</a></li>`;
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    if (rows.length > 0) renderTable(1);
    else document.getElementById('pageInfo').innerText = "KhÃ´ng cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u nguyÃªn váº­t liá»‡u.";
});

document.querySelectorAll('.actual-input').forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener('input', function() {
        let currentQty = parseFloat(this.getAttribute('data-current'));
        let actualQty = parseFloat(this.value);
        let diffCol = this.closest('tr').querySelector('.diff-col');
        
        if (isNaN(actualQty)) {
            diffCol.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">-</span>';
        } else {
            let diff = actualQty - currentQty;
            if (diff > 0) diffCol.innerHTML = `<span class="text-success">+${diff.toFixed(2)} (DÆ°)</span>`;
            else if (diff < 0) diffCol.innerHTML = `<span class="text-danger">${diff.toFixed(2)} (Há»¥t)</span>`;
            else diffCol.innerHTML = `<span class="text-secondary">Khá»›p 100%</span>`;
        }
    });
});

function exportToExcel() {
    var wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
    var ws_data = [
        ["BIÃŠN Báº¢N KIá»‚M Äáº¾M KHO", "", "", "", "", ""],
        ["NgÃ y xuáº¥t phiáº¿u:", new Date().toLocaleDateString('vi-VN'), "", "", "", ""],
        [""],
        ["MÃƒ NVL", "TÃŠN HÃ€NG HÃ“A", "ÄVT", "Tá»’N Há»† THá»NG", "Sá» LÆ¯á»¢NG THá»°C Táº¾ (ÄIá»€N TAY)", "LÃ DO / GHI CHÃš Lá»†CH"]
    ];
    
    rows.forEach(row => {
        let code = row.cells[0].innerText.trim();
        let name = row.cells[1].innerText.trim();
        let stock = row.cells[2].innerText.trim();
        let unit = row.cells[3].innerText.trim();
        ws_data.push([code, name, unit, stock, "", ""]); 
    });

    var ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(ws_data);
    ws['!cols'] = [{wch: 12}, {wch: 40}, {wch: 10}, {wch: 15}, {wch: 32}, {wch: 30}];
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, "PhieuKiemKe");
    XLSX.writeFile(wb, "Phieu_Kiem_Ke_Kho_" + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) + ".xlsx");
}
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.item-checkbox');
        const exportForm = document.getElementById('exportForm');

        checkboxes.forEach(chk => {
            chk.addEventListener('change', function () {
                const row = this.closest('tr');
                const qtyInput = row.querySelector('.quantity-input');
                const costInput = row.querySelector('.cost-input');

                qtyInput.disabled = !this.checked;
                costInput.disabled = !this.checked;

                if (this.checked) {
                    qtyInput.focus();
                    row.style.backgroundColor = '#fff8e1';
                } else {
                    qtyInput.value = '1';
                    row.style.backgroundColor = '';
                }
            });
        });

        const rowsPerPage = 10;
        const tableBody = document.getElementById('ingredientTableBody');
        const tableRows = Array.from(tableBody.querySelectorAll('tr.ing-row'));
        const paginationControls = document.getElementById('paginationControls');

        function displayPage(page) {
            const start = (page - 1) * rowsPerPage;
            const end = start + rowsPerPage;

            tableRows.forEach((row, index) => {
                if (index >= start && index < end) {
                    row.style.display = '';
                } else {
                    row.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
            updatePaginationUI(page);
        }

        function updatePaginationUI(page) {
            const totalPages = Math.ceil(tableRows.length / rowsPerPage);
            paginationControls.innerHTML = '';

            if (totalPages <= 1) return;

            // NÃºt "TrÆ°á»›c"
            const prevLi = document.createElement('li');
            prevLi.className = page === 1 ? 'disabled' : '';
            prevLi.innerHTML = `<a href="#">TrÆ°á»›c</a>`;
            prevLi.addEventListener('click', (e) => { 
                e.preventDefault(); if (page > 1) displayPage(page - 1); 
            });
            paginationControls.appendChild(prevLi);

            // NÃºt Sá»‘
            for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
                const li = document.createElement('li');
                li.className = i === page ? 'active' : '';
                li.innerHTML = `<a href="#">${i}</a>`;
                li.addEventListener('click', (e) => { 
                    e.preventDefault(); displayPage(i); 
                });
                paginationControls.appendChild(li);
            }

            const nextLi = document.createElement('li');
            nextLi.className = page === totalPages ? 'disabled' : '';
            nextLi.innerHTML = `<a href="#">Sau</a>`;
            nextLi.addEventListener('click', (e) => { 
                e.preventDefault(); if (page < totalPages) displayPage(page + 1); 
            });
            paginationControls.appendChild(nextLi);
        }

        if (tableRows.length > 0) displayPage(1);

        exportForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            const checkedBoxes = document.querySelectorAll('.item-checkbox:checked');
            if (checkedBoxes.length === 0) {
                alert('Vui lÃ²ng tÃ­ch chá»n Ã­t nháº¥t má»™t nguyÃªn liá»‡u Ä‘á»ƒ xuáº¥t kho!');
                e.preventDefault();
                return;
            }

            let valid = true;
            checkedBoxes.forEach(chk => {
                const row = chk.closest('tr');
                const qtyInput = row.querySelector('.quantity-input');
                const quantity = parseFloat(qtyInput.value);
                const maxStock = parseFloat(qtyInput.max);

                if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0 || quantity > maxStock) {
                    valid = false;
                    row.style.display = ''; 
                    qtyInput.reportValidity();
                }
            });

            if (!valid) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    const ingredients = <?php echo json_encode($ingredients); ?>;
    
    function addRow() {
        let optionsHtml = '<option value="">- Chá»n NVL -</option>';
        ingredients.forEach(ing => {
            optionsHtml += `<option value="${ing.id}" data-unit="${ing.unit}" data-price="${ing.cost_price}">#${ing.ingredient_code} - ${ing.name}</option>`;
        });

        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.innerHTML = `
            <td class="ps-4"><select class="form-select ingredient-select fw-semibold text-dark" name="ingredient_id[]" onchange="updateUnit(this)" required>${optionsHtml}</select></td>
            <td class="text-center unit-display fw-bold text-muted">-</td>
            <td><input type="number" step="0.01" min="0.01" class="form-control qty-input text-center fw-bold text-primary" name="quantity[]" value="1" oninput="calcRow(this)" onkeydown="return event.keyCode !== 69 && event.keyCode !== 189" required></td>
            <td><input type="number" step="1" min="0" class="form-control price-input text-end fw-bold" name="unit_cost[]" value="0" oninput="calcRow(this)" onkeydown="return event.keyCode !== 69 && event.keyCode !== 189" required></td>
            <td class="text-end row-total">0</td>
            <td class="text-center pe-4"><button type="button" class="btn-remove" onclick="removeRow(this)">Ã—</button></td>
        `;
        document.querySelector('#detailTable tbody').appendChild(tr);
        updateTotals();
    }

    function removeRow(btn) {
        const tbody = document.querySelector('#detailTable tbody');
        if (tbody.children.length > 1) {
            btn.closest('tr').remove();
            updateTotals();
        } else {
            alert("Phiáº¿u nháº­p pháº£i cÃ³ Ã­t nháº¥t 1 dÃ²ng nguyÃªn váº­t liá»‡u!");
        }
    }

    function updateUnit(selectElem) {
        const selectedOption = selectElem.options[selectElem.selectedIndex];
        const unit = selectedOption.getAttribute('data-unit') || '-';
        const price = selectedOption.getAttribute('data-price') || 0;
        
        const tr = selectElem.closest('tr');
        tr.querySelector('.unit-display').textContent = unit;
        
        const priceInput = tr.querySelector('.price-input');
        if (priceInput.value == 0 || priceInput.value === "") {
            priceInput.value = parseFloat(price).toFixed(0);
        }
        calcRow(selectElem);
    }

    function calcRow(elem) {
        const tr = elem.closest('tr');
        let qty = parseFloat(tr.querySelector('.qty-input').value);
        let price = parseFloat(tr.querySelector('.price-input').value);
        
        if(qty < 0) { tr.querySelector('.qty-input').value = 1; qty = 1; }
        if(price < 0) { tr.querySelector('.price-input').value = 0; price = 0; }
        
        qty = qty || 0; price = price || 0;
        const total = qty * price;
        tr.querySelector('.row-total').textContent = total.toLocaleString('vi-VN');
        updateTotals();
    }

    function updateTotals() {
        const tbody = document.querySelector('#detailTable tbody');
        document.getElementById('totalLines').textContent = tbody.children.length;
        
        let grandTotal = 0;
        document.querySelectorAll('.row-total').forEach(td => {
            let val = td.textContent.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/,/g, '');
            grandTotal += parseFloat(val) || 0;
        });
        document.getElementById('grandTotal').textContent = grandTotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN');
    }

    function validateForm() {
        const tbody = document.querySelector('#detailTable tbody');
        const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
        
        if(rows.length === 0) {
            alert("Vui lÃ²ng thÃªm Ã­t nháº¥t má»™t loáº¡i nguyÃªn liá»‡u Ä‘á»ƒ nháº­p kho!");
            return false;
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            const select = rows[i].querySelector('.ingredient-select');
            const qty = parseFloat(rows[i].querySelector('.qty-input').value);
            
            if (select.value === "") {
                alert(`DÃ²ng thá»© ${i+1} chÆ°a chá»n NguyÃªn váº­t liá»‡u. Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i!`);
                select.focus();
                return false;
            }
            if (isNaN(qty) || qty <= 0) {
                alert(`DÃ²ng thá»© ${i+1} cÃ³ sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ (pháº£i lá»›n hÆ¡n 0). Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i!`);
                rows[i].querySelector('.qty-input').focus();
                return false;
            }
        }

        const btn = document.getElementById('btnSubmit');
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = 'â³ ÄANG Xá»¬ LÃ...';
        
        return true;
    }
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const numberInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.number-format');
    numberInputs.forEach(function (input) {
        input.addEventListener('input', function () { this.value = this.value.replace(/\D/g, ''); });
        input.addEventListener('blur', function () {
            if (this.value !== '') {
                const number = Number(this.value);
                this.value = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(number);
            }
        });
        input.addEventListener('focus', function () { this.value = this.value.replace(/\D/g, ''); });
        if (input.form) {
            input.form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
                numberInputs.forEach(inp => { inp.value = inp.value.replace(/\D/g, ''); });
            });
        }
    });
});
</script>

<script>
function validateSearch(form) {
    const searchInput = form.querySelector('input[name="search"]');
    if(searchInput) {
        let val = searchInput.value.trim();
        val = val.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\sÃ€-á»¹-]/g, ""); 
        searchInput.value = val;
        if (val === "") { searchInput.removeAttribute("name"); }
    }
    const selects = form.querySelectorAll('select');
    selects.forEach(select => {
        if (select.value === "") select.removeAttribute("name");
    });
    
    return true;
}
</script>

<?php
class Database {
    private static $instance = null;
    private $conn;

    private $host = 'localhost';
    private $db_name = 'royaldine_5s';
    private $username = 'root';
    private $password = '';
    private static $overrideDbName = null;

    private function __construct() {
        $targetDb = self::$overrideDbName
            ?: (defined('ROYALDINE_DB_NAME') ? ROYALDINE_DB_NAME : (getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_NAME') ?: $this->db_name));
        $targetHost = getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_HOST') ?: $this->host;
        $targetUser = getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_USER') ?: $this->username;
        $targetPass = getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_PASS') !== false ? getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_PASS') : $this->password;

        try {
            $dsn = "mysql:host={$targetHost};dbname={$targetDb};charset=utf8mb4";
            $this->conn = new PDO($dsn, $targetUser, $targetPass, [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false
            ]);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            error_log("[DB Connection Error] " . $e->getMessage());
            die("Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i CSDL RoyalDine 5S.");
        }
    }

    public static function setDatabaseName(string $dbName): void {
        self::$overrideDbName = $dbName;
        self::$instance = null;
    }

    public static function getDatabaseName(): string {
        return self::$overrideDbName
            ?: (defined('ROYALDINE_DB_NAME') ? ROYALDINE_DB_NAME : (getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_NAME') ?: 'royaldine_5s'));
    }

    public static function resetConnection(): void {
        self::$instance = null;
    }

    public static function getConnection() {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new Database();
        }
        return self::$instance->conn;
    }
}

class Controller {
    protected $db;

    public function __construct() {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_start();
        }
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
        if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
            $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        }
    }

        }

        if ($useLayout) {
            require_once __DIR__ . "/../views/layouts/header.php";
            require_once $viewFile;
            require_once __DIR__ . "/../views/layouts/footer.php";
        } else {
            require_once $viewFile;
        }
    }

    protected function json($data, $statusCode = 200) {
        if (ob_get_length()) {
            ob_clean();
        }
        http_response_code($statusCode);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
        exit;
    }

    protected function requireRole($allowedRoles = [], bool $isApi = false) {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_start();
        }

        if (empty($_SESSION['user']['id'])) {
            if ($isApi) {
                $this->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'PhiÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t, vui lÃ²ng Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p láº¡i.'], 401);
            }
            header("Location: index.php?c=auth&a=login");
            exit;
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT u.is_active, r.role_code
            FROM users u
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
            WHERE u.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([(int)$_SESSION['user']['id']]);
        $liveUser = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$liveUser || (int)$liveUser['is_active'] !== 1) {
            unset($_SESSION['user']);
            if ($isApi) {
                $this->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'TÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a hoáº·c khÃ´ng cÃ²n tá»“n táº¡i.'], 403);
            }
            header("Location: index.php?c=auth&a=login");
            exit;
        }

        $_SESSION['user']['role_code'] = $liveUser['role_code'];
        $userRole = strtoupper($liveUser['role_code'] ?? '');
        if ($userRole === 'ADMIN' || $userRole === 'MANAGER') {
            return;
        }

        $expandedAllowed = array_map('strtoupper', $allowedRoles);
        if (in_array('WAITER', $expandedAllowed, true)) {
            $expandedAllowed[] = 'CASHIER';
            $expandedAllowed[] = 'SERVER';
        }
        if (in_array('CHEF', $expandedAllowed, true)) {
            $expandedAllowed[] = 'BAR';
        }

        if (!empty($expandedAllowed) && !in_array($userRole, $expandedAllowed, true)) {
            if ($isApi) {
                $this->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => "Vai trÃ² {$userRole} khÃ´ng cÃ³ quyá»n thá»±c hiá»‡n chá»©c nÄƒng nÃ y."], 403);
            }
            http_response_code(403);
            die("<h2>403 - Truy cáº­p bá»‹ tá»« chá»‘i!</h2><p>Vai trÃ² <b>" . htmlspecialchars($userRole) . "</b> khÃ´ng cÃ³ quyá»n thá»±c hiá»‡n chá»©c nÄƒng nÃ y.</p>");
        }
    }

    protected function writeAuditLog(string $actionType, string $moduleName, string $description, string $severity = 'INFO'): void {
        if (empty($_SESSION['user']['id'])) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            $ip = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '127.0.0.1';
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action_type, module_name, description, severity, ip_address)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ");
            $stmt->execute([(int)$_SESSION['user']['id'], $actionType, $moduleName, $description, $severity, $ip]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            error_log("[AuditLog] " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

    global $passed, $failed;

    public function dashboard() {
        $this->requireRole();

        $totalItems  = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu_items")->fetchColumn();
        $totalTables = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dining_tables")->fetchColumn();
        $totalUsers  = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_active = 1")->fetchColumn();
        $bomCount    = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT menu_item_id) FROM recipes_bom")->fetchColumn();

        $tableStats = ['Empty' => 0, 'Occupied' => 0, 'Reserved' => 0, 'Cleaning' => 0];
        $rows = $this->db->query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dining_tables GROUP BY status")->fetchAll();
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $st = $r['status'];
            if ($st === 'Occupied') $tableStats['Occupied'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
            elseif ($st === 'Reserved') $tableStats['Reserved'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
            elseif ($st === 'Cleaning') $tableStats['Cleaning'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
            else $tableStats['Empty'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
        }
        $occupancyRate = $totalTables > 0
            ? round((($tableStats['Occupied'] + $tableStats['Reserved']) / $totalTables) * 100, 1)
            : 0;

        $dailyLabels = [];
        $dailyRevenue = [];
        for ($i = 6; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $d = date('Y-m-d', strtotime("-$i days"));
            $dailyLabels[] = date('d/m', strtotime($d));
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE DATE(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at)) = ? AND status = 'Paid'");
            $stmt->execute([$d]);
            $dailyRevenue[] = (float)$stmt->fetchColumn();
        }
        $todayRevenue = end($dailyRevenue) ?: 0;
        $weekRevenue  = array_sum($dailyRevenue);

        $monthlyLabels = [];
        $monthlyRevenue = [];
        for ($m = 5; $m >= 0; $m--) {
            $ym = date('Y-m', strtotime("first day of -$m months"));
            $monthlyLabels[] = 'ThÃ¡ng ' . date('m', strtotime($ym . '-01'));
            $stmtM = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at), '%Y-%m') = ? AND status = 'Paid'");
            $stmtM->execute([$ym]);
            $monthlyRevenue[] = (float)$stmtM->fetchColumn();
        }

        $topDishes = $this->db->query("
            SELECT m.item_code, m.name, c.name AS category_name, m.price,
                   COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Paid' AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled' THEN od.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_qty,
                   COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Paid' AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled' THEN od.quantity * od.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_rev
            FROM menu_items m
            JOIN categories c ON m.category_id = c.id
            LEFT JOIN order_details od ON m.id = od.menu_item_id
            LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id
            GROUP BY m.id
            ORDER BY total_rev DESC, m.price DESC
            LIMIT 5
        ")->fetchAll();

        $lowStockItems = $this->db->query("
            SELECT * FROM ingredients
            ORDER BY (stock_quantity <= min_stock_level) DESC, stock_quantity ASC
            LIMIT 5
        ")->fetchAll();

        $recentLogs = $this->db->query("
            SELECT l.*, u.full_name, r.role_code
            FROM audit_logs l
            JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
            ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 5
        ")->fetchAll();

        $this->render('menu/dashboard', compact(
            'totalItems', 'totalTables', 'totalUsers', 'bomCount',
            'tableStats', 'occupancyRate',
            'dailyLabels', 'dailyRevenue', 'todayRevenue', 'weekRevenue',
            'monthlyLabels', 'monthlyRevenue',

        ));

    public function index() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'CHEF']);

        $catFilter = isset($_GET['cat_id']) ? (int)$_GET['cat_id'] : 0;
        $whereSql = $catFilter > 0 ? "WHERE m.category_id = $catFilter" : "";

        $items = $this->db->query("
            SELECT m.*, c.name AS category_name,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipes_bom b WHERE b.menu_item_id = m.id) AS bom_count,
            (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(i.name, ' (', b.quantity_required, ' ', i.unit, ')') SEPARATOR ' â€¢ ')
             FROM recipes_bom b JOIN ingredients i ON b.ingredient_id = i.id WHERE b.menu_item_id = m.id) AS bom_list,
            (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('[', im.modifier_group, '] ', im.modifier_name, IF(im.extra_price > 0, CONCAT(' (+', FORMAT(im.extra_price, 0), 'Ä‘)'), '')) SEPARATOR ' â€¢ ')
             FROM item_modifiers im WHERE im.menu_item_id = m.id) AS modifier_list
            FROM menu_items m 
            JOIN categories c ON m.category_id = c.id 
            $whereSql
            ORDER BY m.id DESC
        ")->fetchAll();

        $categories = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY id ASC")->fetchAll();
        $ingredients = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM ingredients ORDER BY name ASC")->fetchAll();

        $bomRaw = $this->db->query("
            SELECT b.menu_item_id, b.ingredient_id, b.quantity_required, i.name AS ingredient_name, i.unit
            FROM recipes_bom b
            JOIN ingredients i ON b.ingredient_id = i.id
            ORDER BY i.name ASC
        ")->fetchAll();
        $bomByItem = [];
        foreach ($bomRaw as $row) {
            $bomByItem[$row['menu_item_id']][] = $row;
        }

        $modRaw = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM item_modifiers ORDER BY modifier_group ASC, id ASC")->fetchAll();
        $modByItem = [];
        foreach ($modRaw as $row) {
            $modByItem[$row['menu_item_id']][] = $row;
        }

        $this->render('menu/index', compact('items', 'categories', 'ingredients', 'bomByItem', 'modByItem', 'catFilter'));
    }

    public function addBom() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'CHEF']);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $menuItemId = (int)$_POST['menu_item_id'];
            $ingredientId = (int)$_POST['ingredient_id'];
            $qty = (float)$_POST['quantity_required'];

            if ($menuItemId > 0 && $ingredientId > 0 && $qty > 0) {
                $check = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipes_bom WHERE menu_item_id = ? AND ingredient_id = ?");
                $check->execute([$menuItemId, $ingredientId]);
                if ($check->fetchColumn() > 0) {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE recipes_bom SET quantity_required = ? WHERE menu_item_id = ? AND ingredient_id = ?");
                    $stmt->execute([$qty, $menuItemId, $ingredientId]);
                } else {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO recipes_bom (menu_item_id, ingredient_id, quantity_required) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
                    $stmt->execute([$menuItemId, $ingredientId, $qty]);
                }
                $this->logAction('UPDATE_BOM', 'Äá»‹nh lÆ°á»£ng BOM', "Cáº­p nháº­t Ä‘á»‹nh lÆ°á»£ng nguyÃªn liá»‡u ID #$ingredientId (SL: $qty) cho mÃ³n ID #$menuItemId", 'INFO');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "ÄÃ£ cáº­p nháº­t cÃ´ng thá»©c Ä‘á»‹nh lÆ°á»£ng (BOM) thÃ nh cÃ´ng!";
            }
            header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=index&open_bom=$menuItemId");
            exit;
        }

    public function users() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);

        $users = $this->db->query("
            SELECT u.*, r.role_code, r.role_name 
            FROM users u 
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id 
            ORDER BY u.id ASC
        ")->fetchAll();

        $roles = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM roles ORDER BY id ASC")->fetchAll();
        $shifts = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM work_shifts ORDER BY start_time ASC")->fetchAll();

        $filterDate = $_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
        $stmtSched = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT s.*, u.full_name, u.username, r.role_code, w.shift_name, w.start_time, w.end_time, w.allowance
            FROM staff_schedules s
            JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
            JOIN work_shifts w ON s.shift_id = w.id
            WHERE s.work_date = ?
            ORDER BY w.start_time ASC, u.full_name ASC
        ");
        $stmtSched->execute([$filterDate]);
        $schedules = $stmtSched->fetchAll();

        $severityFilter = $_GET['severity'] ?? '';
        if ($severityFilter && in_array($severityFilter, ['INFO', 'WARNING', 'CRITICAL'], true)) {
            $stmtLog = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT l.*, u.full_name, u.username, r.role_code
                FROM audit_logs l
                JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
                JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
                WHERE l.severity = ?
                ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 30
            ");
            $stmtLog->execute([$severityFilter]);
            $auditLogs = $stmtLog->fetchAll();
        } else {
            $auditLogs = $this->db->query("
                SELECT l.*, u.full_name, u.username, r.role_code
                FROM audit_logs l
                JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
                JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
                ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 30
            ")->fetchAll();
        }

        $this->render('menu/users', compact('users', 'roles', 'shifts', 'schedules', 'auditLogs', 'filterDate', 'severityFilter'));
    }

    public function saveUser() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $id = !empty($_POST['user_id']) ? (int)$_POST['user_id'] : 0;
            $fullName = trim($_POST['full_name']);
            $username = trim($_POST['username']);
            $phone = trim($_POST['phone']);
            $roleId = (int)$_POST['role_id'];

            if ($id > 0) {
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE users SET full_name = ?, phone = ?, role_id = ? WHERE id = ?");
                $stmt->execute([$fullName, $phone, $roleId, $id]);
                $this->logAction('UPDATE_USER', 'Há»“ sÆ¡ nhÃ¢n viÃªn', "Cáº­p nháº­t thÃ´ng tin/vai trÃ² cho nhÃ¢n viÃªn: $fullName (ID: #$id)", 'WARNING');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "ÄÃ£ cáº­p nháº­t há»“ sÆ¡ nhÃ¢n viÃªn $fullName thÃ nh cÃ´ng!";
            } else {
                $password = !empty($_POST['password']) ? $_POST['password'] : '123456';
                $hash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT);
                try {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO users (role_id, username, password_hash, full_name, phone, is_active)
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)
                    ");
                    $stmt->execute([$roleId, $username, $hash, $fullName, $phone]);
                    $this->logAction('CREATE_USER', 'Há»“ sÆ¡ nhÃ¢n viÃªn', "Táº¡o má»›i tÃ i khoáº£n '$username' cho nhÃ¢n viÃªn $fullName", 'INFO');
                    $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "ÄÃ£ thÃªm nhÃ¢n viÃªn má»›i $fullName ($username) thÃ nh cÃ´ng!";
                } catch (PDOException $e) {
                    $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "Lá»—i: TÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p '$username' Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i trong há»‡ thá»‘ng!";
                }
            }
        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=staff");
        exit;
    }

    public function attendance() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);
        $id = (int)($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
        $type = $_GET['type'] ?? 'in';
        $date = $_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT s.*, u.full_name, w.shift_name, w.start_time 
            FROM staff_schedules s
            JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id
            JOIN work_shifts w ON s.shift_id = w.id
            WHERE s.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $sched = $stmt->fetch();

        if ($sched) {
            $now = date('H:i:s');
            if ($type === 'in') {
                $status = (strtotime($now) > strtotime($sched['start_time']) + 300) ? 'Late' : 'OnTime';
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE staff_schedules SET check_in = ?, attendance_status = ? WHERE id = ?")
                         ->execute([$now, $status, $id]);
                $statusLabel = ($status === 'Late') ? 'ÄI TRá»„' : 'ÄÃšNG GIá»œ';
                $sev = ($status === 'Late') ? 'WARNING' : 'INFO';
                $this->logAction('CHECK_IN', 'Cháº¥m cÃ´ng', "Cháº¥m cÃ´ng VÃ€O CA ($now - $statusLabel) cho {$sched['full_name']} ({$sched['shift_name']})", $sev);
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "ÄÃ£ cháº¥m cÃ´ng VÃ€O CA lÃºc $now cho {$sched['full_name']} ($statusLabel)!";
            } elseif ($type === 'out') {
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE staff_schedules SET check_out = ? WHERE id = ?")
                         ->execute([$now, $id]);
                $this->logAction('CHECK_OUT', 'Cháº¥m cÃ´ng', "Cháº¥m cÃ´ng TAN CA ($now) cho {$sched['full_name']} ({$sched['shift_name']})", 'INFO');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "ÄÃ£ ghi nháº­n giá» TAN CA lÃºc $now cho {$sched['full_name']}!";
            } elseif ($type === 'absent') {
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE staff_schedules SET attendance_status = 'Absent' WHERE id = ?")
                         ->execute([$id]);
                $this->logAction('MARK_ABSENT', 'Cháº¥m cÃ´ng', "Ghi nháº­n Váº®NG Máº¶T ca {$sched['shift_name']} Ä‘á»‘i vá»›i {$sched['full_name']}", 'CRITICAL');
                $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã¡nh dáº¥u Váº®NG Máº¶T Ä‘á»‘i vá»›i {$sched['full_name']}!";
            }
        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=shifts&date=$date");
        exit;
    }
}

SET NAMES utf8mb4;
DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS royaldine_5s;
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS royaldine_5s CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
USE royaldine_5s;

-- MAI TRÃ‚M: QUáº¢N TRá»Š Há»† THá»NG, NHÃ‚N Sá»°, THá»°C ÄÆ N & Äá»ŠNH LÆ¯á»¢NG BOM

CREATE TABLE roles (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    role_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    role_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE users (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    role_id INT NOT NULL,
    full_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE categories (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    course_type ENUM('Appetizer', 'Soup_Salad', 'Main_Course', 'Dessert', 'Beverage', 'Set_Menu') NOT NULL,
    display_order INT DEFAULT 1,
    is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE menu_items (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    category_id INT NOT NULL,
    item_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    unit VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'Pháº§n',
    price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    image_url VARCHAR(255),
    is_combo TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
    status ENUM('Available', 'OutOfStock', 'Discontinued') DEFAULT 'Available',
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE item_modifiers (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    modifier_group ENUM('Doneness', 'Sauce', 'Extra', 'Allergy_Note') NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    extra_price DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- =========================================================================
-- PHÃ‚N Há»† 4 (KIM HIá»€N - Danh má»¥c gá»‘c Ä‘á»ƒ ná»‘i vá»›i BOM cá»§a Mai TrÃ¢m)
-- =========================================================================

CREATE TABLE suppliers (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    contact_person VARCHAR(100),
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    address VARCHAR(255),
    debt_balance DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE ingredients (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    ingredient_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    unit VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    stock_quantity DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    min_stock_level DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    cost_price DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE recipes_bom (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    menu_item_id INT NOT NULL,
    ingredient_id INT NOT NULL,
    quantity_required DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    wastage_percent DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    FOREIGN KEY (menu_item_id) REFERENCES menu_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- KHÃNH VY: SÆ  Äá»’ BÃ€N, Äáº¶T BÃ€N VIP (BOOKING) & CRM

CREATE TABLE areas (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    surcharge_percent DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    description VARCHAR(255)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE dining_tables (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    area_id INT NOT NULL,
    table_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    capacity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 4,
    qr_token VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE,
    status ENUM('Available', 'Occupied', 'Reserved', 'Cleaning') DEFAULT 'Available',
    FOREIGN KEY (area_id) REFERENCES areas(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE customers (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email VARCHAR(100),
    tier ENUM('Standard', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Diamond') DEFAULT 'Standard',
    points INT DEFAULT 0,
    total_spent DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE promotions (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    discount_type ENUM('Percent', 'Fixed') NOT NULL,
    discount_value DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
    max_discount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT NULL,
    min_order_value DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    min_tier ENUM('Standard', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Diamond') DEFAULT 'Standard',
    start_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
    end_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
    is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE reservations (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    customer_id INT NOT NULL,
    table_id INT DEFAULT NULL,
    booking_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
    guest_count INT NOT NULL,
    deposit_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    special_request TEXT,
    status ENUM('Pending', 'Confirmed', 'CheckedIn', 'Cancelled') DEFAULT 'Pending',
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (table_id) REFERENCES dining_tables(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- TRÃ€ MY: BÃN HÃ€NG (POS/QR), ÄIá»€U PHá»I Báº¾P (KDS) & THANH TOÃN

CREATE TABLE orders (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    order_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    table_id INT NOT NULL,
    reservation_id INT DEFAULT NULL,
    customer_id INT DEFAULT NULL,
    waiter_id INT NOT NULL,
    guest_count INT DEFAULT 2,
    subtotal DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    area_surcharge_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    service_charge_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    discount_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    deposit_deducted DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    vat_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    total_amount DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    status ENUM('Open', 'PendingPayment', 'Paid', 'Cancelled') DEFAULT 'Open',
    opened_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    closed_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (table_id) REFERENCES dining_tables(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (waiter_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE order_details (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    menu_item_id INT NOT NULL,
    quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    unit_price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
    modifier_notes VARCHAR(255),
    course_priority INT DEFAULT 1,
    kds_status ENUM('Waiting', 'Cooking', 'Ready', 'Served', 'Cancelled') DEFAULT 'Waiting',
    cancel_reason VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
    ordered_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (menu_item_id) REFERENCES menu_items(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE payments (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    cashier_id INT NOT NULL,
    payment_method ENUM('Cash', 'VietQR', 'CreditCard') NOT NULL,
    amount DECIMAL(14,2) NOT NULL,
    transaction_ref VARCHAR(100),
    paid_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (cashier_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE order_logs (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    action_type ENUM('CreateOrder', 'TransferTable', 'MergeTable', 'CancelItem', 'Checkout') NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

-- KIM HIá»€N : NHáº¬P XUáº¤T KHO & BÃ€N GIAO CA THU NGÃ‚N

CREATE TABLE stock_receipts (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    receipt_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    supplier_id INT DEFAULT NULL,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    receipt_type ENUM('Import', 'Export_Sale', 'Export_Damage', 'Audit_Adjust') NOT NULL,
    total_amount DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    note TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE stock_receipt_details (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    stock_receipt_id INT NOT NULL,
    ingredient_id INT NOT NULL,
    quantity DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
    unit_cost DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (stock_receipt_id) REFERENCES stock_receipts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredients(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE cash_shifts (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    cashier_id INT NOT NULL,
    opened_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    closed_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
    opening_cash DECIMAL(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    total_cash_sales DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    total_cash_in DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    total_cash_out DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    expected_closing_cash DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    actual_closing_cash DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT NULL,
    discrepancy DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    note TEXT,
    status ENUM('Open', 'Closed') DEFAULT 'Open',
    FOREIGN KEY (cashier_id) REFERENCES users(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

function switchRevenueMode(mode) {
    const btnDaily = document.getElementById('btnRevDaily');
    const btnMonthly = document.getElementById('btnRevMonthly');
    const title = document.getElementById('revChartTitle');

    if (mode === 'monthly') {
        revenueChart.config.type = 'line';
        revenueChart.data.labels = monthlyLabels;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].data = monthlyRevenue;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].fill = true;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = 'rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25)';
        title.textContent = 'ðŸ“ˆ Biá»ƒu Äá»“ Doanh Thu 6 ThÃ¡ng Gáº§n Nháº¥t (VNÄ)';
        btnMonthly.className = 'btn btn-dark text-warning fw-bold';
        btnDaily.className = 'btn btn-outline-dark';
    } else {
        revenueChart.config.type = 'bar';
        revenueChart.data.labels = dailyLabels;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].data = dailyRevenue;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].fill = false;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = 'rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.75)';
        title.textContent = 'ðŸ“ˆ Biá»ƒu Äá»“ Doanh Thu 7 NgÃ y Gáº§n Nháº¥t (VNÄ)';
        btnDaily.className = 'btn btn-dark text-warning fw-bold';
        btnMonthly.className = 'btn btn-outline-dark';
    }
    revenueChart.update();
}

<?php
class Database {
    private static $instance = null;
    private $conn;

    private $host = 'localhost';
    private $db_name = 'royaldine_5s';
    private $username = 'root';
    private $password = '';

    private function __construct() {
        try {
            $dsn = "mysql:host={$this->host};dbname={$this->db_name};charset=utf8mb4";
            $this->conn = new PDO($dsn, $this->username, $this->password, [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false
            ]);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            die("Lỗi kết nối CSDL RoyalDine 5S: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public static function getConnection() {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new Database();
        }
        return self::$instance->conn;
    }

    public function manage()
    {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'HOSTESS', 'WAITER']);
        $model = new TableModel();
        $error = '';

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $action = $_POST['action'] ?? '';
            try {
                if ($action === 'area_add') {
                    $name = trim($_POST['name'] ?? '');
                    $surcharge = (float)($_POST['surcharge_percent'] ?? 0);
                    if ($name === '' || $surcharge < 0 || $surcharge > 100) {
                        throw new InvalidArgumentException('TÃªn khu vá»±c hoáº·c phá»¥ thu khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
                    }
                    $model->addArea($name, $surcharge);
                } elseif ($action === 'area_update') {
                    $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
                    $name = trim($_POST['name'] ?? '');
                    $surcharge = (float)($_POST['surcharge_percent'] ?? 0);
                    if ($id <= 0 || $name === '' || $surcharge < 0 || $surcharge > 100) {
                        throw new InvalidArgumentException('ThÃ´ng tin khu vá»±c khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
                    }
                    $model->updateArea($id, $name, $surcharge);
                } elseif ($action === 'area_delete') {
                    $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
                    if ($id <= 0) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Khu vá»±c khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
                    $model->deleteArea($id);
                } elseif ($action === 'add' || $action === 'update') {
                    $areaId = (int)($_POST['area_id'] ?? 0);
                    $name = trim($_POST['table_name'] ?? '');
                    $capacity = (int)($_POST['capacity'] ?? 0);
                    if ($areaId <= 0 || $name === '' || $capacity < 1 || $capacity > 100) {
                        throw new InvalidArgumentException('ThÃ´ng tin bÃ n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
                    }
                    if ($action === 'add') {
                        $model->addTable($areaId, $name, $capacity);
                    } else {
                        $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
                        if ($id <= 0 || !$model->findTable($id)) {
                            throw new InvalidArgumentException('BÃ n cáº§n sá»­a khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.');
                        }
                        $model->updateTable($id, $areaId, $name, $capacity);
                    }
                } elseif ($action === 'status') {
                    $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
                    $status = $_POST['status'] ?? '';

                        throw new InvalidArgumentException('BÃ n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.');

    public function customer(): void
    {
        $model = new ReservationModel();
        $bookingTime = trim($_POST['booking_time'] ?? $_GET['booking_time'] ?? '');
        $guestCount = (int)($_POST['guest_count'] ?? $_GET['guest_count'] ?? 1);
        $tables = [];
        $error = '';

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && ($_POST['action'] ?? '') === 'create') {
            $fullName = trim($_POST['full_name'] ?? '');
            $phone = trim($_POST['phone'] ?? '');
            $email = trim($_POST['email'] ?? '');
            $tableId = (int)($_POST['table_id'] ?? 0);
            $specialRequest = trim($_POST['special_request'] ?? '');
            $date = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d\TH:i', $bookingTime);

            if ($fullName === '') $error = 'Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p há» vÃ  tÃªn.';
            elseif (!preg_match('/^[0-9]{9,11}$/', $phone)) $error = 'Sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.';
            elseif ($email !== '' && !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) $error = 'Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.';
            elseif (!$date || $date <= new DateTime()) $error = 'Thá»i gian Ä‘áº·t bÃ n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.';
            elseif ($guestCount < 1 || $guestCount > 100) $error = 'Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng khÃ¡ch khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.';
            elseif ($tableId <= 0) $error = 'Vui lÃ²ng chá»n bÃ n.';
            else {
                $table = $model->findTable($tableId);
                if (!$table || !in_array($table['status'], ['Available', 'Reserved'], true)) {
                    $error = 'BÃ n khÃ´ng cÃ²n kháº£ dá»¥ng.';
                } elseif ((int)$table['capacity'] < $guestCount) {
                    $error = 'BÃ n khÃ´ng Ä‘á»§ sá»©c chá»©a sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng khÃ¡ch.';
                } elseif (!$model->isTableAvailable($tableId, $date->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'))) {
                    $error = 'BÃ n Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ ngÆ°á»i Ä‘áº·t trong thá»i gian nÃ y.';
                } else {
                    $depositAmount = match (true) {
                        $guestCount <= 4  => 50000,
                        $guestCount <= 8  => 100000,
                        $guestCount <= 12 => 150000,
                        $guestCount <= 20 => 200000,
                        default           => 300000
                    };
                    $bookingCode = $model->createReservation([
                        'full_name' => $fullName,
                        'phone' => $phone,
                        'email' => $email,
                        'table_id' => $tableId,
                        'booking_time' => $date->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                        'guest_count' => $guestCount,
                        'deposit_amount' => $depositAmount,
                        'special_request' => $specialRequest
                    ]);
                    header('Location: index.php?c=booking&a=customer&created=' . urlencode($bookingCode) . '&guest_count=' . $guestCount);
                    exit;
                }
            }
        }

        if ($bookingTime !== '') {
            $date = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d\TH:i', $bookingTime);
            if ($date && $date > new DateTime() && $guestCount >= 1 && $guestCount <= 100) {
                $tables = $model->getAvailableTablesForBooking($date->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'), $guestCount);
            } elseif ($error === '') {
                $error = 'Vui lÃ²ng chá»n thá»i gian Ä‘áº·t bÃ n há»£p lá»‡.';
            }
        }

        $success = trim($_GET['created'] ?? '');
        $depositAmount = match (true) {
            $guestCount <= 4  => 50000,
            $guestCount <= 8  => 100000,
            $guestCount <= 12 => 150000,
            $guestCount <= 20 => 200000,
            default           => 300000
        };

        $this->render('booking/customer', compact('tables', 'bookingTime', 'guestCount', 'error', 'success', 'depositAmount'));
    }

<?php
class MenuController extends Controller {

    private function logAction($actionType, $moduleName, $description, $severity = 'INFO') {
        $this->writeAuditLog($actionType, $moduleName, $description, $severity);
    }

    public function dashboard() {
        $this->requireRole();

        $selectedDate = $_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
        if (!preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $selectedDate) || strtotime($selectedDate) === false) {
            $selectedDate = date('Y-m-d');
        }
        $prevDate = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($selectedDate . ' -1 day'));

        // 1. Chỉ số cơ sở dữ liệu thực tế
        $totalItems  = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu_items")->fetchColumn();
        $totalTables = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dining_tables")->fetchColumn();
        $totalUsers  = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_active = 1")->fetchColumn();
        $bomCount    = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT menu_item_id) FROM recipes_bom")->fetchColumn();

        // 2. Tình trạng bàn thực tế
        $tableStats = ['Empty' => 0, 'Occupied' => 0, 'Reserved' => 0, 'Cleaning' => 0];
        $rows = $this->db->query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dining_tables GROUP BY status")->fetchAll();
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $st = $r['status'];
            if ($st === 'Occupied') $tableStats['Occupied'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
            elseif ($st === 'Reserved') $tableStats['Reserved'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
            elseif ($st === 'Cleaning') $tableStats['Cleaning'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
            else $tableStats['Empty'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
        }
        $occupancyRate = $totalTables > 0
            ? round((($tableStats['Occupied'] + $tableStats['Reserved']) / $totalTables) * 100, 1)
            : 0;

        // 3. Đơn hàng và Đặt bàn theo ngày đang chọn
        $stmtOrdersDate = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Paid'), 0) AS paid_orders,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Open'), 0) AS open_orders,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Paid' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_revenue
            FROM orders
            WHERE DATE(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at)) = ?
        ");
        $stmtOrdersDate->execute([$selectedDate]);
        $orderDaySummary = $stmtOrdersDate->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $todayOrdersCount     = (int)($orderDaySummary['total_orders'] ?? 0);
        $todayPaidOrdersCount = (int)($orderDaySummary['paid_orders'] ?? 0);
        $openOrdersCount      = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Open'")->fetchColumn();

        $stmtPrevRev = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0)
            FROM orders
            WHERE DATE(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at)) = ? AND status = 'Paid'
        ");
        $stmtPrevRev->execute([$prevDate]);
        $yesterdayRevenue = (float)$stmtPrevRev->fetchColumn();

        $stmtBookingsDate = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_bookings,
                COALESCE(SUM(status IN ('Pending', 'Confirmed')), 0) AS upcoming_bookings,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'CheckedIn'), 0) AS checkedin_bookings
            FROM reservations
            WHERE DATE(booking_time) = ?
        ");
        $stmtBookingsDate->execute([$selectedDate]);
        $bookingDaySummary = $stmtBookingsDate->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $todayBookingsCount    = (int)($bookingDaySummary['total_bookings'] ?? 0);
        $upcomingBookingsCount = (int)($bookingDaySummary['upcoming_bookings'] ?? 0);

        // 4. Chuỗi doanh thu & số đơn 7 ngày tính đến ngày đang chọn
        $dailyLabels  = [];
        $dailyRevenue = [];
        $dailyOrders  = [];
        for ($i = 6; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $d = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($selectedDate . " -$i days"));
            $dailyLabels[] = date('d/m', strtotime($d));

            $stmtD = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Paid' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rev,
                    COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Paid'), 0) AS cnt
                FROM orders
                WHERE DATE(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at)) = ?
            ");
            $stmtD->execute([$d]);
            $rowD = $stmtD->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            $dailyRevenue[] = (float)($rowD['rev'] ?? 0);
            $dailyOrders[]  = (int)($rowD['cnt'] ?? 0);
        }
        $todayRevenue = end($dailyRevenue) ?: 0;
        $weekRevenue  = array_sum($dailyRevenue);
        $weekPaidOrders = array_sum($dailyOrders);
        $avgOrderValue = $todayPaidOrdersCount > 0
            ? round($todayRevenue / $todayPaidOrdersCount)
            : ($weekPaidOrders > 0 ? round($weekRevenue / $weekPaidOrders) : 0);

        // 5. Doanh thu 6 tháng gần nhất
        $monthlyLabels  = [];
        $monthlyRevenue = [];
        for ($m = 5; $m >= 0; $m--) {
            $ym = date('Y-m', strtotime(date('Y-m-01', strtotime($selectedDate)) . " -$m months"));
            $monthlyLabels[] = 'Tháng ' . date('m/Y', strtotime($ym . '-01'));
            $stmtM = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0)
                FROM orders
                WHERE DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at), '%Y-%m') = ? AND status = 'Paid'
            ");
            $stmtM->execute([$ym]);
            $monthlyRevenue[] = (float)$stmtM->fetchColumn();
        }

        // 6. Tỷ trọng phương thức thanh toán thực tế
        $paymentBreakdown = $this->db->query("
            SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS tx_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount
            FROM payments
            GROUP BY payment_method
            ORDER BY total_amount DESC
        ")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        // 7. Top 5 món ăn theo doanh thu thực tế
        $topDishes = $this->db->query("
            SELECT m.item_code, m.name, m.unit, c.name AS category_name, m.price,
                   COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Paid' AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled' THEN od.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_qty,
                   COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Paid' AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled' THEN od.quantity * od.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_rev
            FROM menu_items m
            JOIN categories c ON m.category_id = c.id
            LEFT JOIN order_details od ON m.id = od.menu_item_id
            LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id
            GROUP BY m.id
            ORDER BY total_rev DESC, m.price DESC
            LIMIT 5
        ")->fetchAll();

        // 8. Cảnh báo vận hành thực tế
        $lowStockItems = $this->db->query("
            SELECT * FROM ingredients
            WHERE stock_quantity <= min_stock_level
            ORDER BY (stock_quantity - min_stock_level) ASC
            LIMIT 6
        ")->fetchAll();

        $pendingKdsCount = (int)$this->db->query("
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM order_details od
            JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id
            WHERE o.status = 'Open' AND od.kds_status IN ('Waiting', 'Cooking')
        ")->fetchColumn();

        $openShift = $this->db->query("
            SELECT cs.*, u.full_name AS cashier_name
            FROM cash_shifts cs
            LEFT JOIN users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id
            WHERE cs.status = 'Open'
            ORDER BY cs.id DESC LIMIT 1
        ")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        // 9. Hoạt động gần đây
        $recentLogs = $this->db->query("
            SELECT l.*, u.full_name, r.role_code
            FROM audit_logs l
            JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
            ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 6
        ")->fetchAll();

        $this->render('menu/dashboard', compact(
            'selectedDate', 'prevDate', 'totalItems', 'totalTables', 'totalUsers', 'bomCount',
            'tableStats', 'occupancyRate',
            'todayOrdersCount', 'todayPaidOrdersCount', 'openOrdersCount',
            'todayBookingsCount', 'upcomingBookingsCount',
            'dailyLabels', 'dailyRevenue', 'dailyOrders', 'todayRevenue', 'yesterdayRevenue', 'weekRevenue', 'avgOrderValue',
            'monthlyLabels', 'monthlyRevenue',
            'paymentBreakdown', 'topDishes', 'lowStockItems', 'pendingKdsCount', 'openShift', 'recentLogs'
        ));
    }

    public function index() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'CHEF']);

        $catFilter = isset($_GET['cat_id']) ? (int)$_GET['cat_id'] : 0;
        $whereSql = $catFilter > 0 ? "WHERE m.category_id = $catFilter" : "";

        $items = $this->db->query("
            SELECT m.*, c.name AS category_name,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipes_bom b WHERE b.menu_item_id = m.id) AS bom_count,
            (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(i.name, ' (', b.quantity_required, ' ', i.unit, ')') SEPARATOR ' • ')
             FROM recipes_bom b JOIN ingredients i ON b.ingredient_id = i.id WHERE b.menu_item_id = m.id) AS bom_list,
            (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('[', im.modifier_group, '] ', im.modifier_name, IF(im.extra_price > 0, CONCAT(' (+', FORMAT(im.extra_price, 0), 'đ)'), '')) SEPARATOR ' • ')
             FROM item_modifiers im WHERE im.menu_item_id = m.id) AS modifier_list
            FROM menu_items m 
            JOIN categories c ON m.category_id = c.id 
            $whereSql
            ORDER BY m.id DESC
        ")->fetchAll();

        $categories = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY id ASC")->fetchAll();
        $ingredients = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM ingredients ORDER BY name ASC")->fetchAll();

        $bomRaw = $this->db->query("
            SELECT b.menu_item_id, b.ingredient_id, b.quantity_required, i.name AS ingredient_name, i.unit
            FROM recipes_bom b
            JOIN ingredients i ON b.ingredient_id = i.id
            ORDER BY i.name ASC
        ")->fetchAll();
        $bomByItem = [];
        foreach ($bomRaw as $row) {
            $bomByItem[$row['menu_item_id']][] = $row;
        }

        $modRaw = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM item_modifiers ORDER BY modifier_group ASC, id ASC")->fetchAll();
        $modByItem = [];
        foreach ($modRaw as $row) {
            $modByItem[$row['menu_item_id']][] = $row;
        }

        $this->render('menu/index', compact('items', 'categories', 'ingredients', 'bomByItem', 'modByItem', 'catFilter'));
    }

    public function saveCategory() {

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && !empty($_POST['category_name'])) {
            $catName = trim($_POST['category_name']);
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO categories (name) VALUES (?)");

            $this->logAction('CREATE_CATEGORY', 'Thực đơn & BOM', "Thêm nhóm thực đơn mới: $catName", 'INFO');
            $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã thêm nhóm thực đơn '$catName' thành công!";
        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=index");
        exit;
    }

    public function saveMenuItem() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'CHEF']);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $id = !empty($_POST['item_id']) ? (int)$_POST['item_id'] : 0;
            $categoryId = (int)$_POST['category_id'];
            $itemCode = trim($_POST['item_code']);
            $name = trim($_POST['name']);
            $unit = trim($_POST['unit']);
            $price = (float)$_POST['price'];
            $status = $_POST['status'] ?? 'Available';

            if ($id > 0) {
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                    UPDATE menu_items 
                    SET category_id = ?, item_code = ?, name = ?, unit = ?, price = ?, status = ?
                    WHERE id = ?
                ");
                $stmt->execute([$categoryId, $itemCode, $name, $unit, $price, $status, $id]);
                $this->logAction('UPDATE_MENU', 'Thực đơn & BOM', "Cập nhật món '$name' ($itemCode) - Giá mới: " . number_format($price) . "đ", 'WARNING');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã cập nhật món '$name' thành công!";
            } else {
                try {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO menu_items (category_id, item_code, name, unit, price, status) 
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    ");
                    $stmt->execute([$categoryId, $itemCode, $name, $unit, $price, $status]);
                    $this->logAction('CREATE_MENU', 'Thực đơn & BOM', "Thêm món mới '$name' ($itemCode) - Giá: " . number_format($price) . "đ", 'INFO');
                    $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã thêm món '$name' vào thực đơn!";
                } catch (PDOException $e) {
                    $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "Lỗi: Mã món '$itemCode' đã tồn tại!";
                }
            }
        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=index");
        exit;
    }

    public function toggleMenuStatus() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'CHEF']);
        $id = (int)($_GET['id'] ?? 0);

        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $item = $stmt->fetch();

            $newStatus = ($item['status'] === 'Available') ? 'Unavailable' : 'Available';

            $label = ($newStatus === 'Available') ? 'MỞ BÁN LẠI' : 'BÁO TẠM HẾT MÓN';

        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=index");
        exit;
    }

    public function addBom() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'CHEF']);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $menuItemId = (int)$_POST['menu_item_id'];
            $ingredientId = (int)$_POST['ingredient_id'];
            $qty = (float)$_POST['quantity_required'];

            if ($menuItemId > 0 && $ingredientId > 0 && $qty > 0) {
                $check = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipes_bom WHERE menu_item_id = ? AND ingredient_id = ?");
                $check->execute([$menuItemId, $ingredientId]);
                if ($check->fetchColumn() > 0) {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE recipes_bom SET quantity_required = ? WHERE menu_item_id = ? AND ingredient_id = ?");
                    $stmt->execute([$qty, $menuItemId, $ingredientId]);
                } else {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO recipes_bom (menu_item_id, ingredient_id, quantity_required) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
                    $stmt->execute([$menuItemId, $ingredientId, $qty]);
                }
                $this->logAction('UPDATE_BOM', 'Định lượng BOM', "Cập nhật định lượng nguyên liệu ID #$ingredientId (SL: $qty) cho món ID #$menuItemId", 'INFO');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã cập nhật công thức định lượng (BOM) thành công!";

            exit;
        }

    public function users() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);

        $users = $this->db->query("
            SELECT u.*, r.role_code, r.role_name 
            FROM users u 
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id 
            ORDER BY u.id ASC
        ")->fetchAll();

        $roles = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM roles ORDER BY id ASC")->fetchAll();
        $shifts = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM work_shifts ORDER BY start_time ASC")->fetchAll();

        $filterDate = $_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
        $stmtSched = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT s.*, u.full_name, u.username, r.role_code, w.shift_name, w.start_time, w.end_time, w.allowance
            FROM staff_schedules s
            JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
            JOIN work_shifts w ON s.shift_id = w.id
            WHERE s.work_date = ?
            ORDER BY w.start_time ASC, u.full_name ASC
        ");
        $stmtSched->execute([$filterDate]);
        $schedules = $stmtSched->fetchAll();

        $severityFilter = $_GET['severity'] ?? '';
        if ($severityFilter && in_array($severityFilter, ['INFO', 'WARNING', 'CRITICAL'], true)) {
            $stmtLog = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT l.*, u.full_name, u.username, r.role_code
                FROM audit_logs l
                JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
                JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
                WHERE l.severity = ?
                ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 30
            ");
            $stmtLog->execute([$severityFilter]);
            $auditLogs = $stmtLog->fetchAll();
        } else {
            $auditLogs = $this->db->query("
                SELECT l.*, u.full_name, u.username, r.role_code
                FROM audit_logs l
                JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
                JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
                ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 30
            ")->fetchAll();
        }

        $this->render('menu/users', compact('users', 'roles', 'shifts', 'schedules', 'auditLogs', 'filterDate', 'severityFilter'));
    }

    public function saveUser() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $id = !empty($_POST['user_id']) ? (int)$_POST['user_id'] : 0;
            $fullName = trim($_POST['full_name']);
            $username = trim($_POST['username']);
            $phone = trim($_POST['phone']);
            $roleId = (int)$_POST['role_id'];

            if ($id > 0) {
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE users SET full_name = ?, phone = ?, role_id = ? WHERE id = ?");
                $stmt->execute([$fullName, $phone, $roleId, $id]);
                $this->logAction('UPDATE_USER', 'Hồ sơ nhân viên', "Cập nhật thông tin/vai trò cho nhân viên: $fullName (ID: #$id)", 'WARNING');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã cập nhật hồ sơ nhân viên $fullName thành công!";
            } else {
                $password = !empty($_POST['password']) ? $_POST['password'] : '123456';
                $hash = password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT);
                try {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO users (role_id, username, password_hash, full_name, phone, is_active)
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)
                    ");
                    $stmt->execute([$roleId, $username, $hash, $fullName, $phone]);
                    $this->logAction('CREATE_USER', 'Hồ sơ nhân viên', "Tạo mới tài khoản '$username' cho nhân viên $fullName", 'INFO');
                    $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã thêm nhân viên mới $fullName ($username) thành công!";
                } catch (PDOException $e) {
                    $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "Lỗi: Tên đăng nhập '$username' đã tồn tại trong hệ thống!";
                }
            }
        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=staff");
        exit;
    }

    public function toggleUserStatus() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);
        $id = (int)($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
        if ($id === (int)$_SESSION['user']['id']) {
            $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "Không thể tự khóa tài khoản Quản trị viên đang đăng nhập!";
            header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=staff");
            exit;
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT full_name, username, is_active FROM users WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $u = $stmt->fetch();
        if ($u) {
            $newStatus = $u['is_active'] ? 0 : 1;
            $this->db->prepare("UPDATE users SET is_active = ? WHERE id = ?")->execute([$newStatus, $id]);
            $statusText = $newStatus ? "MỞ KHÓA" : "KHÓA TRUY CẬP";
            $severity = $newStatus ? 'WARNING' : 'CRITICAL';
            $this->logAction('TOGGLE_STATUS', 'Bảo mật tài khoản', "$statusText tài khoản '{$u['username']}' ({$u['full_name']})", $severity);
            $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã $statusText tài khoản {$u['full_name']}!";
        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=staff");
        exit;
    }

            $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã đặt lại mật khẩu của {$u['full_name']} về '123456'!";

    }

    public function assignShift() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $userId = (int)$_POST['user_id'];
            $shiftId = (int)$_POST['shift_id'];
            $workDate = $_POST['work_date'];
            $note = trim($_POST['note'] ?? '');

            try {
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO staff_schedules (user_id, shift_id, work_date, attendance_status, note)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'Scheduled', ?)
                ");
                $stmt->execute([$userId, $shiftId, $workDate, $note]);
                $this->logAction('ASSIGN_SHIFT', 'Phân ca làm việc', "Phân ca ID #$shiftId ngày $workDate cho nhân viên ID #$userId", 'INFO');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã phân ca làm việc ngày $workDate thành công!";
            } catch (PDOException $e) {
                $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "Nhân viên này đã được xếp vào ca làm việc này trong ngày $workDate!";
            }
            header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=shifts&date=$workDate");
            exit;
        }
    }

    public function attendance() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);
        $id = (int)($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
        $type = $_GET['type'] ?? 'in';
        $date = $_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT s.*, u.full_name, w.shift_name, w.start_time 
            FROM staff_schedules s
            JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id
            JOIN work_shifts w ON s.shift_id = w.id
            WHERE s.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $sched = $stmt->fetch();

        if ($sched) {
            $now = date('H:i:s');
            if ($type === 'in') {
                $status = (strtotime($now) > strtotime($sched['start_time']) + 300) ? 'Late' : 'OnTime';
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE staff_schedules SET check_in = ?, attendance_status = ? WHERE id = ?")
                         ->execute([$now, $status, $id]);
                $statusLabel = ($status === 'Late') ? 'ĐI TRỄ' : 'ĐÚNG GIỜ';
                $sev = ($status === 'Late') ? 'WARNING' : 'INFO';
                $this->logAction('CHECK_IN', 'Chấm công', "Chấm công VÀO CA ($now - $statusLabel) cho {$sched['full_name']} ({$sched['shift_name']})", $sev);
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã chấm công VÀO CA lúc $now cho {$sched['full_name']} ($statusLabel)!";
            } elseif ($type === 'out') {
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE staff_schedules SET check_out = ? WHERE id = ?")
                         ->execute([$now, $id]);
                $this->logAction('CHECK_OUT', 'Chấm công', "Chấm công TAN CA ($now) cho {$sched['full_name']} ({$sched['shift_name']})", 'INFO');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "Đã ghi nhận giờ TAN CA lúc $now cho {$sched['full_name']}!";
            } elseif ($type === 'absent') {
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE staff_schedules SET attendance_status = 'Absent' WHERE id = ?")
                         ->execute([$id]);
                $this->logAction('MARK_ABSENT', 'Chấm công', "Ghi nhận VẮNG MẶT ca {$sched['shift_name']} đối với {$sched['full_name']}", 'CRITICAL');
                $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "Đã đánh dấu VẮNG MẶT đối với {$sched['full_name']}!";
            }
        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=shifts&date=$date");
        exit;
    }
}
