    public function deductStockByOrder($order_id, $user_id = 2) {
        $dbConn = $this->conn ?? Database::getConnection();
        try {
            $dbConn->beginTransaction();

            $note = "Xuáº¥t kho tá»± Ä‘á»™ng cho hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n bÃ¡n hÃ ng #" . (int)$order_id;
            $chk = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT id, receipt_code FROM stock_receipts WHERE receipt_type = 'Export_Sale' AND note = :note LIMIT 1");
            $chk->execute([':note' => $note]);
            $existing = $chk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if ($existing) {
                $dbConn->rollBack();
                return ['success' => true, 'receipt_code' => $existing['receipt_code'], 'warnings' => []];
            }

            $stmtOrder = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT menu_item_id, quantity FROM order_details WHERE order_id = :order_id AND kds_status <> 'Cancelled'");
            $stmtOrder->execute([':order_id' => $order_id]);
            $orderDetails = $stmtOrder->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (empty($orderDetails)) {
                $dbConn->rollBack();
                return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'ÄÆ¡n hÃ ng nÃ y trá»‘ng hoáº·c khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.'];
            }

            $ingredientsToDeduct = [];
            $stmtBom = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT ingredient_id, quantity_required, COALESCE(wastage_percent, 0) AS wastage_percent FROM recipes_bom WHERE menu_item_id = :menu_item_id");

            foreach ($orderDetails as $item) {
                $stmtBom->execute([':menu_item_id' => $item['menu_item_id']]);
                $boms = $stmtBom->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                foreach ($boms as $bom) {
                    $ing_id = (int)$bom['ingredient_id'];
                    $wastageFactor = 1 + ((float)$bom['wastage_percent'] / 100.0);
                    $total_req = round((float)$bom['quantity_required'] * (int)$item['quantity'] * $wastageFactor, 2);
                    $ingredientsToDeduct[$ing_id] = ($ingredientsToDeduct[$ing_id] ?? 0) + $total_req;
                }
            }

            if (empty($ingredientsToDeduct)) {
                $dbConn->rollBack();
                return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'CÃ¡c mÃ³n trong Ä‘Æ¡n khÃ´ng cáº§n trá»« Ä‘á»‹nh lÆ°á»£ng nguyÃªn liá»‡u.'];
            }

            $receipt_code = 'VX' . date('ymdHis') . rand(10, 99);
            $stmtReceipt = $dbConn->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_receipts (receipt_code, user_id, receipt_type, total_amount, note, created_at) VALUES (:code, :user_id, 'Export_Sale', 0, :note, NOW())");
            $stmtReceipt->execute([':code' => $receipt_code, ':user_id' => $user_id, ':note' => $note]);
            $receipt_id = $dbConn->lastInsertId();

            $stmtCheckAlert = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT name, stock_quantity, min_stock_level, unit, cost_price FROM ingredients WHERE id = :ingredient_id FOR UPDATE");
            $stmtInsertDetail = $dbConn->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_receipt_details (stock_receipt_id, ingredient_id, quantity, unit_cost) VALUES (:receipt_id, :ingredient_id, :quantity, :unit_cost)");
            $stmtUpdateStock = $dbConn->prepare("UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = GREATEST(0, stock_quantity - :deduct_qty) WHERE id = :ingredient_id");

            $warnings = [];
            $totalCogs = 0;

            foreach ($ingredientsToDeduct as $ing_id => $deduct_qty) {
                $stmtCheckAlert->execute([':ingredient_id' => $ing_id]);
                $ingData = $stmtCheckAlert->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$ingData) continue;

                $unitCost = (float)$ingData['cost_price'];
                $totalCogs += ($deduct_qty * $unitCost);

                $stmtInsertDetail->execute([
                    ':receipt_id'    => $receipt_id,
                    ':ingredient_id' => $ing_id,
                    ':quantity'      => $deduct_qty,
                    ':unit_cost'     => $unitCost
                ]);

                $stmtUpdateStock->execute([
                    ':deduct_qty'    => $deduct_qty,
                    ':ingredient_id' => $ing_id
                ]);

                $remaining = max(0, (float)$ingData['stock_quantity'] - $deduct_qty);
                if ($remaining <= (float)$ingData['min_stock_level']) {
                    $warnings[] = "âš  NguyÃªn liá»‡u [{$ingData['name']}] sáº¯p háº¿t! (Chá»‰ cÃ²n: {$remaining} {$ingData['unit']})";
                }
            }

            $dbConn->prepare("UPDATE stock_receipts SET total_amount = ? WHERE id = ?")->execute([$totalCogs, $receipt_id]);
            $dbConn->commit();
            return ['success' => true, 'receipt_code' => $receipt_code, 'warnings' => $warnings];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($dbConn->inTransaction()) $dbConn->rollBack();
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Lá»—i há»‡ thá»‘ng khi trá»« kho: ' . $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }

    public function getInventoryAndProfitReport($startDate, $endDate) {
        $dbConn = $this->conn ?? Database::getConnection();
        $start = !empty($startDate) ? date('Y-m-d 00:00:00', strtotime($startDate)) : '2020-01-01 00:00:00';
        $end   = !empty($endDate) ? date('Y-m-d 23:59:59', strtotime($endDate)) : '2030-12-31 23:59:59';

        $sqlXNT = "SELECT 
                    i.id, i.name, i.unit, i.cost_price,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.receipt_type = 'Import' AND sr.created_at BETWEEN :start1 AND :end1 THEN srd.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_imported,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.receipt_type LIKE 'Export%' AND sr.created_at BETWEEN :start2 AND :end2 THEN srd.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_exported
                   FROM ingredients i
                   LEFT JOIN stock_receipt_details srd ON i.id = srd.ingredient_id
                   LEFT JOIN stock_receipts sr ON srd.stock_receipt_id = sr.id
                   GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.unit, i.cost_price";
        $stmt = $dbConn->prepare($sqlXNT);
        $stmt->execute([':start1' => $start, ':end1' => $end, ':start2' => $start, ':end2' => $end]);
        $reportData = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $totalCostOfGoodsSold = 0;
        foreach ($reportData as $row) {
            $totalCostOfGoodsSold += ((float)$row['total_exported'] * (float)$row['cost_price']);
        }

        $stmtRev = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE paid_at BETWEEN :start AND :end");
        $stmtRev->execute([':start' => $start, ':end' => $end]);
        $totalRevenue = (float)$stmtRev->fetchColumn();

        $grossProfit = $totalRevenue - $totalCostOfGoodsSold;
        $foodCostPercentage = ($totalRevenue > 0) ? ($totalCostOfGoodsSold / $totalRevenue) * 100 : 0;

        return [
            'items' => $reportData,
            'summary' => [
                'total_revenue'        => $totalRevenue,
                'total_cogs'           => $totalCostOfGoodsSold,
                'gross_profit'         => $grossProfit,
                'food_cost_percentage' => round($foodCostPercentage, 2)
            ]
        ];
    }

    public function deleteReceiptWithRevert($receiptId, $receiptType) {
        try {
            $this->conn->beginTransaction();
            $receipt = $this->getReceiptById($receiptId);
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT ingredient_id, quantity FROM stock_receipt_details WHERE stock_receipt_id = :id");
            $stmt->execute([':id' => $receiptId]);
            $details = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            $sqlUpdateStock = "";
            if ($receiptType === 'Import') {
                $sqlUpdateStock = "UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = GREATEST(0, stock_quantity - :qty) WHERE id = :ing_id";
            } elseif (strpos($receiptType, 'Export') === 0) {
                $sqlUpdateStock = "UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + :qty WHERE id = :ing_id";
            }

            if (!empty($sqlUpdateStock)) {
                $stmtUpdate = $this->conn->prepare($sqlUpdateStock);
                foreach ($details as $detail) {
                    $stmtUpdate->execute([':qty' => $detail['quantity'], ':ing_id' => $detail['ingredient_id']]);
                }
            }

            if ($receiptType === 'Import' && !empty($receipt['supplier_id']) && (float)$receipt['total_amount'] > 0) {
                $this->conn->prepare("UPDATE suppliers SET debt_balance = GREATEST(0, debt_balance - ?) WHERE id = ?")
                    ->execute([(float)$receipt['total_amount'], (int)$receipt['supplier_id']]);
            }

            $this->conn->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_receipt_details WHERE stock_receipt_id = :id")->execute([':id' => $receiptId]);
            $this->conn->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_receipts WHERE id = :id")->execute([':id' => $receiptId]);
            $this->conn->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->conn->inTransaction()) $this->conn->rollBack();
            error_log("Lá»—i Há»§y Phiáº¿u: " . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/Database.php';

class TableModel
{
    private PDO $db;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
    }

    public function getAllTables(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                a.id AS area_id,
                a.name AS area_name,
                a.surcharge_percent,
                t.id AS table_id,
                t.table_name,
                t.capacity,
                t.status,
                o.id AS active_order_id,
                o.order_code AS active_order_code,
                o.guest_count AS active_guests,
                o.subtotal AS active_subtotal,
                o.opened_at AS active_opened_at,
                u.full_name AS waiter_name
            FROM areas a
            LEFT JOIN dining_tables t ON t.area_id = a.id
            LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.table_id = t.id AND o.status = 'Open'
            LEFT JOIN users u ON o.waiter_id = u.id
            ORDER BY a.id, t.id
        ";
        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getTableStatistics(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Available'), 0) AS available,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Occupied'), 0) AS occupied,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Reserved'), 0) AS reserved,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Cleaning'), 0) AS cleaning
            FROM dining_tables
        ";
        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getAreas(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                a.id,
                a.name,
                a.surcharge_percent,
                COUNT(t.id) AS table_count
            FROM areas a
            LEFT JOIN dining_tables t ON t.area_id = a.id
            GROUP BY a.id, a.name, a.surcharge_percent
            ORDER BY a.id
        ";
        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function addArea(string $name, float $surcharge): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO areas (name, surcharge_percent) VALUES (?, ?)");
        return $stmt->execute([$name, $surcharge]);
    }

    public function updateArea(int $id, string $name, float $surcharge): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE areas SET name = ?, surcharge_percent = ? WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$name, $surcharge, $id]);
    }

    public function deleteArea(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dining_tables WHERE area_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        if ((int)$stmt->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a khu vá»±c Ä‘ang cÃ³ bÃ n liÃªn káº¿t.');
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM areas WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function addTable(int $areaId, string $name, int $capacity): bool
    {
        $qrToken = 'QR_' . strtoupper(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9]/', '', $name)) . '_' . random_int(100, 999);
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO dining_tables (area_id, table_name, capacity, qr_token, status)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'Available')
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$areaId, $name, $capacity, $qrToken]);
    }

    public function updateTable(int $id, int $areaId, string $name, int $capacity): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            UPDATE dining_tables
            SET area_id = ?, table_name = ?, capacity = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$areaId, $name, $capacity, $id]);
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $id, string $status): bool
    {
        $allowedStatuses = ['Available', 'Occupied', 'Reserved', 'Cleaning'];
        if (!in_array($status, $allowedStatuses, true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = ? WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$status, $id]);
    }

    public function findTable(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT * FROM dining_tables WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $table = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $table ?: null;
    }
}

    $resId  = (int)$resRow['id'];

    $tbStatusAfterConfirm = $db->query("SELECT status FROM dining_tables WHERE id = 1")->fetchColumn();
    assertTest($okConfirm && $tbStatusAfterConfirm === 'Reserved', "Luong 1B: Xac nhan Booking -> Ban chuyen sang Reserved");

    $okCheckin = $resModel->updateReservationStatus($resId, 'CheckedIn', 2);
    $tbStatusAfterCheckin = $db->query("SELECT status FROM dining_tables WHERE id = 1")->fetchColumn();
    $autoOrder = $db->query("SELECT id, deposit_deducted FROM orders WHERE table_id = 1 AND status = 'Open' LIMIT 1")->fetch();
    assertTest($okCheckin && $tbStatusAfterCheckin === 'Occupied' && !empty($autoOrder['id']), "Luong 1C: Check-in Booking -> Ban chuyen Occupied & Tu dong mo Order POS kem tien coc");

    // 3. Gá»i mÃ³n trÃªn POS cho bÃ n vá»«a Check-in
    $wagyuStockBefore = (float)$db->query("SELECT stock_quantity FROM ingredients WHERE id = 1")->fetchColumn();
    $addOrderRes = $orderModel->createOrAddOrder(1, 3, [
        ['menu_item_id' => 2, 'quantity' => 1, 'modifier_notes' => 'Medium Rare']
    ]);
    assertTest(($addOrderRes['status'] ?? '') === 'success', "Luong 2A: POS goi mon tren ban vua Check-in thanh cong");

    $orderId = (int)$addOrderRes['order_id'];
    $detailId = (int)$db->query("SELECT id FROM order_details WHERE order_id = $orderId ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1")->fetchColumn();

    // 4. Luá»“ng KDS: Waiting -> Cooking -> Ready -> Served
    $kds1 = $orderModel->updateKdsStatus($detailId, 'Cooking');
    $kds2 = $orderModel->updateKdsStatus($detailId, 'Ready');
    $kds3 = $orderModel->updateKdsStatus($detailId, 'Served');
    assertTest(($kds1['status'] ?? '') === 'success' && ($kds2['status'] ?? '') === 'success' && ($kds3['status'] ?? '') === 'success', "Luong 2B: KDS cap nhat trang thai Waiting -> Cooking -> Ready -> Served");

    // 5. Luá»“ng TÃ­nh Bill & Thanh toÃ¡n + Trá»« kho BOM + Cá»™ng Ä‘iá»ƒm CRM

    // Dá»n dáº¹p báº£n ghi test CLI Ä‘á»ƒ giá»¯ sáº¡ch dá»¯ liá»‡u váº­n hÃ nh
    if (!empty($bomRes['receipt_code'])) {

    const guestCount = <?= $guestCount ?>;

    // TÃNH TIá»€N Äáº¶T Cá»ŒC THEO Sá» LÆ¯á»¢NG KHÃCH
    function calculateDeposit(count) {

        if (count <= 4) return 50000;

        if (count <= 8) return 100000;

        if (count <= 12) return 150000;

        if (count <= 20) return 200000;

        return 300000;
    }


    if (depositElement) {

        depositElement.textContent =
            calculateDeposit(guestCount).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'Ä‘';

    }


    // CHá»ŒN BÃ€N
    const tableButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.table-option');

    const customerForm = document.getElementById('customerForm');

    const selectedTableId = document.getElementById('selectedTableId');

    const selectedTableName = document.getElementById('selectedTableName');

    const selectedTableCapacity = document.getElementById('selectedTableCapacity');


    tableButtons.forEach(function (button) {

        button.addEventListener('click', function () {

            tableButtons.forEach(function (item) {

                item.classList.remove('selected');

                item.querySelector('.selected-label').style.display = 'none';

            });


            this.classList.add('selected');

            this.querySelector('.selected-label').style.display = 'block';


            selectedTableId.value = this.dataset.id;

            selectedTableName.textContent = this.dataset.name;

            selectedTableCapacity.textContent =
                ' - Sá»©c chá»©a: ' + this.dataset.capacity + ' khÃ¡ch';


            customerForm.style.display = 'block';


            customerForm.scrollIntoView({

                behavior: 'smooth',

                block: 'start'

            });

        });

    });

});
</script>

<?php
class Database {
    private static $instance = null;
    private $conn;

    private $host = 'localhost';
    private $db_name = 'royaldine_5s';
    private $username = 'root';
    private $password = '';
    private static $overrideDbName = null;

    private function __construct() {
        $targetDb = self::$overrideDbName
            ?: (defined('ROYALDINE_DB_NAME') ? ROYALDINE_DB_NAME : (getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_NAME') ?: $this->db_name));
        $targetHost = getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_HOST') ?: $this->host;
        $targetUser = getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_USER') ?: $this->username;
        $targetPass = getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_PASS') !== false ? getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_PASS') : $this->password;

        try {
            $dsn = "mysql:host={$targetHost};dbname={$targetDb};charset=utf8mb4";
            $this->conn = new PDO($dsn, $targetUser, $targetPass, [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false
            ]);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            error_log("[DB Connection Error] " . $e->getMessage());
            die("Lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i CSDL RoyalDine 5S: " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public static function setDatabaseName(string $dbName): void {
        self::$overrideDbName = $dbName;
        self::$instance = null;
    }

    public static function getDatabaseName(): string {
        return self::$overrideDbName
            ?: (defined('ROYALDINE_DB_NAME') ? ROYALDINE_DB_NAME : (getenv('ROYALDINE_DB_NAME') ?: 'royaldine_5s'));
    }

    public static function resetConnection(): void {
        self::$instance = null;
    }

    public static function getConnection() {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new Database();
        }
        return self::$instance->conn;
    }
}

<?php
class AuthController extends Controller {
    public function index() {
        if (isset($_SESSION['user'])) {
            header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=dashboard");
            exit;
        }
        $this->login();
    }

    public function login() {
        $error = '';
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $username = trim($_POST['username'] ?? '');
            $password = $_POST['password'] ?? '';

            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT u.*, r.role_code, r.role_name 
                FROM users u 
                JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id 
                WHERE u.username = ? AND u.is_active = 1
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$username]);
            $user = $stmt->fetch();

            if ($user && password_verify($password, $user['password_hash'])) {
                $_SESSION['user'] = $user;
                header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=dashboard");
                exit;
            } else {
                $error = 'Sai tên đăng nhập hoặc mật khẩu!';
            }
        }
        $this->render('auth_login', ['error' => $error], false);
    }

    public function logout() {
        session_destroy();
        header("Location: index.php?c=auth&a=login");
        exit;
    }
}

    public function index()
    {
        $this->requireRole();
        $model = new TableModel();
        $reservationModel = new ReservationModel();
        $isAdmin = $this->isAdminRole();

        $selectedFloor = isset($_GET['floor']) ? (int)$_GET['floor'] : 1;
        $selectedAreaId = isset($_GET['area_id']) ? (int)$_GET['area_id'] : 0;
        $selectedDate = trim($_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d'));
        if (!preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $selectedDate) || strtotime($selectedDate) === false) {
            $selectedDate = date('Y-m-d');
        }

        $floorsSummary = $model->getFloorsSummary();
        $availableFloorNums = array_map(fn($f) => (int)$f['floor_number'], $floorsSummary);
        if ($selectedFloor !== 0 && !in_array($selectedFloor, $availableFloorNums, true)) {
            $selectedFloor = $availableFloorNums[0] ?? 1;
        }

        $tables = $model->getAllTables(
            $selectedFloor > 0 ? $selectedFloor : null,
            $selectedAreaId > 0 ? $selectedAreaId : null,
            $selectedDate
        );
        $statistics = $model->getTableStatistics($selectedFloor > 0 ? $selectedFloor : null);
        $areas = $model->getAreas();
        $reservedTableIds = $reservationModel->getUpcomingReservedTableIds();

        $flashSuccess = $_SESSION['flash_msg'] ?? '';
        $flashError   = $_SESSION['flash_err'] ?? '';
        unset($_SESSION['flash_msg'], $_SESSION['flash_err']);

        $this->render('booking/index', compact(
            'tables',
            'statistics',
            'floorsSummary',
            'areas',
            'reservedTableIds',
            'selectedFloor',
            'selectedAreaId',
            'selectedDate',
            'isAdmin',
            'flashSuccess',
            'flashError'
        ));
    }

    public function customer(): void
    {
        $tableModel = new TableModel();
        $model = new ReservationModel();

        $selectedDate = trim($_POST['booking_date'] ?? $_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d'));
        if (!preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $selectedDate) || strtotime($selectedDate) === false) {
            $selectedDate = date('Y-m-d');
        }
        $selectedFloor = isset($_GET['floor']) ? (int)$_GET['floor'] : 1;
        $selectedAreaId = isset($_GET['area_id']) ? (int)$_GET['area_id'] : 0;
        $guestCount = (int)($_POST['guest_count'] ?? $_GET['guest_count'] ?? 4);
        $error = '';

        $floorsSummary = $tableModel->getFloorsSummary();
        $availableFloorNums = array_map(fn($f) => (int)$f['floor_number'], $floorsSummary);
        if ($selectedFloor !== 0 && !in_array($selectedFloor, $availableFloorNums, true)) {
            $selectedFloor = $availableFloorNums[0] ?? 1;
        }
        $areas = $tableModel->getAreas();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && ($_POST['action'] ?? '') === 'confirm_test_deposit') {
            $bookingCode = trim($_POST['booking_code'] ?? '');
            if ($bookingCode !== '' && $model->confirmTestDeposit($bookingCode)) {
                header('Location: index.php?c=booking&a=customer&created=' . urlencode($bookingCode) . '&test_paid=1');
                exit;
            }
            $error = 'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ¡c nháº­n thanh toÃ¡n Ä‘áº·t cá»c mÃ´ phá»ng.';
        }

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && ($_POST['action'] ?? '') === 'create') {
            $fullName = trim($_POST['full_name'] ?? '');
            $phone = trim($_POST['phone'] ?? '');
            $email = trim($_POST['email'] ?? '');
            $tableId = (int)($_POST['table_id'] ?? 0);
            $bookingTime = trim($_POST['booking_time'] ?? '');
            $specialRequest = trim($_POST['special_request'] ?? '');
            $date = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d\TH:i', $bookingTime);

            if ($fullName === '') $error = 'Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p há» vÃ  tÃªn.';
            elseif (!preg_match('/^0[0-9]{9,10}$/', $phone)) $error = 'Sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ (Pháº£i báº¯t Ä‘áº§u báº±ng sá»‘ 0 vÃ  cÃ³ 10-11 chá»¯ sá»‘).';
            elseif ($email !== '' && !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) $error = 'Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.';
            elseif (!$date || $date <= new DateTime('-5 minutes')) $error = 'Thá»i gian Ä‘áº·t bÃ n pháº£i náº±m trong tÆ°Æ¡ng lai.';
            elseif ($guestCount < 1 || $guestCount > 100) $error = 'Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng khÃ¡ch khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.';
            elseif ($tableId <= 0) $error = 'Vui lÃ²ng chá»n bÃ n hoáº·c phÃ²ng trá»‘ng.';
            else {
                try {
                    $selectedTable = $model->findTable($tableId);
                    if (!$selectedTable) {
                        throw new InvalidArgumentException('BÃ n/PhÃ²ng Ä‘Ã£ chá»n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.');
                    }

                    $depositAmount = method_exists('TableModel', 'calculateDepositByTable')
                        ? TableModel::calculateDepositByTable($selectedTable, $guestCount)
                        : 50000;

                    $bookingCode = $model->createReservation([
                        'full_name' => $fullName,
                        'phone' => $phone,
                        'email' => $email,
                        'table_id' => $tableId,
                        'booking_time' => $date->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                        'guest_count' => $guestCount,
                        'deposit_amount' => $depositAmount,
                        'special_request' => $specialRequest
                    ]);
                    header('Location: index.php?c=booking&a=customer&created=' . urlencode($bookingCode) . '&guest_count=' . $guestCount);
                    exit;
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    $error = $e->getMessage();
                }
            }
        }

        $tables = $tableModel->getAllTables(
            $selectedFloor > 0 ? $selectedFloor : null,
            $selectedAreaId > 0 ? $selectedAreaId : null,
            $selectedDate
        );

        $success = trim($_GET['created'] ?? '');
        $createdReservation = ($success !== '' && method_exists($model, 'getReservationByCode'))
            ? $model->getReservationByCode($success)
            : null;
        $depositAmount = $createdReservation ? (float)$createdReservation['deposit_amount'] : 50000;

        $this->render('booking/customer', compact(
            'tables',
            'floorsSummary',
            'areas',
            'selectedFloor',
            'selectedAreaId',
            'selectedDate',
            'guestCount',
            'error',
            'success',
            'depositAmount',
            'createdReservation'
        ));
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../models/CashShiftModel.php';

class CashShiftController extends Controller {
    private $cashModel;

    public function __construct() {
        parent::__construct();
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'STOCK', 'WAITER', 'CASHIER']);
        $this->cashModel = new CashShiftModel();
    }

    public function index() {
        header("Location: index.php?c=stock&tab=cash_shift");
        exit;
    }

    public function open() {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $cashier_id = (int)($_SESSION['user']['id'] ?? 1);
            $opening_cash = (float)str_replace(',', '', $_POST['opening_cash'] ?? 0);
            $note = trim($_POST['note'] ?? '');

            $checkOpen = $this->cashModel->getCurrentOpenShift($cashier_id);
            if ($checkOpen) {
                echo "<script>alert('Äang cÃ³ má»™t ca lÃ m viá»‡c chÆ°a Ä‘Ã³ng! Vui lÃ²ng Ä‘Ã³ng ca hiá»‡n táº¡i trÆ°á»›c.'); window.location.href='index.php?c=stock&tab=cash_shift';</script>";
                exit;
            }

            if ($this->cashModel->openShift($cashier_id, $opening_cash, $note)) {
                echo "<script>alert('Má»Ÿ ca thÃ nh cÃ´ng!'); window.location.href='index.php?c=stock&tab=cash_shift';</script>";
            } else {
                echo "<script>alert('Lá»—i khi má»Ÿ ca!'); window.location.href='index.php?c=stock&tab=cash_shift';</script>";
            }
        }
    }

    public function close() {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $shift_id = (int)$_POST['shift_id'];
            $actual_closing_cash = (float)str_replace(',', '', $_POST['actual_closing_cash'] ?? 0);
            $note = trim($_POST['close_note'] ?? '');

            if ($this->cashModel->closeShift($shift_id, $actual_closing_cash, $note)) {
                echo "<script>alert('ÄÃ³ng ca vÃ  bÃ n giao thÃ nh cÃ´ng!'); window.location.href='index.php?c=stock&tab=cash_shift';</script>";
            } else {
                echo "<script>alert('Lá»—i há»‡ thá»‘ng khi Ä‘Ã³ng ca!'); window.location.href='index.php?c=stock&tab=cash_shift';</script>";
            }
        }
    }

    public function transaction() {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $cashier_id = (int)($_SESSION['user']['id'] ?? 1);
            $type = $_POST['trans_type'] ?? 'IN';
            $amount = (float)str_replace(',', '', $_POST['amount'] ?? 0);
            $target_person = trim($_POST['target_person'] ?? '');
            $note_input = trim($_POST['note'] ?? '');

            $final_note = !empty($target_person)
                ? (($type == 'IN' ? "NgÆ°á»i ná»™p: " : "NgÆ°á»i nháº­n: ") . $target_person . " - LÃ½ do: " . $note_input)
                : $note_input;

            if ($amount <= 0) {
                echo "<script>alert('Sá»‘ tiá»n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡!'); window.location.href='index.php?c=stock&tab=cash_shift&subtab=fund';</script>";
                exit;
            }

            if ($this->cashModel->createTransaction($cashier_id, $type, $amount, $final_note)) {
                echo "<script>alert('Láº­p phiáº¿u thÃ nh cÃ´ng!'); window.location.href='index.php?c=stock&tab=cash_shift&subtab=fund';</script>";
            } else {
                echo "<script>alert('Lá»—i: Báº¡n pháº£i Má»ž CA LÃ€M VIá»†C trÆ°á»›c khi láº­p phiáº¿u thu/chi!'); window.location.href='index.php?c=stock&tab=cash_shift&subtab=fund';</script>";
            }
        }
    }

    public function printShift() {
        if (!isset($_GET['id'])) {
            die('Lá»—i: KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y ID ca lÃ m viá»‡c.');
        }
        $shift_id = (int)$_GET['id'];
        $dbConn = $this->cashModel->getConnection();
        $stmt = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT cs.*, u.full_name as cashier_name FROM cash_shifts cs LEFT JOIN users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id WHERE cs.id = :id");
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $shift_id]);
        $shiftData = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$shiftData) {
            die('Lá»—i: Ca lÃ m viá»‡c khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }
        require_once __DIR__ . '/../views/stock/print_shift.php';
    }
}

<?php

require_once __DIR__ . '/../models/CustomerModel.php';

class CustomerController extends Controller
{
    private CustomerModel $customerModel;

    public function __construct()
    {
        parent::__construct();
        $this->customerModel = new CustomerModel();
    }

    public function index()
    {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'HOSTESS', 'WAITER', 'CASHIER']);

        $error = '';
        $success = '';

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $id = !empty($_POST['customer_id']) ? (int)$_POST['customer_id'] : null;
            try {
                $this->customerModel->saveCustomer($_POST, $id);
                $_SESSION['crm_flash_success'] = $id
                    ? 'Đã cập nhật hồ sơ khách hàng.'
                    : 'Đã tạo hồ sơ khách hàng mới.';
                header('Location: index.php?c=customer&a=index');
                exit;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $error = $e->getMessage();
            }
        }

        if (!empty($_SESSION['crm_flash_success'])) {
            $success = $_SESSION['crm_flash_success'];
            unset($_SESSION['crm_flash_success']);
        } elseif (isset($_GET['success'])) {
            $success = 'Thao tác thành công.';
        }

        $keyword = trim($_GET['keyword'] ?? '');
        $customers = $this->customerModel->getAllCustomers($keyword);
        $statistics = $this->customerModel->getCustomerStatistics();

        $this->render(
            'customer/index',
            compact('customers', 'statistics', 'keyword', 'success', 'error')
        );
    }

    public function create()
    {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'HOSTESS', 'WAITER', 'CASHIER']);

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            try {
                $this->customerModel->saveCustomer($_POST);
                $_SESSION['crm_flash_success'] = 'Đã tạo hồ sơ khách hàng mới.';
                header('Location: index.php?c=customer&a=index');
                exit;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $_SESSION['crm_flash_error'] = $e->getMessage();
                header('Location: index.php?c=customer&a=index');
                exit;
            }
        }

        header('Location: index.php?c=customer&a=index');
        exit;
    }

    public function edit()
    {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'HOSTESS', 'WAITER', 'CASHIER']);

        $id = (int)($_GET['id'] ?? $_POST['customer_id'] ?? 0);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && $id > 0) {
            try {
                $this->customerModel->saveCustomer($_POST, $id);
                $_SESSION['crm_flash_success'] = 'Đã cập nhật hồ sơ khách hàng.';
                header('Location: index.php?c=customer&a=index');
                exit;
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $_SESSION['crm_flash_error'] = $e->getMessage();
                header('Location: index.php?c=customer&a=index');
                exit;
            }
        }

        header('Location: index.php?c=customer&a=index');
        exit;
    }

    public function detail()
    {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'HOSTESS', 'WAITER', 'CASHIER']);

        $id = (int)($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
        $customer = $this->customerModel->findCustomer($id);

        if (!$customer) {
            http_response_code(404);
            die('Không tìm thấy khách hàng.');
        }

        $this->render('customer/detail', compact('customer'));
    }
}

<?php
class MenuController extends Controller {

    private function logAction($actionType, $moduleName, $description, $severity = 'INFO') {
        $this->writeAuditLog($actionType, $moduleName, $description, $severity);
    }

    public function dashboard() {
        $this->requireRole();

        $selectedDate = $_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
        if (!preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $selectedDate) || strtotime($selectedDate) === false) {
            $selectedDate = date('Y-m-d');
        }
        $prevDate = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($selectedDate . ' -1 day'));

        // 1. Chá»‰ sá»‘ cÆ¡ sá»Ÿ dá»¯ liá»‡u thá»±c táº¿
        $totalItems  = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu_items")->fetchColumn();
        $totalTables = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dining_tables")->fetchColumn();
        $totalUsers  = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE is_active = 1")->fetchColumn();
        $bomCount    = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT menu_item_id) FROM recipes_bom")->fetchColumn();

        // 2. TÃ¬nh tráº¡ng bÃ n thá»±c táº¿
        $tableStats = ['Empty' => 0, 'Occupied' => 0, 'Reserved' => 0, 'Cleaning' => 0];
        $rows = $this->db->query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dining_tables GROUP BY status")->fetchAll();
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            $st = $r['status'];
            if ($st === 'Occupied') $tableStats['Occupied'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
            elseif ($st === 'Reserved') $tableStats['Reserved'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
            elseif ($st === 'Cleaning') $tableStats['Cleaning'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
            else $tableStats['Empty'] += (int)$r['cnt'];
        }
        $occupancyRate = $totalTables > 0
            ? round((($tableStats['Occupied'] + $tableStats['Reserved']) / $totalTables) * 100, 1)
            : 0;

        // 3. ÄÆ¡n hÃ ng vÃ  Äáº·t bÃ n theo ngÃ y Ä‘ang chá»n
        $stmtOrdersDate = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Paid'), 0) AS paid_orders,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Open'), 0) AS open_orders,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Paid' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_revenue
            FROM orders
            WHERE DATE(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at)) = ?
        ");
        $stmtOrdersDate->execute([$selectedDate]);
        $orderDaySummary = $stmtOrdersDate->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $todayOrdersCount     = (int)($orderDaySummary['total_orders'] ?? 0);
        $todayPaidOrdersCount = (int)($orderDaySummary['paid_orders'] ?? 0);
        $openOrdersCount      = (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Open'")->fetchColumn();

        $stmtPrevRev = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0)
            FROM orders
            WHERE DATE(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at)) = ? AND status = 'Paid'
        ");
        $stmtPrevRev->execute([$prevDate]);
        $yesterdayRevenue = (float)$stmtPrevRev->fetchColumn();

        $stmtBookingsDate = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_bookings,
                COALESCE(SUM(status IN ('Pending', 'Confirmed')), 0) AS upcoming_bookings,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'CheckedIn'), 0) AS checkedin_bookings
            FROM reservations
            WHERE DATE(booking_time) = ?
        ");
        $stmtBookingsDate->execute([$selectedDate]);
        $bookingDaySummary = $stmtBookingsDate->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $todayBookingsCount    = (int)($bookingDaySummary['total_bookings'] ?? 0);
        $upcomingBookingsCount = (int)($bookingDaySummary['upcoming_bookings'] ?? 0);

        // 4. Chuá»—i doanh thu & sá»‘ Ä‘Æ¡n 7 ngÃ y tÃ­nh Ä‘áº¿n ngÃ y Ä‘ang chá»n
        $dailyLabels  = [];
        $dailyRevenue = [];
        $dailyOrders  = [];
        for ($i = 6; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $d = date('Y-m-d', strtotime($selectedDate . " -$i days"));
            $dailyLabels[] = date('d/m', strtotime($d));

            $stmtD = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Paid' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rev,
                    COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Paid'), 0) AS cnt
                FROM orders
                WHERE DATE(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at)) = ?
            ");
            $stmtD->execute([$d]);
            $rowD = $stmtD->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            $dailyRevenue[] = (float)($rowD['rev'] ?? 0);
            $dailyOrders[]  = (int)($rowD['cnt'] ?? 0);
        }
        $todayRevenue = end($dailyRevenue) ?: 0;
        $weekRevenue  = array_sum($dailyRevenue);
        $weekPaidOrders = array_sum($dailyOrders);
        $avgOrderValue = $todayPaidOrdersCount > 0
            ? round($todayRevenue / $todayPaidOrdersCount)
            : ($weekPaidOrders > 0 ? round($weekRevenue / $weekPaidOrders) : 0);

        // 5. Doanh thu 6 thÃ¡ng gáº§n nháº¥t
        $monthlyLabels  = [];
        $monthlyRevenue = [];
        for ($m = 5; $m >= 0; $m--) {
            $ym = date('Y-m', strtotime(date('Y-m-01', strtotime($selectedDate)) . " -$m months"));
            $monthlyLabels[] = 'ThÃ¡ng ' . date('m/Y', strtotime($ym . '-01'));
            $stmtM = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0)
                FROM orders
                WHERE DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(closed_at, opened_at), '%Y-%m') = ? AND status = 'Paid'
            ");
            $stmtM->execute([$ym]);
            $monthlyRevenue[] = (float)$stmtM->fetchColumn();
        }

        // 6. Tá»· trá»ng phÆ°Æ¡ng thá»©c thanh toÃ¡n thá»±c táº¿
        $paymentBreakdown = $this->db->query("
            SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS tx_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount
            FROM payments
            GROUP BY payment_method
            ORDER BY total_amount DESC
        ")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        // 7. Top 5 mÃ³n Äƒn theo doanh thu thá»±c táº¿
        $topDishes = $this->db->query("
            SELECT m.item_code, m.name, m.unit, c.name AS category_name, m.price,
                   COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Paid' AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled' THEN od.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_qty,
                   COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Paid' AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled' THEN od.quantity * od.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_rev
            FROM menu_items m
            JOIN categories c ON m.category_id = c.id
            LEFT JOIN order_details od ON m.id = od.menu_item_id
            LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id
            GROUP BY m.id
            ORDER BY total_rev DESC, m.price DESC
            LIMIT 5
        ")->fetchAll();

        // 8. Cáº£nh bÃ¡o váº­n hÃ nh thá»±c táº¿
        $lowStockItems = $this->db->query("
            SELECT * FROM ingredients
            WHERE stock_quantity <= min_stock_level
            ORDER BY (stock_quantity - min_stock_level) ASC
            LIMIT 6
        ")->fetchAll();

        $pendingKdsCount = (int)$this->db->query("
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM order_details od
            JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id
            WHERE o.status = 'Open' AND od.kds_status IN ('Waiting', 'Cooking')
        ")->fetchColumn();

        $openShift = $this->db->query("
            SELECT cs.*, u.full_name AS cashier_name
            FROM cash_shifts cs
            LEFT JOIN users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id
            WHERE cs.status = 'Open'
            ORDER BY cs.id DESC LIMIT 1
        ")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        // 9. Hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng gáº§n Ä‘Ã¢y
        $recentLogs = $this->db->query("
            SELECT l.*, u.full_name, r.role_code
            FROM audit_logs l
            JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
            ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 6
        ")->fetchAll();

        $this->render('menu/dashboard', compact(
            'selectedDate', 'prevDate', 'totalItems', 'totalTables', 'totalUsers', 'bomCount',
            'tableStats', 'occupancyRate',
            'todayOrdersCount', 'todayPaidOrdersCount', 'openOrdersCount',
            'todayBookingsCount', 'upcomingBookingsCount',
            'dailyLabels', 'dailyRevenue', 'dailyOrders', 'todayRevenue', 'yesterdayRevenue', 'weekRevenue', 'avgOrderValue',
            'monthlyLabels', 'monthlyRevenue',
            'paymentBreakdown', 'topDishes', 'lowStockItems', 'pendingKdsCount', 'openShift', 'recentLogs'
        ));
    }

    public function index() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'CHEF']);

        $catFilter = isset($_GET['cat_id']) ? (int)$_GET['cat_id'] : 0;
        $params = [];
        $whereSql = "";
        if ($catFilter > 0) {
            $whereSql = "WHERE m.category_id = ?";
            $params[] = $catFilter;
        }

        $stmtItems = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT m.*, c.name AS category_name,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipes_bom b WHERE b.menu_item_id = m.id) AS bom_count,
            (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(i.name, ' (', b.quantity_required, ' ', i.unit, ')') SEPARATOR ' â€¢ ')
             FROM recipes_bom b JOIN ingredients i ON b.ingredient_id = i.id WHERE b.menu_item_id = m.id) AS bom_list,
            (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('[', im.modifier_group, '] ', im.modifier_name, IF(im.extra_price > 0, CONCAT(' (+', FORMAT(im.extra_price, 0), 'Ä‘)'), '')) SEPARATOR ' â€¢ ')
             FROM item_modifiers im WHERE im.menu_item_id = m.id) AS modifier_list
            FROM menu_items m 
            JOIN categories c ON m.category_id = c.id 
            $whereSql
            ORDER BY m.id DESC
        ");
        $stmtItems->execute($params);
        $items = $stmtItems->fetchAll();

        $categories = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY id ASC")->fetchAll();
        $ingredients = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM ingredients ORDER BY name ASC")->fetchAll();

        $bomRaw = $this->db->query("
            SELECT b.menu_item_id, b.ingredient_id, b.quantity_required, i.name AS ingredient_name, i.unit
            FROM recipes_bom b
            JOIN ingredients i ON b.ingredient_id = i.id
            ORDER BY i.name ASC
        ")->fetchAll();
        $bomByItem = [];
        foreach ($bomRaw as $row) {
            $bomByItem[$row['menu_item_id']][] = $row;
        }

        $modRaw = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM item_modifiers ORDER BY modifier_group ASC, id ASC")->fetchAll();
        $modByItem = [];
        foreach ($modRaw as $row) {
            $modByItem[$row['menu_item_id']][] = $row;
        }

        $this->render('menu/index', compact('items', 'categories', 'ingredients', 'bomByItem', 'modByItem', 'catFilter'));
    }

    public function saveCategory() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'CHEF']);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST' && !empty(trim($_POST['category_name'] ?? ''))) {
            $catName = trim($_POST['category_name']);
            $courseType = $_POST['course_type'] ?? 'Main_Course';
            $allowedCourses = ['Appetizer', 'Soup_Salad', 'Main_Course', 'Dessert', 'Beverage', 'Set_Menu'];
            if (!in_array($courseType, $allowedCourses, true)) {

            $stmt->execute([$catName, $courseType]);
            $this->logAction('CREATE_CATEGORY', 'Thá»±c Ä‘Æ¡n & BOM', "ThÃªm nhÃ³m thá»±c Ä‘Æ¡n má»›i: $catName", 'INFO');

        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=index");
        exit;

    public function saveMenuItem() {

                try {

                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    ");
                    $stmt->execute([$categoryId, $itemCode, $name, $unit, $price, $status]);

    public function toggleMenuStatus() {

    public function deleteMenuItem() {

                $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM item_modifiers WHERE menu_item_id = ?")->execute([$id]);
                $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM menu_items WHERE id = ?")->execute([$id]);
                $this->db->commit();
                $this->logAction('DELETE_MENU', 'Thá»±c Ä‘Æ¡n & BOM', "XÃ³a mÃ³n Äƒn '{$item['name']}' ({$item['item_code']}) khá»i thá»±c Ä‘Æ¡n", 'CRITICAL');

            } catch (PDOException $e) {
                if ($this->db->inTransaction()) $this->db->rollBack();
                $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a mÃ³n nÃ y vÃ¬ Ä‘Ã£ phÃ¡t sinh trong hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n bÃ¡n hÃ ng! HÃ£y chuyá»ƒn sang tráº¡ng thÃ¡i 'Táº¡m háº¿t'.";

    public function addBom() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'CHEF']);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $menuItemId = (int)($_POST['menu_item_id'] ?? 0);
            $ingredientId = (int)($_POST['ingredient_id'] ?? 0);
            $qty = (float)($_POST['quantity_required'] ?? 0);

            if ($menuItemId > 0 && $ingredientId > 0 && $qty > 0) {
                $check = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipes_bom WHERE menu_item_id = ? AND ingredient_id = ?");
                $check->execute([$menuItemId, $ingredientId]);
                if ($check->fetchColumn() > 0) {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE recipes_bom SET quantity_required = ? WHERE menu_item_id = ? AND ingredient_id = ?");
                    $stmt->execute([$qty, $menuItemId, $ingredientId]);
                } else {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO recipes_bom (menu_item_id, ingredient_id, quantity_required) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
                    $stmt->execute([$menuItemId, $ingredientId, $qty]);
                }
                $this->logAction('UPDATE_BOM', 'Äá»‹nh lÆ°á»£ng BOM', "Cáº­p nháº­t Ä‘á»‹nh lÆ°á»£ng nguyÃªn liá»‡u ID #$ingredientId (SL: $qty) cho mÃ³n ID #$menuItemId", 'INFO');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "ÄÃ£ cáº­p nháº­t cÃ´ng thá»©c Ä‘á»‹nh lÆ°á»£ng (BOM) thÃ nh cÃ´ng!";
            }
            header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=index&open_bom=$menuItemId");
            exit;
        }
    }

    public function users() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);

        $users = $this->db->query("
            SELECT u.*, r.role_code, r.role_name 
            FROM users u 
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id 
            ORDER BY u.id ASC
        ")->fetchAll();

        $roles = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM roles ORDER BY id ASC")->fetchAll();
        $shifts = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM work_shifts ORDER BY start_time ASC")->fetchAll();

        $filterDate = $_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');
        $stmtSched = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT s.*, u.full_name, u.username, r.role_code, w.shift_name, w.start_time, w.end_time, w.allowance
            FROM staff_schedules s
            JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
            JOIN work_shifts w ON s.shift_id = w.id
            WHERE s.work_date = ?
            ORDER BY w.start_time ASC, u.full_name ASC
        ");
        $stmtSched->execute([$filterDate]);
        $schedules = $stmtSched->fetchAll();

        $severityFilter = $_GET['severity'] ?? '';
        if ($severityFilter && in_array($severityFilter, ['INFO', 'WARNING', 'CRITICAL'], true)) {
            $stmtLog = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT l.*, u.full_name, u.username, r.role_code
                FROM audit_logs l
                JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
                JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
                WHERE l.severity = ?
                ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 30
            ");
            $stmtLog->execute([$severityFilter]);
            $auditLogs = $stmtLog->fetchAll();
        } else {
            $auditLogs = $this->db->query("
                SELECT l.*, u.full_name, u.username, r.role_code
                FROM audit_logs l
                JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id
                JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
                ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 30
            ")->fetchAll();
        }

        $this->render('menu/users', compact('users', 'roles', 'shifts', 'schedules', 'auditLogs', 'filterDate', 'severityFilter'));
    }

    public function saveUser() {

            if ($fullName === '' || $roleId <= 0 || ($id === 0 && $username === '')) {
                $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ há» tÃªn, tÃ i khoáº£n vÃ  vai trÃ²!";
                header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=staff");
                exit;
            }

            if ($id > 0) {
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE users SET full_name = ?, phone = ?, role_id = ? WHERE id = ?");
                $stmt->execute([$fullName, $phone, $roleId, $id]);
                $this->logAction('UPDATE_USER', 'Há»“ sÆ¡ nhÃ¢n viÃªn', "Cáº­p nháº­t thÃ´ng tin/vai trÃ² cho nhÃ¢n viÃªn: $fullName (ID: #$id)", 'WARNING');

                $password = !empty($_POST['password']) ? $_POST['password'] : '123456';

                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1)
                    ");
                    $stmt->execute([$roleId, $username, $hash, $fullName, $phone]);
                    $this->logAction('CREATE_USER', 'Há»“ sÆ¡ nhÃ¢n viÃªn', "Táº¡o má»›i tÃ i khoáº£n '$username' cho nhÃ¢n viÃªn $fullName", 'INFO');

                }

        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=staff");
        exit;

    public function saveShift() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $shiftCode = strtoupper(trim($_POST['shift_code'] ?? ('SHIFT_' . uniqid())));
            $shiftName = trim($_POST['shift_name'] ?? '');
            $startTime = trim($_POST['start_time'] ?? '08:00:00');
            $endTime   = trim($_POST['end_time'] ?? '14:00:00');
            $allowance = max(0, (float)($_POST['allowance'] ?? 0));
            $desc      = trim($_POST['description'] ?? '');

            if ($shiftName !== '') {
                try {
                    $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO work_shifts (shift_code, shift_name, start_time, end_time, allowance, description)
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    ");
                    $stmt->execute([$shiftCode, $shiftName, $startTime, $endTime, $allowance, $desc]);
                    $this->logAction('CREATE_SHIFT', 'PhÃ¢n ca lÃ m viá»‡c', "Táº¡o ca lÃ m viá»‡c má»›i: $shiftName ($startTime - $endTime)", 'INFO');
                    $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "ÄÃ£ thÃªm ca lÃ m viá»‡c '$shiftName' thÃ nh cÃ´ng!";
                } catch (PDOException $e) {
                    $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "MÃ£ ca lÃ m viá»‡c '$shiftCode' Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i!";
                }
            }
        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=shifts");
        exit;
    }

    public function attendance() {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN']);
        $id = (int)($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
        $type = $_GET['type'] ?? 'in';
        $date = $_GET['date'] ?? date('Y-m-d');

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT s.*, u.full_name, w.shift_name, w.start_time 
            FROM staff_schedules s
            JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id
            JOIN work_shifts w ON s.shift_id = w.id
            WHERE s.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $sched = $stmt->fetch();

        if ($sched) {
            $now = date('H:i:s');
            if ($type === 'in') {
                $status = (strtotime($now) > strtotime($sched['start_time']) + 300) ? 'Late' : 'OnTime';
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE staff_schedules SET check_in = ?, attendance_status = ? WHERE id = ?")
                         ->execute([$now, $status, $id]);
                $statusLabel = ($status === 'Late') ? 'ÄI TRá»„' : 'ÄÃšNG GIá»œ';
                $sev = ($status === 'Late') ? 'WARNING' : 'INFO';
                $this->logAction('CHECK_IN', 'Cháº¥m cÃ´ng', "Cháº¥m cÃ´ng VÃ€O CA ($now - $statusLabel) cho {$sched['full_name']} ({$sched['shift_name']})", $sev);
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "ÄÃ£ cháº¥m cÃ´ng VÃ€O CA lÃºc $now cho {$sched['full_name']} ($statusLabel)!";
            } elseif ($type === 'out') {
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE staff_schedules SET check_out = ? WHERE id = ?")
                         ->execute([$now, $id]);
                $this->logAction('CHECK_OUT', 'Cháº¥m cÃ´ng', "Cháº¥m cÃ´ng TAN CA ($now) cho {$sched['full_name']} ({$sched['shift_name']})", 'INFO');
                $_SESSION['flash_msg'] = "ÄÃ£ ghi nháº­n giá» TAN CA lÃºc $now cho {$sched['full_name']}!";
            } elseif ($type === 'absent') {
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE staff_schedules SET attendance_status = 'Absent' WHERE id = ?")
                         ->execute([$id]);
                $this->logAction('MARK_ABSENT', 'Cháº¥m cÃ´ng', "Ghi nháº­n Váº®NG Máº¶T ca {$sched['shift_name']} Ä‘á»‘i vá»›i {$sched['full_name']}", 'CRITICAL');
                $_SESSION['flash_err'] = "ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã¡nh dáº¥u Váº®NG Máº¶T Ä‘á»‘i vá»›i {$sched['full_name']}!";
            }
        }
        header("Location: index.php?c=menu&a=users&tab=shifts&date=$date");
        exit;
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../models/OrderModel.php';

class PosController extends Controller {
    private $orderModel;

    const LOGIN_URL = 'index.php?c=auth&a=login';

    public function __construct() {
        parent::__construct();
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) session_start();
        $this->orderModel = new OrderModel();
    }

    private function input() {
        $d = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        return is_array($d) ? $d : [];
    }

    private function guard(bool $api = true, array $allowedRoles = ['ADMIN', 'WAITER', 'CASHIER', 'CHEF', 'BAR', 'HOSTESS']) {
        $this->requireRole($allowedRoles, $api);
    }

    private function guardPost(array $allowedRoles = ['ADMIN', 'WAITER', 'CASHIER']) {
        $this->guard(true, $allowedRoles);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            $this->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'PhÆ°Æ¡ng thá»©c khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c há»— trá»£.'], 405);
        }
    }

    private function uid() { return (int)$_SESSION['user']['id']; }

    private function date($v) {
        return (is_string($v) && preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $v) && strtotime($v) !== false) ? $v : null;
    }

    public function index() {
        $this->guard(false, ['ADMIN', 'WAITER', 'CASHIER', 'CHEF', 'BAR', 'HOSTESS']);

        // 1. Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng sá»­a lá»—i font chá»¯ mÃ³n Äƒn lÃ m vá»¡ JSON JavaScript trÃªn POS
        $this->db->exec("
            UPDATE menu_items 
            SET name = 'RÆ°á»£u vang Ä‘á» ChÃ¢teau Margaux (Ly)', unit = 'Ly' 
            WHERE name LIKE '%?%' OR item_code = 'RD-WINE01'
        ");

        // 2. Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng giáº£i phÃ³ng cÃ¡c Ä‘Æ¡n Open bá»‹ rá»—ng (khÃ´ng cÃ³ mÃ³n nÃ o) hoáº·c bÃ n bá»‹ lá»‡ch tráº¡ng thÃ¡i
        $this->db->exec("
            UPDATE orders o
            LEFT JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.id AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled'
            SET o.status = 'Cancelled', o.closed_at = NOW()
            WHERE o.status = 'Open' AND od.id IS NULL AND o.reservation_id IS NULL
        ");
        $this->db->exec("
            UPDATE dining_tables dt
            LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.table_id = dt.id AND o.status = 'Open'
            SET dt.status = IF(o.id IS NULL, 'Available', 'Occupied')
            WHERE dt.status IN ('Available', 'Occupied')
        ");

        $this->render('pos/index');
    }

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../models/PromotionModel.php';

class PromotionController extends Controller
{
    private PromotionModel $promotionModel;

    public function __construct()
    {
        parent::__construct();
        $this->promotionModel = new PromotionModel();
    }

    private function checkAccess(): void
    {
        $this->requireRole(['ADMIN', 'HOSTESS', 'WAITER', 'CASHIER']);
    }

    public function index(): void
    {
        $this->checkAccess();

        $keyword = trim($_GET['keyword'] ?? '');
        $promotions = $this->promotionModel->getAllPromotions($keyword);

        $this->render('promotion/index', [
            'promotions' => $promotions,
            'keyword' => $keyword
        ]);
    }

    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->checkAccess();

        $this->render('promotion/form', [
            'promotion' => null
        ]);
    }

    public function store(): void
    {
        $this->checkAccess();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            header('Location: index.php?c=promotion&a=index');
            exit;
        }

        try {
            $this->promotionModel->savePromotion($_POST);
            $_SESSION['promotion_message'] = 'ThÃªm voucher thÃ nh cÃ´ng.';
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $_SESSION['promotion_error'] = $e->getMessage();
            header('Location: index.php?c=promotion&a=create');
            exit;
        }

        header('Location: index.php?c=promotion&a=index');
        exit;
    }

    public function edit(): void
    {
        $this->checkAccess();

        $id = (int)($_GET['id'] ?? 0);
        $promotion = $this->promotionModel->findPromotion($id);

        if (!$promotion) {
            http_response_code(404);
            exit('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y voucher.');
        }

        $this->render('promotion/form', [
            'promotion' => $promotion
        ]);
    }

    public function update(): void
    {
        $this->checkAccess();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            header('Location: index.php?c=promotion&a=index');
            exit;
        }

        $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);

        try {
            $this->promotionModel->savePromotion($_POST, $id);
            $_SESSION['promotion_message'] = 'Cáº­p nháº­t voucher thÃ nh cÃ´ng.';
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $_SESSION['promotion_error'] = $e->getMessage();
            header('Location: index.php?c=promotion&a=edit&id=' . $id);
            exit;
        }

        header('Location: index.php?c=promotion&a=index');
        exit;
    }

    public function toggle(): void
    {
        $this->checkAccess();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $this->promotionModel->togglePromotion($id);
        }

        header('Location: index.php?c=promotion&a=index');
        exit;
    }

    public function delete(): void
    {
        $this->checkAccess();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $id = (int)($_POST['id'] ?? 0);
            $this->promotionModel->deletePromotion($id);
        }

        header('Location: index.php?c=promotion&a=index');
        exit;
    }

    public function testVoucher(): void
    {
        $this->checkAccess();

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            header('Location: index.php?c=promotion&a=index');
            exit;
        }

        $code = trim($_POST['code'] ?? '');
        $orderValue = (float)($_POST['order_value'] ?? 0);
        $customerTier = $_POST['customer_tier'] ?? 'Standard';

        $allowedTiers = ['Standard', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Diamond'];

        if (!in_array($customerTier, $allowedTiers, true)) {
            $customerTier = 'Standard';
        }

        if ($code === '' || $orderValue <= 0) {
            $result = [
                'valid' => false,
                'message' => 'Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p mÃ£ voucher vÃ  giÃ¡ trá»‹ Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng há»£p lá»‡.'
            ];
        } else {
            try {
                $result = $this->promotionModel->validateVoucher(
                    $code,
                    $orderValue,
                    $customerTier
                );
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $result = [
                    'valid' => false,
                    'message' => $e->getMessage()
                ];
            }
        }

        $promotions = $this->promotionModel->getAllPromotions();

        $this->render('promotion/index', [
            'promotions' => $promotions,
            'keyword' => '',
            'testResult' => $result,
            'testInput' => [
                'code' => $code,
                'order_value' => $orderValue,
                'customer_tier' => $customerTier
            ]
        ]);
    }
}

    public function create_receipt() {

                        $detailsData[] = [

    public function export_excel() {

        $group_filter  = isset($_GET['group_filter']) ? trim($_GET['group_filter']) : '';

        header("Expires: 0");

        echo '<html xmlns:x="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:excel"><head><meta charset="utf-8"></head><body><table border="1">';
        echo '<tr style="background-color: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; font-weight: bold; text-align: center;">
                <th>STT</th><th>MÃ£ NVL</th><th>TÃªn NguyÃªn Váº­t Liá»‡u</th><th>NhÃ³m HÃ ng</th><th>ÄVT</th>

        if (!empty($ingredients)) {
            $stt = 1;
            foreach ($ingredients as $item) {

                $stockColor = $isLowStock ? 'color: red; font-weight: bold;' : '';
                echo '<tr>';

    public function create() {
        $this->checkAccess(['ADMIN', 'STOCK']);
        $type = $_GET['type'] ?? 'import';

        $suppliers = $this->stockModel->getSuppliers('', 'active', 1000, 0);
        $ingredients = $this->stockModel->getIngredients('', '', '', '', 1000, 0);

        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $receipt_code = trim($_POST['receipt_code']);
            $supplier_id  = ($type === 'import') ? ($_POST['supplier_id'] ?? null) : null;
            $note         = trim($_POST['note']);
            $created_at   = ($_POST['created_at'] ?? date('Y-m-d')) . ' ' . date('H:i:s');

            $ingredient_ids = $_POST['ingredient_id'] ?? [];
            $quantities     = $_POST['quantity'] ?? [];
            $unit_costs     = $_POST['unit_cost'] ?? [];

            $total_amount = 0;
            $detailsData  = [];

            for ($i = 0; $i < count($ingredient_ids); $i++) {
                $ing_id = (int)$ingredient_ids[$i];
                $qty    = (float)($quantities[$i] ?? 0);
                $cost   = (float)($unit_costs[$i] ?? 0);

                if ($ing_id > 0 && $qty > 0) {
                    $detailsData[] = [
                        'ingredient_id' => $ing_id,
                        'quantity'      => $qty,
                        'unit_cost'     => $cost
                    ];
                    $total_amount += $qty * $cost;
                }
            }

            $current_user_id = (int)($_SESSION['user']['id'] ?? 1);
            $receiptData = [
                'receipt_code' => $receipt_code,
                'supplier_id'  => $supplier_id,
                'user_id'      => $current_user_id,
                'total_amount' => $total_amount,
                'note'         => $note,
                'created_at'   => $created_at
            ];

            if (!empty($detailsData)) {
                if ($type === 'import') {
                    $isSaved = $this->stockModel->createImportReceipt($receiptData, $detailsData);
                    $msgType = 'nháº­p kho';
                } else {
                    $isSaved = $this->stockModel->createExportReceipt($receiptData, $detailsData);
                    $msgType = 'xuáº¥t kho';
                }

                if ($isSaved) {
                    echo "<script>
                        alert('ÄÃ£ lÆ°u phiáº¿u $msgType thÃ nh cÃ´ng! Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng tá»“n kho Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c cáº­p nháº­t.');
                        window.location.href = 'index.php?c=stock&a=index&tab=dashboard';

                    echo "<script>alert('KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»§ sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng tá»“n kho Ä‘á»ƒ xuáº¥t hoáº·c lá»—i káº¿t ná»‘i dá»¯ liá»‡u!');</script>";

    public function audit() {
        $this->checkAccess(['ADMIN', 'STOCK']);
        $ingredients = $this->stockModel->getIngredients('', '', '', '', 1000, 0);
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $user_id      = (int)($_SESSION['user']['id'] ?? 1);
            $receipt_code = trim($_POST['receipt_code'] ?? 'KK' . date('ymdHis'));
            $note         = trim($_POST['note'] ?? 'Phiáº¿u Ä‘iá»u chá»‰nh kiá»ƒm kÃª Ä‘á»‹nh ká»³');
            $created_at   = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');

            $ingredient_ids = $_POST['ingredient_id'] ?? [];
            $current_qtys   = $_POST['current_qty'] ?? [];
            $actual_qtys    = $_POST['actual_qty'] ?? [];
            $unit_costs     = $_POST['unit_cost'] ?? [];
            $reasons        = $_POST['reason'] ?? [];

            $auditDetails = [];
            for ($i = 0; $i < count($ingredient_ids); $i++) {
                if (isset($actual_qtys[$i]) && $actual_qtys[$i] !== '') {
                    $actual_qty  = (float)$actual_qtys[$i];
                    $current_qty = (float)$current_qtys[$i];
                    $diff        = $actual_qty - $current_qty;

                    if ($diff != 0) {
                        $auditDetails[] = [
                            'ingredient_id' => (int)$ingredient_ids[$i],
                            'actual_qty'    => $actual_qty,
                            'difference'    => $diff,
                            'unit_cost'     => (float)($unit_costs[$i] ?? 0),
                            'reason'        => trim($reasons[$i] ?? '')
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!empty($auditDetails)) {
                $receiptData = [
                    'receipt_code' => $receipt_code,
                    'user_id'      => $user_id,
                    'note'         => $note,
                    'created_at'   => $created_at
                ];
                $receiptId = $this->stockModel->createAuditReceipt($receiptData, $auditDetails);
                if ($receiptId) {
                    echo "<script>
                        alert('ÄÃ£ hoÃ n táº¥t kiá»ƒm kÃª! Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng tá»“n kho thá»±c táº¿ Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c cÃ¢n báº±ng.');
                        window.location.href='index.php?c=stock_receipt&a=show&id=" . $receiptId . "&from=dashboard';
                    </script>";
                    exit;
                } else {
                    echo "<script>alert('KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ lÆ°u phiáº¿u kiá»ƒm kÃª!');</script>";
                }
            } else {
                echo "<script>alert('Sá»‘ liá»‡u tá»“n kho khá»›p 100%, khÃ´ng cÃ³ chÃªnh lá»‡ch cáº§n Ä‘iá»u chá»‰nh.'); window.location.href='index.php?c=stock&a=index&tab=dashboard';</script>";
                exit;
            }
        }

        require_once __DIR__ . '/../views/layouts/header.php';
        require_once __DIR__ . '/../views/stock/stock_receipt/audit_form.php';
        require_once __DIR__ . '/../views/layouts/footer.php';
    }

    public function delete() {

<?php
class Controller {
    protected $db;

    public function __construct() {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_start();
        }
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
        if (empty($_SESSION['csrf_token'])) {
            $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        }
    }

    protected function render($viewPath, $data = [], $useLayout = true) {
        $data['csrf_token'] = $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '';
        extract($data);
        $viewFile = __DIR__ . "/../views/{$viewPath}.php";
        if (!file_exists($viewFile)) {
            die("KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y giao diá»‡n: {$viewPath}");
        }

        if ($useLayout) {
            require_once __DIR__ . "/../views/layouts/header.php";
            require_once $viewFile;
            require_once __DIR__ . "/../views/layouts/footer.php";
        } else {
            require_once $viewFile;
        }
    }

    protected function json($data, $statusCode = 200) {
        if (ob_get_length()) {
            ob_clean();
        }
        http_response_code($statusCode);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
        exit;
    }

    protected function requireRole($allowedRoles = [], bool $isApi = false) {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_start();
        }

        if (empty($_SESSION['user']['id'])) {
            if ($isApi) {
                $this->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'PhiÃªn Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t, vui lÃ²ng Ä‘Äƒng nháº­p láº¡i.'], 401);
            }
            header("Location: index.php?c=auth&a=login");
            exit;
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT u.is_active, r.role_code
            FROM users u
            JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.id
            WHERE u.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([(int)$_SESSION['user']['id']]);
        $liveUser = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$liveUser || (int)$liveUser['is_active'] !== 1) {
            unset($_SESSION['user']);
            if ($isApi) {
                $this->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'TÃ i khoáº£n Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ khÃ³a hoáº·c khÃ´ng cÃ²n tá»“n táº¡i.'], 403);
            }
            header("Location: index.php?c=auth&a=login");
            exit;
        }

        $_SESSION['user']['role_code'] = $liveUser['role_code'];
        $userRole = strtoupper($liveUser['role_code'] ?? '');
        if ($userRole === 'ADMIN' || $userRole === 'MANAGER') {
            return;
        }

        $expandedAllowed = array_map('strtoupper', $allowedRoles);
        if (in_array('WAITER', $expandedAllowed, true)) {
            $expandedAllowed[] = 'CASHIER';
            $expandedAllowed[] = 'SERVER';
        }
        if (in_array('CHEF', $expandedAllowed, true)) {
            $expandedAllowed[] = 'BAR';
        }

        if (!empty($expandedAllowed) && !in_array($userRole, $expandedAllowed, true)) {
            if ($isApi) {
                $this->json(['status' => 'error', 'message' => "Vai trÃ² {$userRole} khÃ´ng cÃ³ quyá»n thá»±c hiá»‡n chá»©c nÄƒng nÃ y."], 403);
            }
            http_response_code(403);
            die("<h2>403 - Truy cáº­p bá»‹ tá»« chá»‘i!</h2><p>Vai trÃ² <b>" . htmlspecialchars($userRole) . "</b> khÃ´ng cÃ³ quyá»n thá»±c hiá»‡n chá»©c nÄƒng nÃ y.</p>");
        }
    }

    protected function writeAuditLog(string $actionType, string $moduleName, string $description, string $severity = 'INFO'): void {
        if (empty($_SESSION['user']['id'])) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            $ip = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '127.0.0.1';
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, action_type, module_name, description, severity, ip_address)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ");
            $stmt->execute([(int)$_SESSION['user']['id'], $actionType, $moduleName, $description, $severity, $ip]);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            error_log("[AuditLog] " . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

SET NAMES utf8mb4;

-- 1. Core tables creation (safe if already exists)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roles (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    role_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    role_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    role_id INT NOT NULL,
    full_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS work_shifts (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    shift_code VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT NULL UNIQUE,
    shift_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    start_time TIME NOT NULL,
    end_time TIME NOT NULL,
    allowance DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    description VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS staff_schedules (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    shift_id INT NOT NULL,
    work_date DATE NOT NULL,
    check_in TIME DEFAULT NULL,
    check_out TIME DEFAULT NULL,
    attendance_status ENUM('Scheduled','OnTime','Late','Absent') DEFAULT 'Scheduled',
    note VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE KEY uq_user_shift_date (user_id, shift_id, work_date),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (shift_id) REFERENCES work_shifts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    action_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    module_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

    severity ENUM('INFO','WARNING','CRITICAL') DEFAULT 'INFO',
    ip_address VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT '127.0.0.1',
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Bổ sung bảng cho TV1 (Ca làm việc, Phân ca, Nhật ký hệ thống)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS work_shifts (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    shift_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    start_time TIME NOT NULL,
    end_time TIME NOT NULL,
    allowance DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

INSERT IGNORE INTO work_shifts (id, shift_name, start_time, end_time, allowance) VALUES
(1, 'Ca Sáng (Morning Fine Dining)', '08:00:00', '14:00:00', 50000),
(2, 'Ca Tối (Royal Dinner & Wine)', '16:00:00', '22:30:00', 80000);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS staff_schedules (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    shift_id INT NOT NULL,
    work_date DATE NOT NULL,
    check_in TIME DEFAULT NULL,
    check_out TIME DEFAULT NULL,
    attendance_status ENUM('Scheduled','OnTime','Late','Absent') DEFAULT 'Scheduled',
    note VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
    UNIQUE KEY uq_user_shift_date (user_id, shift_id, work_date),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (shift_id) REFERENCES work_shifts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    action_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    module_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    severity ENUM('INFO','WARNING','CRITICAL') DEFAULT 'INFO',
    ip_address VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT '127.0.0.1',
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- Bổ sung bảng giao dịch thu/chi cho TV4
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cash_transactions (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    shift_id INT NOT NULL,
    type ENUM('IN', 'OUT') NOT NULL,
    amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL,
    note TEXT,
    creator VARCHAR(100),
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (shift_id) REFERENCES cash_shifts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

    work_date DATE NOT NULL,
    check_in TIME DEFAULT NULL,
    check_out TIME DEFAULT NULL,

    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (shift_id) REFERENCES work_shifts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE KEY uk_user_shift_date (user_id, shift_id, work_date)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

    action_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    module_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

    severity ENUM('INFO', 'WARNING', 'CRITICAL') DEFAULT 'INFO',
    ip_address VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT '127.0.0.1',
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
