SET NAMES utf8mb4;
DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS royaldine_5s;
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS royaldine_5s CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
USE royaldine_5s;

-- MAI TRÃ‚M: QUáº¢N TRá»Š Há»† THá»NG, NHÃ‚N Sá»°, THá»°C ÄÆ N & Äá»ŠNH LÆ¯á»¢NG BOM

CREATE TABLE roles (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    role_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    role_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE users (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    role_id INT NOT NULL,
    full_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE work_shifts (
    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    shift_code VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT NULL UNIQUE,
    shift_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    start_time TIME NOT NULL,
    end_time TIME NOT NULL,
    allowance DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    description VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL

function hasColumn(PDO $db, string $table, string $column): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = ? AND COLUMN_NAME = ?");
    $st->execute([$table, $column]);
    return (int)$st->fetchColumn() > 0;
}

function hasForeignKey(PDO $db, string $table, string $column, string $refTable): bool {
    $st = $db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = ? AND COLUMN_NAME = ? AND REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME = ?");
    $st->execute([$table, $column, $refTable]);
    return (int)$st->fetchColumn() > 0;
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/Database.php';

class CashShiftModel {
    private $conn;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->conn = Database::getConnection();
    }

    public function getConnection() {
        return $this->conn;
    }

    public function getCurrentOpenShift($cashier_id = null) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->query("
            SELECT cs.*, u.full_name AS cashier_name 
            FROM cash_shifts cs 
            LEFT JOIN users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id 
            WHERE cs.status = 'Open' 
            ORDER BY cs.id DESC LIMIT 1
        ");
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function openShift($cashier_id, $opening_cash, $note = '') {
        if ((float)$opening_cash < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        $ownTx = !$this->conn->inTransaction();
        if ($ownTx) $this->conn->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $chk = $this->conn->query("SELECT id FROM cash_shifts WHERE status = 'Open' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE");
            if ($chk->fetch()) {
                if ($ownTx) $this->conn->rollBack();
                return false;
            }
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO cash_shifts (cashier_id, opened_at, opening_cash, expected_closing_cash, note, status)
                VALUES (?, NOW(), ?, ?, ?, 'Open')
            ");
            $ok = $stmt->execute([(int)$cashier_id, (float)$opening_cash, (float)$opening_cash, $note]);
            if ($ownTx) $this->conn->commit();
            return $ok;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($ownTx && $this->conn->inTransaction()) $this->conn->rollBack();
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function closeShift($shift_id, $actual_closing_cash, $note = '') {
        if ((float)$actual_closing_cash < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        $ownTx = !$this->conn->inTransaction();
        if ($ownTx) $this->conn->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM cash_shifts WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE");
            $stmt->execute([(int)$shift_id]);
            $shift = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$shift || $shift['status'] !== 'Open') {
                if ($ownTx) $this->conn->rollBack();
                return false;
            }

            $expected = (float)$shift['opening_cash'] + (float)$shift['total_cash_sales'] + (float)$shift['total_cash_in'] - (float)$shift['total_cash_out'];
            $discrepancy = (float)$actual_closing_cash - $expected;
            $finalNote = trim(($shift['note'] ?? '') . ($note ? ' | Chá»‘t ca: ' . $note : ''));

            $upd = $this->conn->prepare("
                UPDATE cash_shifts 
                SET closed_at = NOW(),
                    expected_closing_cash = ?,
                    actual_closing_cash = ?,
                    discrepancy = ?,
                    note = ?,
                    status = 'Closed'
                WHERE id = ? AND status = 'Open'
            ");
            $ok = $upd->execute([$expected, (float)$actual_closing_cash, $discrepancy, $finalNote, (int)$shift_id]);
            if ($ownTx) $this->conn->commit();
            return $ok;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($ownTx && $this->conn->inTransaction()) $this->conn->rollBack();
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function recordSaleTransaction($cashier_id, $amount, $type = 'sales') {
        if ((float)$amount <= 0) return false;
        $shift = $this->getCurrentOpenShift($cashier_id);
        if (!$shift) return false;

        $upd = $this->conn->prepare("
            UPDATE cash_shifts 
            SET total_cash_sales = total_cash_sales + ?,
                expected_closing_cash = opening_cash + (total_cash_sales + ?) + total_cash_in - total_cash_out
            WHERE id = ? AND status = 'Open'
        ");
        return $upd->execute([(float)$amount, (float)$amount, (int)$shift['id']]);
    }

    public function createTransaction($cashier_id, $type, $amount, $note = '') {
        if ((float)$amount <= 0 || !in_array($type, ['IN', 'OUT'], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $ownTx = !$this->conn->inTransaction();
        if ($ownTx) $this->conn->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmt = $this->conn->query("SELECT * FROM cash_shifts WHERE status = 'Open' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE");
            $shift = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$shift) {
                if ($ownTx) $this->conn->rollBack();
                return false;
            }

            $creator = $_SESSION['user']['full_name'] ?? 'Thu ngÃ¢n';
            $ins = $this->conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO cash_transactions (shift_id, type, amount, note, creator, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
            ");
            $ins->execute([(int)$shift['id'], $type, (float)$amount, $note, $creator]);

            if ($type === 'IN') {
                $upd = $this->conn->prepare("
                    UPDATE cash_shifts 
                    SET total_cash_in = total_cash_in + ?,
                        expected_closing_cash = opening_cash + total_cash_sales + (total_cash_in + ?) - total_cash_out
                    WHERE id = ?
                ");
                $upd->execute([(float)$amount, (float)$amount, (int)$shift['id']]);
            } else {
                $upd = $this->conn->prepare("
                    UPDATE cash_shifts 
                    SET total_cash_out = total_cash_out + ?,
                        expected_closing_cash = opening_cash + total_cash_sales + total_cash_in - (total_cash_out + ?)
                    WHERE id = ?
                ");
                $upd->execute([(float)$amount, (float)$amount, (int)$shift['id']]);
            }

            if ($ownTx) $this->conn->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($ownTx && $this->conn->inTransaction()) $this->conn->rollBack();
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function getTransactionsByShift($shift_id) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT * FROM cash_transactions WHERE shift_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC");
        $stmt->execute([(int)$shift_id]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getShiftHistory($limit = 20) {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("
            SELECT cs.*, u.full_name AS cashier_name 
            FROM cash_shifts cs 
            LEFT JOIN users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id 
            ORDER BY cs.id DESC LIMIT :limit
        ");
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', (int)$limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/Database.php';

class CustomerModel
{
    private PDO $db;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
    }

    // ChÃ­nh sÃ¡ch xÃ©t nÃ¢ng háº¡ng tá»± Ä‘á»™ng theo Tá»•ng chi tiÃªu lÅ©y káº¿ CRM
    private function calculateTier(float $totalSpent): string
    {
        if ($totalSpent >= 50000000) {
            return 'Diamond';
        }
        if ($totalSpent >= 20000000) {
            return 'Gold';
        }
        if ($totalSpent >= 5000000) {
            return 'Silver';
        }
        return 'Standard';
    }

    public function getAllCustomers(string $keyword = ''): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT id, full_name, phone, email, tier, points, total_spent, created_at
            FROM customers
        ";
        $params = [];

        if ($keyword !== '') {
            $sql .= " WHERE full_name LIKE ? OR phone LIKE ? OR email LIKE ?";
            $search = '%' . $keyword . '%';
            $params = [$search, $search, $search];
        }

        $sql .= " ORDER BY total_spent DESC, id DESC";
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getCustomerStatistics(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tier = 'Standard' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS standard_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tier = 'Silver' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS silver_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tier = 'Gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gold_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tier = 'Diamond' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS diamond_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) AS total_points,
                COALESCE(SUM(total_spent), 0) AS total_revenue
            FROM customers
        ";
        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function findCustomer(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $customer = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $customer ?: null;
    }

    public function saveCustomer(array $data, ?int $id = null): bool
    {
        $name = trim($data['full_name'] ?? '');
        $phone = trim($data['phone'] ?? '');
        $email = trim($data['email'] ?? '');

        if ($name === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p há» tÃªn.');
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9]{9,11}$/', $phone)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }
        if ($email !== '' && !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }

        $check = $this->db->prepare("SELECT id FROM customers WHERE phone = ? AND id != ?");
        $check->execute([$phone, $id ?? 0]);
        if ($check->fetch()) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }

        if ($id !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE customers SET full_name = ?, phone = ?, email = ? WHERE id = ?");
            return $stmt->execute([$name, $phone, $email !== '' ? $email : null, $id]);
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO customers (full_name, phone, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
        return $stmt->execute([$name, $phone, $email !== '' ? $email : null]);
    }

    // Tá»± Ä‘á»™ng cá»™ng Ä‘iá»ƒm (10.000Ä‘ = 1 Ä‘iá»ƒm) vÃ  xÃ©t nÃ¢ng háº¡ng ngay sau thanh toÃ¡n
    public function recordPurchase(int $customerId, float $amount): bool
    {
        if ($amount <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        $ownTransaction = !$this->db->inTransaction();
        if ($ownTransaction) {
            $this->db->beginTransaction();
        }

        try {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT total_spent FROM customers WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE");
            $stmt->execute([$customerId]);
            $customer = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (!$customer) {
                throw new RuntimeException('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y khÃ¡ch hÃ ng.');
            }

            $points = (int)floor($amount / 10000);
            $newTotal = (float)$customer['total_spent'] + $amount;
            $newTier = $this->calculateTier($newTotal);

            $update = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE customers
                SET total_spent = total_spent + ?,
                    points = points + ?,
                    tier = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $update->execute([$amount, $points, $newTier, $customerId]);

            if ($ownTransaction) {
                $this->db->commit();
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($ownTransaction && $this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/CustomerModel.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/StockModel.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/CashShiftModel.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/Database.php';

class OrderModel {
    private $db;

    const SERVICE_RATE = 0.05;
    const VAT_RATE     = 0.08;
    const TIER_DISCOUNT = ['Standard' => 0, 'Silver' => 0.03, 'Gold' => 0.05, 'Diamond' => 0.10];
    const TIER_RANK = [
        'Standard' => 0,
        'Silver'   => 1,
        'Gold'     => 2,
        'Diamond'  => 3
    ];
    const COURSE_PRIORITY = [
        'Appetizer'   => 1,
        'Soup_Salad'  => 2,
        'Main_Course' => 3,
        'Dessert'     => 4,
        'Beverage'    => 1,
        'Set_Menu'    => 3
    ];

    const BANK_ID = 'MB';
    const BANK_ACCOUNT = '0901000003';
    const BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME = 'ROYALDINE 5S';

    public function __construct() {
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
    }

    private function err($msg) {
        return ['status' => 'error', 'message' => $msg];
    }

    private function fail($e) {
        if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
            $this->db->rollBack();
        }
        if ($e instanceof PDOException) {
            error_log('[POS] ' . $e->getMessage());
            return $this->err('Lá»—i cÆ¡ sá»Ÿ dá»¯ liá»‡u, vui lÃ²ng thá»­ láº¡i hoáº·c bÃ¡o quáº£n trá»‹.');
        }
        return $this->err($e->getMessage());
    }

    private function one($sql, $params = []) {
        $st = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $st->execute($params);
        return $st->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    private function all($sql, $params = []) {
        $st = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $st->execute($params);
        return $st->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    private function recalcSubtotal($order_id) {
        $this->db->prepare("
            UPDATE orders
            SET subtotal = (
                SELECT IFNULL(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 0)
                FROM order_details
                WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status <> 'Cancelled'
            )
            WHERE id = ?
        ")->execute([$order_id, $order_id]);
    }

    private function addLog($order_id, $user_id, $type, $desc) {
        $this->db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO order_logs (order_id, user_id, action_type, description)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ")->execute([$order_id, $user_id, $type, $desc]);
    }

    private function dateRange($col, $from, $to) {
        if ($from && $to) {
            return [" AND $col >= ? AND $col < DATE_ADD(?, INTERVAL 1 DAY)", [$from, $to]];
        }
        return ['', []];
    }

    private function releaseTableSmart(int $tableId): void {
        $upcoming = $this->one("
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM reservations
            WHERE table_id = ?
              AND status = 'Confirmed'
              AND booking_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
        ", [$tableId]);
        $nextStatus = ((int)($upcoming['cnt'] ?? 0) > 0) ? 'Reserved' : 'Available';
        $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = ? WHERE id = ?")->execute([$nextStatus, $tableId]);
    }

    /**
     * Äá»“ng bá»™ háº¡ng thÃ nh viÃªn dá»±a trÃªn Äiá»ƒm tÃ­ch lÅ©y vÃ  Tá»•ng chi tiÃªu lÅ©y káº¿ CRM
     */
    private function resolveCustomerRank(array $cust): string {
        $spent = (float)($cust['total_spent'] ?? 0);
        $points = (int)($cust['points'] ?? 0);
        $dbTier = (string)($cust['tier'] ?? 'Standard');

        $metricTier = CustomerModel::calculateTierByMetrics($spent, $points);
        $finalTier = ((self::TIER_RANK[$metricTier] ?? 0) >= (self::TIER_RANK[$dbTier] ?? 0))
            ? $metricTier
            : $dbTier;

        if ($finalTier !== $dbTier && !empty($cust['id'])) {
            $this->db->prepare("UPDATE customers SET tier = ? WHERE id = ?")
                ->execute([$finalTier, (int)$cust['id']]);
        }

        return $finalTier;
    }

    public function createOrAddOrder($table_id, $waiter_id, $items) {
        $table_id = (int)$table_id;
        if (!$table_id || !is_array($items) || !$items) {
            return $this->err('ChÆ°a chá»n bÃ n hoáº·c chÆ°a cÃ³ mÃ³n nÃ o.');
        }
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $table = $this->one("SELECT id, table_name, status FROM dining_tables WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE", [$table_id]);
            if (!$table) {
                throw new Exception('BÃ n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i!');
            }

            $order = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code FROM orders WHERE table_id = ? AND status = 'Open' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE", [$table_id]);
            if (!$order) {
                if ($table['status'] === 'Cleaning') {
                    throw new Exception("BÃ n {$table['table_name']} Ä‘ang dá»n vá»‡ sinh, chÆ°a thá»ƒ má»Ÿ Ä‘Æ¡n má»›i!");
                }

                $res = $this->one("
                    SELECT id, customer_id, guest_count, deposit_amount
                    FROM reservations
                    WHERE table_id = ? AND status IN ('CheckedIn', 'Confirmed')
                    ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'CheckedIn', 'Confirmed'), booking_time DESC
                    LIMIT 1
                ", [$table_id]);

                $resId   = $res ? (int)$res['id'] : null;
                $custId  = $res ? (int)$res['customer_id'] : null;
                $guests  = $res ? (int)$res['guest_count'] : 2;
                $deposit = $res ? (float)$res['deposit_amount'] : 0;

                if ($res && $res['id']) {
                    $this->db->prepare("UPDATE reservations SET status = 'CheckedIn' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$resId]);
                }

                $order_code = 'ORD-' . strtoupper(uniqid());
                $this->db->prepare("
                    INSERT INTO orders (
                        order_code, table_id, reservation_id, customer_id, waiter_id,
                        guest_count, deposit_deducted, status, opened_at
                    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Open', NOW())
                ")->execute([$order_code, $table_id, $resId, $custId, $waiter_id, $guests, $deposit]);

                $order = ['id' => $this->db->lastInsertId(), 'order_code' => $order_code];
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Occupied' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$table_id]);
                $this->addLog($order['id'], $waiter_id, 'CreateOrder', "Táº¡o Ä‘Æ¡n má»›i: {$order_code} táº¡i bÃ n {$table['table_name']}");
            }

            $ins = $this->db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO order_details (order_id, menu_item_id, quantity, unit_price, modifier_notes, course_priority, kds_status)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Waiting')
            ");
            foreach ($items as $it) {
                $qty = (int)($it['quantity'] ?? 0);
                if ($qty < 1 || $qty > 99) {
                    throw new Exception('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng mÃ³n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ (1â€“99).');
                }
                $mi = $this->one("
                    SELECT mi.id, mi.name, mi.price, mi.status, c.course_type
                    FROM menu_items mi
                    JOIN categories c ON mi.category_id = c.id
                    WHERE mi.id = ?
                ", [(int)($it['menu_item_id'] ?? 0)]);
                if (!$mi) {
                    throw new Exception('CÃ³ mÃ³n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i trong thá»±c Ä‘Æ¡n.');
                }
                if ($mi['status'] !== 'Available') {
                    throw new Exception("MÃ³n \"{$mi['name']}\" hiá»‡n khÃ´ng phá»¥c vá»¥ ({$mi['status']}).");
                }
                $note = mb_substr(trim((string)$it['modifier_notes'] ?? ''), 0, 255);
                $ins->execute([
                    $order['id'],
                    $mi['id'],
                    $qty,
                    $mi['price'],
                    $note !== '' ? $note : null,
                    self::COURSE_PRIORITY[$mi['course_type']] ?? 1
                ]);
            }
            $this->recalcSubtotal($order['id']);
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'order_id' => (int)$order['id'], 'message' => 'Gá»i mÃ³n thÃ nh cÃ´ng!'];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return $this->fail($e);
        }
    }

    public function cancelOrderItem($order_detail_id, $user_id, $reason) {
        $reason = trim((string)$reason);
        if (mb_strlen($reason) < 3) {
            return $this->err('Báº¯t buá»™c nháº­p lÃ½ do há»§y mÃ³n (Ã­t nháº¥t 3 kÃ½ tá»±).');
        }
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $it = $this->one("
                SELECT od.id, od.order_id, od.quantity, od.kds_status, mi.name, o.status AS order_status, dt.table_name
                FROM order_details od
                JOIN menu_items mi ON od.menu_item_id = mi.id
                JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id
                JOIN dining_tables dt ON o.table_id = dt.id
                WHERE od.id = ? FOR UPDATE
            ", [(int)$order_detail_id]);
            if (!$it) throw new Exception('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y mÃ³n!');
            if ($it['order_status'] !== 'Open') throw new Exception('HÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ há»§y mÃ³n!');
            if ($it['kds_status'] === 'Cooking') throw new Exception('Báº¿p Ä‘ang cháº¿ biáº¿n mÃ³n nÃ y, hÃ£y bÃ¡o báº¿p trÆ°á»Ÿng náº¿u cáº§n dá»«ng mÃ³n!');
            if ($it['kds_status'] === 'Served') throw new Exception('MÃ³n Ä‘Ã£ phá»¥c vá»¥ cho khÃ¡ch, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ há»§y.');
            if (!in_array($it['kds_status'], ['Waiting', 'Ready'], true)) throw new Exception('MÃ³n nÃ y khÃ´ng thá»ƒ há»§y!');

            if ($it['kds_status'] === 'Ready') {
                $reason = '[ÄÃ£ náº¥u xong] ' . $reason;
            }

            $st = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE order_details
                SET kds_status = 'Cancelled', cancel_reason = ?
                WHERE id = ? AND kds_status = ?
            ");
            $st->execute([mb_substr($reason, 0, 255), $it['id'], $it['kds_status']]);
            if ($st->rowCount() === 0) {
                throw new Exception('Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i mÃ³n vá»«a thay Ä‘á»•i, hÃ£y táº£i láº¡i mÃ n hÃ¬nh.');
            }

            $this->recalcSubtotal($it['order_id']);
            $this->addLog($it['order_id'], $user_id, 'CancelItem', "Há»§y mÃ³n ID {$it['id']} ({$it['quantity']}Ã— {$it['name']}, BÃ n {$it['table_name']}). LÃ½ do: {$reason}");
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'message' => 'ÄÃ£ há»§y mÃ³n thÃ nh cÃ´ng'];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return $this->fail($e);
        }
    }

    public function getKDSList() {
        return $this->all("
            SELECT od.id, od.order_id, od.kds_status, od.quantity, od.modifier_notes, od.ordered_at,
                   mi.name AS item_name, dt.table_name, c.course_type,
                   IF(c.course_type = 'Beverage', 'Bar', 'Kitchen') AS station,
                   TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, od.ordered_at, NOW()) AS wait_minutes
            FROM order_details od
            JOIN menu_items mi ON od.menu_item_id = mi.id
            JOIN categories c ON mi.category_id = c.id
            JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id AND o.status = 'Open'
            JOIN dining_tables dt ON o.table_id = dt.id
            WHERE od.kds_status IN ('Waiting', 'Cooking', 'Ready')
            ORDER BY od.ordered_at ASC, od.course_priority ASC, od.id ASC
        ");
    }

    public function updateKdsStatus($order_detail_id, $new_status, $takeaway = false) {
        $prev = ['Cooking' => 'Waiting', 'Ready' => 'Cooking', 'Served' => 'Ready'];
        if (!isset($prev[$new_status])) {
            return $this->err('Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡');
        }
        $set = 'od.kds_status = ?';
        if ($takeaway && $new_status === 'Served') {
            $set .= ", od.modifier_notes = LEFT(CONCAT_WS(' Â· ', NULLIF(od.modifier_notes, ''), 'Mang vá»'), 255)";
        }
        $st = $this->db->prepare("
            UPDATE order_details od
            JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id
            SET $set
            WHERE od.id = ? AND od.kds_status = ? AND o.status = 'Open'
        ");
        $st->execute([$new_status, (int)$order_detail_id, $prev[$new_status]]);
        if ($st->rowCount() === 0) {
            return $this->err('MÃ³n Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘á»•i tráº¡ng thÃ¡i hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ há»§y. HÃ£y táº£i láº¡i mÃ n hÃ¬nh.');
        }
        return ['status' => 'success', 'message' => "ÄÃ£ chuyá»ƒn tráº¡ng thÃ¡i sang: {$new_status}"];
    }

    private function qrUrl($amount, $order_code) {
        return 'https://img.vietqr.io/image/' . self::BANK_ID . '-' . self::BANK_ACCOUNT . '-compact2.png'
            . '?amount=' . (int)round($amount)
            . '&addInfo=' . rawurlencode('THANH TOAN HD ' . $order_code)
            . '&accountName=' . rawurlencode(self::BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME);
    }

 public function calcBill($order_id, $phone = '', $voucher = '') {
        $o = $this->one("
            SELECT o.id, o.order_code, o.status, o.customer_id, o.reservation_id, o.deposit_deducted,
                   dt.table_name, a.name AS area_name, a.surcharge_percent
            FROM orders o
            JOIN dining_tables dt ON o.table_id = dt.id
            JOIN areas a ON dt.area_id = a.id
            WHERE o.id = ?
        ", [(int)$order_id]);
        if (!$o) return null;

        $items = $this->all("
            SELECT mi.name, od.quantity, od.unit_price, od.modifier_notes
            FROM order_details od
            JOIN menu_items mi ON od.menu_item_id = mi.id
            WHERE od.order_id = ? AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled'
            ORDER BY od.ordered_at, od.id
        ", [$o['id']]);
        $subtotal = 0;
        foreach ($items as $i) {
            $subtotal += $i['quantity'] * $i['unit_price'];
        }

        $unf = $this->one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_details WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status IN ('Waiting', 'Cooking')", [$o['id']]);
        $rdy = $this->one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_details WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status = 'Ready'", [$o['id']]);

        $surcharge = round($subtotal * (float)$o['surcharge_percent'] / 100);
        $service   = round(($subtotal + $surcharge) * self::SERVICE_RATE);

        $cust = null;
        $phoneErr = null;
        $digits = preg_replace('/\D/', '', (string)$phone);
        if ($digits !== '') {
            $cust = $this->one("SELECT id, full_name, phone, tier, points, total_spent FROM customers WHERE phone = ?", [$digits]);
            if (!$cust) {
                $phoneErr = 'KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y khÃ¡ch hÃ ng vá»›i sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i nÃ y.';
            }
        }

        $tier = $cust['tier'] ?? 'Standard';
        $tierRate = $cust ? (self::TIER_DISCOUNT[$tier] ?? 0) : 0;
        $tierPercent = (int)round($tierRate * 100);
        $tierDisc = $cust ? round(($subtotal + $surcharge) * $tierRate) : 0;

        $customerDisplay = null;
        if ($cust) {
            $customerDisplay = $tierPercent > 0
                ? ($cust['full_name'] . ' Â· Giáº£m ' . $tierPercent . '%')
                : ($cust['full_name'] . ' Â· TÃ­ch Ä‘iá»ƒm tiÃªu chuáº©n');
        }

        $voucherDisc = 0;
        $voucherErr = null;
        $code = strtoupper(trim((string)$voucher));
        if ($code !== '') {
            $p = $this->one("SELECT *, (NOW() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date) AS in_range FROM promotions WHERE code = ?", [$code]);
            if (!$p || !$p['is_active']) $voucherErr = 'MÃ£ voucher khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ ngá»«ng Ã¡p dá»¥ng.';
            elseif (!$p['in_range']) $voucherErr = 'Voucher chÆ°a Ä‘áº¿n hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ quÃ¡ háº¡n sá»­ dá»¥ng.';
            elseif ($subtotal < (float)$p['min_order_value']) $voucherErr = 'ÄÆ¡n tá»‘i thiá»ƒu ' . number_format($p['min_order_value'], 0, ',', '.') . 'â‚« má»›i dÃ¹ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c voucher nÃ y.';
            elseif ((self::TIER_RANK[$tier] ?? 0) < (self::TIER_RANK[$p['min_tier']] ?? 0)) $voucherErr = 'Voucher chá»‰ dÃ nh cho háº¡ng ' . $p['min_tier'] . ' trá»Ÿ lÃªn.';
            else {
                $base = max(0, $subtotal + $surcharge - $tierDisc);
                $d = $p['discount_type'] === 'Percent' ? $base * (float)$p['discount_value'] / 100 : (float)$p['discount_value'];
                if ($p['discount_type'] === 'Percent' && $p['max_discount'] !== null) $d = min($d, (float)$p['max_discount']);
                $voucherDisc = round(max(0, min($d, $base)));
            }
        }

        $deposit = (float)($o['deposit_deducted'] ?? 0);
        if ($deposit <= 0 && !empty($o['reservation_id'])) {
            $resRow = $this->one("SELECT deposit_amount FROM reservations WHERE id = ?", [$o['reservation_id']]);
            $deposit = (float)($resRow['deposit_amount'] ?? 0);
        }

        $discount = $tierDisc + $voucherDisc;
        $taxable  = max(0, $subtotal + $surcharge + $service - $discount);
        $vat      = round($taxable * self::VAT_RATE);
        $grossTotal = $taxable + $vat;
        $depositDeducted = min($deposit, $grossTotal);
        $total    = max(0, $grossTotal - $depositDeducted);

        return [
            'order_id'               => (int)$o['id'],
            'order_code'             => $o['order_code'],
            'status'                 => $o['status'],
            'table_name'             => $o['table_name'],
            'area_name'              => $o['area_name'],
            'surcharge_percent'      => (float)$o['surcharge_percent'],
            'items'                  => $items,
            'unfinished'             => (int)$unf['n'],
            'ready_unserved'         => (int)$rdy['n'],
            'subtotal'               => $subtotal,
            'surcharge'              => $surcharge,
            'service'                => $service,
            'tier'                   => $tier,
            'tier_discount_percent'  => $tierPercent,
            'tier_discount'          => $tierDisc,
            'voucher_code'           => $code,
            'voucher_discount'       => $voucherDisc,
            'discount'               => $discount,
            'vat'                    => $vat,
            'deposit_deducted'       => $depositDeducted,
            'total'                  => $total,
            'customer_id'            => $cust['id'] ?? null,
            'customer_name'          => $customerDisplay,
            'phone_error'            => $phoneErr,
            'voucher_error'          => $voucherErr,
            'vietqr_url'             => $this->qrUrl($total, $o['order_code']),
        ];
    }

    public function checkoutOrder($order_id, $cashier_id, $payment_method, $phone = '', $voucher = '', $ref = '') {
        if (!in_array($payment_method, ['Cash', 'VietQR', 'CreditCard'], true)) {
            return $this->err('PhÆ°Æ¡ng thá»©c thanh toÃ¡n khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $o = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code, status, table_id, reservation_id FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE", [(int)$order_id]);
            if (!$o) throw new Exception('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng!');
            if ($o['status'] === 'Paid') throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n hÃ ng Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c thanh toÃ¡n trÆ°á»›c Ä‘Ã³.');
            if ($o['status'] !== 'Open') throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ thanh toÃ¡n!');

            $b = $this->calcBill($o['id'], $phone, $voucher);
            if ($b['unfinished'] > 0) throw new Exception("CÃ²n {$b['unfinished']} mÃ³n Báº¿p/Bar chÆ°a lÃ m xong, chÆ°a thá»ƒ thanh toÃ¡n.");
            if ($b['phone_error'])    throw new Exception($b['phone_error']);
            if ($b['voucher_error'])  throw new Exception($b['voucher_error']);
            if ($b['subtotal'] <= 0)  throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n chÆ°a cÃ³ mÃ³n nÃ o Ä‘á»ƒ thanh toÃ¡n. HÃ£y dÃ¹ng chá»©c nÄƒng ÄÃ³ng bÃ n.');

            $cashModel = new CashShiftModel();
            $openShift = $cashModel->getCurrentOpenShift($cashier_id);
            $shiftId   = $openShift ? (int)$openShift['id'] : null;

            $savedVoucherCode = $b['voucher_code'] !== ''
                ? $b['voucher_code']
                : ($b['auto_voucher_code'] ?? null);

            $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE orders
                SET customer_id = COALESCE(?, customer_id),
                    shift_id = COALESCE(?, shift_id),
                    subtotal = ?,
                    area_surcharge_amount = ?,
                    service_charge_amount = ?,
                    discount_amount = ?,
                    voucher_code = ?,
                    deposit_deducted = ?,
                    vat_amount = ?,
                    total_amount = ?,
                    status = 'Paid',
                    closed_at = NOW()
                WHERE id = ?
            ")->execute([
                $b['customer_id'],
                $shiftId,
                $b['subtotal'],
                $b['surcharge'],
                $b['service'],
                $b['discount'],
                $savedVoucherCode,
                $b['deposit_deducted'],
                $b['vat'],
                $b['total'],
                $o['id']
            ]);

            $this->db->prepare("UPDATE order_details SET kds_status = 'Served' WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status = 'Ready'")->execute([$o['id']]);

            $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO payments (order_id, cashier_id, payment_method, amount, transaction_ref) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")
                ->execute([$o['id'], $cashier_id, $payment_method, $b['total'], trim((string)$ref) !== '' ? mb_substr(trim((string)$ref), 0, 100) : null]);

            $this->releaseTableSmart((int)$o['table_id']);

            if (!empty($b['customer_id']) && $b['total'] > 0) {
                $customerModel = new CustomerModel();
                $customerModel->recordPurchase((int)$b['customer_id'], (float)$b['total']);
            }

            if ($payment_method === 'Cash' && $b['total'] > 0 && $openShift) {
                $cashModel->recordSaleTransaction($cashier_id, (float)$b['total'], 'sales');
            }

            $stockModel = new StockModel();
            $bomResult = $stockModel->deductStockByOrder((int)$o['id'], (int)$cashier_id);
            if (empty($bomResult['success'])) {
                throw new Exception($bomResult['message'] ?? 'KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»§ nguyÃªn liá»‡u tá»“n kho Ä‘á»ƒ hoÃ n táº¥t thanh toÃ¡n.');
            }

            $note = 'Thanh toÃ¡n thÃ nh cÃ´ng: ' . number_format($b['total']) . ' VND (' . $payment_method . ')';
            if ($b['tier_discount'] > 0)    $note .= ", giáº£m auto háº¡ng {$b['tier']} ({$b['tier_discount_percent']}%) -" . number_format($b['tier_discount']);
            if ($b['voucher_discount'] > 0) $note .= ", voucher {$b['voucher_code']} -" . number_format($b['voucher_discount']);
            if ($b['deposit_deducted'] > 0) $note .= ", trá»« cá»c -" . number_format($b['deposit_deducted']);
            $this->addLog($o['id'], $cashier_id, 'Checkout', $note);

            $this->db->commit();
            $res = [
                'status'                => 'success',
                'order_id'              => (int)$o['id'],
                'total_amount'          => $b['total'],
                'discount_amount'       => $b['discount'],
                'tier_discount_percent' => $b['tier_discount_percent'],
                'customer_name'         => $b['customer_name'],
                'vietqr_url'            => $b['vietqr_url']
            ];
            if (!empty($bomResult['warnings'])) {
                $res['stock_warnings'] = $bomResult['warnings'];
            }
            return $res;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return $this->fail($e);
        }
    }

    public function closeEmptyOrder($order_id, $user_id) {
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $o = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code, status, table_id, reservation_id FROM orders WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE", [(int)$order_id]);
            if (!$o) throw new Exception('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng!');
            if ($o['status'] !== 'Open') throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã³ng.');
            $n = $this->one("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_details WHERE order_id = ? AND kds_status <> 'Cancelled'", [$o['id']]);
            if ($n['n'] > 0) throw new Exception('ÄÆ¡n váº«n cÃ²n mÃ³n, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘Ã³ng bÃ n. HÃ£y thanh toÃ¡n hoáº·c há»§y mÃ³n trÆ°á»›c.');

            $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET status = 'Cancelled', subtotal = 0, total_amount = 0, closed_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?")->execute([$o['id']]);
            if (!empty($o['reservation_id'])) {
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE reservations SET status = 'Cancelled' WHERE id = ? AND status = 'CheckedIn'")->execute([(int)$o['reservation_id']]);
            }
            $this->releaseTableSmart((int)$o['table_id']);

            $this->addLog($o['id'], $user_id, 'Checkout', "ÄÃ³ng bÃ n khÃ´ng phÃ¡t sinh doanh thu (Ä‘Æ¡n {$o['order_code']} Ä‘Ã£ há»§y háº¿t mÃ³n)");
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'message' => 'ÄÃ£ Ä‘Ã³ng bÃ n, bÃ n sáºµn sÃ ng Ä‘Ã³n khÃ¡ch má»›i'];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return $this->fail($e);
        }
    }

    public function transferTableByTableId($from_table_id, $to_table_id, $user_id, $mode = '') {
        $from_id = (int)$from_table_id;
        $to_id   = (int)$to_table_id;
        if (!$from_id || !$to_id || $from_id === $to_id) return $this->err('BÃ n má»›i pháº£i khÃ¡c bÃ n hiá»‡n táº¡i!');
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $tsql = "SELECT dt.id, dt.table_name, dt.status, a.name AS area_name, a.surcharge_percent
                     FROM dining_tables dt JOIN areas a ON dt.area_id = a.id WHERE dt.id = ? FOR UPDATE";
            if ($from_id < $to_id) { $fromT = $this->one($tsql, [$from_id]); $toT = $this->one($tsql, [$to_id]); }
            else                   { $toT = $this->one($tsql, [$to_id]);     $fromT = $this->one($tsql, [$from_id]); }
            if (!$fromT || !$toT) throw new Exception('BÃ n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i!');

            $fromOrder = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code, guest_count, customer_id, deposit_deducted FROM orders WHERE table_id = ? AND status = 'Open' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE", [$from_id]);
            if (!$fromOrder) throw new Exception('BÃ n nguá»“n hiá»‡n khÃ´ng cÃ³ Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng nÃ o Ä‘ang má»Ÿ!');
            $toOrder = $this->one("SELECT id, order_code FROM orders WHERE table_id = ? AND status = 'Open' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE", [$to_id]);
            if ($mode === '') $mode = $toOrder ? 'merge' : 'transfer';

            if ($mode === 'merge') {
                if (!$toOrder) throw new Exception('BÃ n Ä‘Ã­ch chÆ°a cÃ³ Ä‘Æ¡n Ä‘ang má»Ÿ Ä‘á»ƒ gá»™p. HÃ£y dÃ¹ng Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n.');
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE order_details SET order_id = ? WHERE order_id = ?")->execute([$toOrder['id'], $fromOrder['id']]);
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET guest_count = guest_count + ?, deposit_deducted = deposit_deducted + ?, customer_id = COALESCE(customer_id, ?) WHERE id = ?")
                    ->execute([(int)$fromOrder['guest_count'], (float)$fromOrder['deposit_deducted'], $fromOrder['customer_id'], $toOrder['id']]);
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET status = 'Cancelled', subtotal = 0, total_amount = 0, closed_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?")->execute([$fromOrder['id']]);
                $this->releaseTableSmart($from_id);
                $this->recalcSubtotal($toOrder['id']);
                $msg = 'Gá»™p bÃ n thÃ nh cÃ´ng!';
                $this->addLog($toOrder['id'], $user_id, 'MergeTable',
                    "Gá»™p bÃ n {$fromT['table_name']} (Ä‘Æ¡n {$fromOrder['order_code']}) vÃ o bÃ n {$toT['table_name']} (Ä‘Æ¡n {$toOrder['order_code']}). Phá»¥ thu tÃ­nh theo khu vá»±c {$toT['area_name']} (" . (float)$toT['surcharge_percent'] . '%)');
            } else {
                if ($toOrder || $toT['status'] !== 'Available') {
                    throw new Exception("BÃ n {$toT['table_name']} khÃ´ng trá»‘ng (" . ($toOrder ? 'Ä‘ang cÃ³ khÃ¡ch' : $toT['status']) . '), chá»‰ chuyá»ƒn Ä‘áº¿n bÃ n trá»‘ng!');
                }
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE orders SET table_id = ? WHERE id = ?")->execute([$to_id, $fromOrder['id']]);
                $this->releaseTableSmart($from_id);
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Occupied' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$to_id]);
                $msg = 'Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n thÃ nh cÃ´ng!';
                $this->addLog($fromOrder['id'], $user_id, 'TransferTable',
                    "Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n {$fromT['table_name']} ({$fromT['area_name']}, phá»¥ thu " . (float)$fromT['surcharge_percent'] . "%) sang {$toT['table_name']} ({$toT['area_name']}, phá»¥ thu " . (float)$toT['surcharge_percent'] . '%)');
            }
            $this->db->commit();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'message' => $msg];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return $this->fail($e);
        }
    }

    public function getBillData($order_id) {
        $order = $this->one("SELECT o.*, dt.table_name, a.name AS area_name, u.full_name AS waiter_name,
                                    c.full_name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, c.tier AS customer_tier, c.points AS customer_points
                             FROM orders o
                             JOIN dining_tables dt ON o.table_id = dt.id
                             JOIN areas a ON dt.area_id = a.id
                             LEFT JOIN users u ON o.waiter_id = u.id
                             LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
                             WHERE o.id = ?", [(int)$order_id]);
        if (!$order) return null;
        $details = $this->all("SELECT od.*, mi.name AS item_name, mi.unit
                               FROM order_details od JOIN menu_items mi ON od.menu_item_id = mi.id
                               WHERE od.order_id = ? AND od.kds_status <> 'Cancelled' ORDER BY od.ordered_at, od.id", [$order['id']]);
        return ['order' => $order, 'details' => $details];
    }

    public function getReportByPaymentMethod($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('paid_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT payment_method, COUNT(id) AS transaction_count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_revenue
                           FROM payments WHERE 1=1 $w GROUP BY payment_method", $p);
    }

    public function getTimeShiftReport($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('paid_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(paid_at) < 14 THEN 'Ca sÃ¡ng (Ä‘áº¿n 14h)' WHEN HOUR(paid_at) < 18 THEN 'Ca chiá»u (14hâ€“18h)' ELSE 'Ca tá»‘i (tá»« 18h)' END AS shift_name,
                                  COUNT(id) AS transaction_count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_revenue
                           FROM payments WHERE 1=1 $w GROUP BY shift_name ORDER BY MIN(HOUR(paid_at))", $p);
    }

    public function getCancelLogsReport($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('ol.created_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT ol.id, ol.order_id, o.order_code, dt.table_name, u.full_name AS staff_name, ol.description, ol.created_at
                           FROM order_logs ol
                           LEFT JOIN users u ON ol.user_id = u.id
                           LEFT JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
                           LEFT JOIN dining_tables dt ON o.table_id = dt.id
                           WHERE ol.action_type = 'CancelItem' $w ORDER BY ol.id DESC", $p);
    }

    public function getMoveLogsReport($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('ol.created_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT ol.id, ol.action_type, o.order_code, u.full_name AS staff_name, ol.description, ol.created_at
                           FROM order_logs ol
                           LEFT JOIN users u ON ol.user_id = u.id
                           LEFT JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
                           WHERE ol.action_type IN ('TransferTable', 'MergeTable') $w ORDER BY ol.id DESC", $p);
    }

    public function getShiftRevenueReport($fromDate = null, $toDate = null) {
        [$w, $p] = $this->dateRange('cs.opened_at', $fromDate, $toDate);
        return $this->all("SELECT cs.id AS shift_id, u.full_name AS cashier_name, cs.opened_at, cs.closed_at, cs.opening_cash, cs.total_cash_sales, cs.status,
                  IFNULL((SELECT SUM(x.amount) FROM payments x WHERE x.paid_at >= cs.opened_at AND x.paid_at <= IFNULL(cs.closed_at, NOW())), 0) AS total_revenue,
                  IFNULL((SELECT SUM(x.amount) FROM payments x WHERE x.payment_method = 'Cash' AND x.paid_at >= cs.opened_at AND x.paid_at <= IFNULL(cs.closed_at, NOW())), 0) AS cash_revenue
                           FROM cash_shifts cs JOIN users u ON cs.cashier_id = u.id
                           WHERE 1=1 $w ORDER BY cs.id DESC", $p);
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/Database.php';

class PromotionModel
{
    private PDO $db;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
    }

    public function getAllPromotions(string $keyword = ''): array
    {
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM promotions";
        $params = [];

        if ($keyword !== '') {
            $sql .= " WHERE code LIKE ? OR name LIKE ?";
            $params = ["%$keyword%", "%$keyword%"];
        }

        $sql .= " ORDER BY id DESC";

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function findPromotion(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT * FROM promotions WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);

        $promotion = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        return $promotion ?: null;
    }

    public function savePromotion(array $data, ?int $id = null): bool
    {
        $code = strtoupper(trim($data['code'] ?? ''));
        $name = trim($data['name'] ?? '');
        $type = $data['discount_type'] ?? '';
        $value = (float)($data['discount_value'] ?? 0);
        $maxDiscount = $data['max_discount'] ?? null;
        $minOrder = (float)($data['min_order_value'] ?? 0);
        $minTier = $data['min_tier'] ?? 'Standard';
        $startDate = $data['start_date'] ?? '';
        $endDate = $data['end_date'] ?? '';
        $isActive = isset($data['is_active']) ? 1 : 0;

        if ($code === '' || $name === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p mÃ£ vÃ  tÃªn voucher.');
        }

        if (!preg_match('/^[A-Z0-9_-]{3,30}$/', $code)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('MÃ£ voucher pháº£i cÃ³ 3-30 kÃ½ tá»±, chá»‰ gá»“m chá»¯, sá»‘, dáº¥u gáº¡ch ngang hoáº·c gáº¡ch dÆ°á»›i.');
        }

        if (!in_array($type, ['Percent', 'Fixed'], true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Loáº¡i giáº£m giÃ¡ khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }

        if ($value <= 0 || ($type === 'Percent' && $value > 100)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('GiÃ¡ trá»‹ giáº£m giÃ¡ khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }

        if ($maxDiscount !== null && $maxDiscount !== '' && (float)$maxDiscount < 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Má»©c giáº£m tá»‘i Ä‘a khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }

        if ($minOrder < 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('ÄÆ¡n tá»‘i thiá»ƒu khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }

        if (!in_array($minTier, ['Standard', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Diamond'], true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Háº¡ng thÃ nh viÃªn khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }

        if (!$startDate || !$endDate || strtotime($endDate) < strtotime($startDate)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('NgÃ y káº¿t thÃºc pháº£i sau hoáº·c báº±ng ngÃ y báº¯t Ä‘áº§u.');
        }

        $checkSql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotions WHERE code = ?";
        $checkParams = [$code];

        if ($id !== null) {
            $checkSql .= " AND id <> ?";
            $checkParams[] = $id;
        }

        $check = $this->db->prepare($checkSql);
        $check->execute($checkParams);

        if ((int)$check->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('MÃ£ voucher Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }

        $maxDiscount = ($maxDiscount === '' || $maxDiscount === null)
            ? null
            : (float)$maxDiscount;

        if ($id !== null) {
            $sql = "UPDATE promotions SET
                    code = ?, name = ?, discount_type = ?,
                    discount_value = ?, max_discount = ?,
                    min_order_value = ?, min_tier = ?,
                    start_date = ?, end_date = ?, is_active = ?
                    WHERE id = ?";

            $params = [
                $code, $name, $type, $value, $maxDiscount,
                $minOrder, $minTier, $startDate, $endDate,
                $isActive, $id
            ];
        } else {
            $sql = "INSERT INTO promotions
                    (code, name, discount_type, discount_value,
                     max_discount, min_order_value, min_tier,
                     start_date, end_date, is_active)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";

            $params = [
                $code, $name, $type, $value, $maxDiscount,
                $minOrder, $minTier, $startDate, $endDate,
                $isActive
            ];
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);

        return $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function deletePromotion(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM promotions WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function togglePromotion(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            UPDATE promotions
            SET is_active = IF(is_active = 1, 0, 1)
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function validateVoucher(
        string $code,
        float $orderValue,
        string $customerTier = 'Standard'
    ): array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM promotions
            WHERE code = ?
              AND is_active = 1
              AND NOW() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
            LIMIT 1
        ");

        $stmt->execute([strtoupper(trim($code))]);
        $voucher = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (!$voucher) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'message' => 'Voucher khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i, háº¿t háº¡n hoáº·c Ä‘Ã£ bá»‹ táº¯t.'];
        }

        if ($orderValue < (float)$voucher['min_order_value']) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'message' => 'ÄÆ¡n hÃ ng chÆ°a Ä‘áº¡t giÃ¡ trá»‹ tá»‘i thiá»ƒu.'];
        }

        $tiers = ['Standard' => 0, 'Silver' => 1, 'Gold' => 2, 'Diamond' => 3];

        if (($tiers[$customerTier] ?? 0) < ($tiers[$voucher['min_tier']] ?? 0)) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'message' => 'Háº¡ng thÃ nh viÃªn chÆ°a Ä‘á»§ Ä‘iá»u kiá»‡n sá»­ dá»¥ng voucher.'];
        }

        if ($voucher['discount_type'] === 'Percent') {
            $discount = $orderValue * (float)$voucher['discount_value'] / 100;
            if ($voucher['max_discount'] !== null) {
                $discount = min($discount, (float)$voucher['max_discount']);
            }
        } else {
            $discount = (float)$voucher['discount_value'];
            if ($voucher['max_discount'] !== null) {
                $discount = min($discount, (float)$voucher['max_discount']);
            }
        }

        $discount = round(max(0, min($discount, $orderValue)));

        return [
            'valid' => true,
            'message' => 'Ãp dá»¥ng voucher thÃ nh cÃ´ng.',
            'voucher' => $voucher,
            'discount' => $discount
        ];
    }
}

<?php

class ReservationModel
{

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
        new TableModel();
    }
public function countReservations(): int
    {
        return (int)$this->db->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations")->fetchColumn();
    }

    public function getReservationsPaginated(int $limit, int $offset): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                r.*,
                c.full_name,
                c.phone,
                c.tier,
                t.table_name,
                t.status AS table_status,
                a.name AS area_name,
                (SELECT o.status FROM orders o WHERE o.reservation_id = r.id ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS linked_order_status
            FROM reservations r
            INNER JOIN customers c ON c.id = r.customer_id
            LEFT JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = r.table_id
            LEFT JOIN areas a ON a.id = t.area_id
            ORDER BY r.booking_time DESC
            LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
        ";
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', max(1, $limit), PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':offset', max(0, $offset), PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getAllReservations(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                r.*,
                c.full_name,
                c.phone,
                c.tier,
                t.table_name,
                t.table_type,
                t.capacity,
                a.name AS area_name,
                a.floor_number
            FROM reservations r
            INNER JOIN customers c ON c.id = r.customer_id
            LEFT JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = r.table_id
            LEFT JOIN areas a ON a.id = t.area_id
            ORDER BY r.booking_time DESC
        ";
        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getBookingStatistics(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_bookings,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Pending'), 0) AS pending,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Confirmed'), 0) AS confirmed,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'CheckedIn'), 0) AS checked_in,
                COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Cancelled'), 0) AS cancelled,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CheckedIn' THEN deposit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS checked_in_deposit,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Cancelled' THEN deposit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_deposit
            FROM reservations
        ";
        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getTopVipCustomers(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT id, full_name, phone, tier, points, total_spent
            FROM customers
            ORDER BY total_spent DESC
            LIMIT 10
        ";
        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getAvailableTables(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                t.id,
                t.table_name,
                t.table_type,
                t.capacity,
                t.status,
                a.name AS area_name,
                a.floor_number,
                a.surcharge_percent
            FROM dining_tables t
            INNER JOIN areas a ON a.id = t.area_id
            WHERE t.status IN ('Available', 'Reserved')
            ORDER BY a.floor_number ASC, a.id ASC, FIELD(t.table_type, 'Standard', 'VIP', 'Premium'), t.table_name ASC
        ";
        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function getAvailableTablesForBooking(string $bookingTime, int $guestCount): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                t.id,
                t.table_name,
                t.table_type,
                t.capacity,
                t.status,
                a.name AS area_name,
                a.floor_number,
                a.surcharge_percent
            FROM dining_tables t
            INNER JOIN areas a ON a.id = t.area_id
            WHERE t.status IN ('Available', 'Reserved')
              AND t.capacity >= ?
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM reservations r
                  WHERE r.table_id = t.id
                    AND r.status IN ('Pending', 'Confirmed', 'CheckedIn')
                    AND r.booking_time < DATE_ADD(?, INTERVAL 120 MINUTE)
                    AND DATE_ADD(r.booking_time, INTERVAL 120 MINUTE) > ?
              )
            ORDER BY a.floor_number ASC, a.id ASC, FIELD(t.table_type, 'Standard', 'VIP', 'Premium'), t.table_name ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$guestCount, $bookingTime, $bookingTime]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function findOrCreateCustomer(string $name, string $phone, string $email = ''): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT id FROM customers WHERE phone = ? FOR UPDATE");
        $stmt->execute([$phone]);
        $customer = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if ($customer) {
            $update = $this->db->prepare("
                UPDATE customers
                SET full_name = ?, email = COALESCE(?, email)
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            $update->execute([$name, $email !== '' ? $email : null, $customer['id']]);
            return (int)$customer['id'];
        }

        $insert = $this->db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO customers (full_name, phone, email)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?)
        ");
        $insert->execute([$name, $phone, $email !== '' ? $email : null]);
        return (int)$this->db->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function findTable(int $tableId): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT t.*, a.name AS area_name, a.floor_number, a.surcharge_percent
            FROM dining_tables t
            LEFT JOIN areas a ON a.id = t.area_id
            WHERE t.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$tableId]);
        $table = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $table ?: null;
    }

    public function isTableAvailable(int $tableId, string $bookingTime): bool
    {
        $table = $this->findTable($tableId);
        if (!$table || !in_array($table['status'], ['Available', 'Reserved'], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $sql = "
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM reservations
            WHERE table_id = ?
              AND status IN ('Pending', 'Confirmed', 'CheckedIn')
              AND booking_time < DATE_ADD(?, INTERVAL 120 MINUTE)
              AND DATE_ADD(booking_time, INTERVAL 120 MINUTE) > ?
        ";
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute([$tableId, $bookingTime, $bookingTime]);
        return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn() === 0;
    }

    public function createReservation(array $data): string
    {
        $tableId = (int)($data['table_id'] ?? 0);
        $guestCount = (int)($data['guest_count'] ?? 0);
        $bookingTime = trim((string)($data['booking_time'] ?? ''));
        $phone = trim((string)($data['phone'] ?? ''));
        $name = trim((string)($data['full_name'] ?? ''));
        $email = trim((string)($data['email'] ?? ''));
        $deposit = (float)($data['deposit_amount'] ?? 0);

        if ($name === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p há» vÃ  tÃªn khÃ¡ch hÃ ng.');
        }
        // LUá»’NG LOGIC Báº®T BUá»˜C: SÄT pháº£i báº¯t Ä‘áº§u báº±ng sá»‘ 0 vÃ  cÃ³ tá»« 10 Ä‘áº¿n 11 chá»¯ sá»‘
        if (!preg_match('/^0[0-9]{9,10}$/', $phone)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Sá»‘ Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ (Pháº£i báº¯t Ä‘áº§u báº±ng sá»‘ 0 vÃ  cÃ³ tá»« 10 Ä‘áº¿n 11 chá»¯ sá»‘).');
        }
        if ($email !== '' && !filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Äá»‹a chá»‰ Email khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }
        if ($tableId <= 0 || $guestCount < 1 || $deposit < 0 || $bookingTime === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Vui lÃ²ng nháº­p Ä‘áº§y Ä‘á»§ thÃ´ng tin bÃ n, sá»‘ khÃ¡ch vÃ  thá»i gian Ä‘áº·t.');
        }
        if (strtotime($bookingTime) === false || strtotime($bookingTime) <= time() - 300) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Thá»i gian Ä‘áº·t bÃ n pháº£i náº±m trong tÆ°Æ¡ng lai.');
        }

        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $tStmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT * FROM dining_tables WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE");
            $tStmt->execute([$tableId]);
            $table = $tStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (!$table || !in_array($table['status'], ['Available', 'Reserved'], true)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('BÃ n/PhÃ²ng khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i hoáº·c hiá»‡n khÃ´ng kháº£ dá»¥ng Ä‘á»ƒ Ä‘áº·t.');
            }
            if ($guestCount > (int)$table['capacity']) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng khÃ¡ch ($guestCount) vÆ°á»£t quÃ¡ sá»©c chá»©a tá»‘i Ä‘a cá»§a {$table['table_name']} ({$table['capacity']} gháº¿).");
            }
            if (!$this->isTableAvailable($tableId, $bookingTime)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('BÃ n/PhÃ²ng Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ lá»‹ch Ä‘áº·t trÃ¹ng trong khung giá» nÃ y.');
            }

            // RULE Cá»ŒC Báº®T BUá»˜C: VIP = 5.000.000Ä‘, ThÆ°á»£ng Háº¡ng (Premium) = 10.000.000Ä‘
            $tableType = $table['table_type'] ?? 'Standard';
            if ($tableType === 'VIP') {
                $deposit = (float)TableModel::DEPOSIT_VIP;
            } elseif ($tableType === 'Premium') {
                $deposit = (float)TableModel::DEPOSIT_PREMIUM;
            }

            $customerId = $this->findOrCreateCustomer($name, $phone, $email);
            $bookingCode = 'BK' . date('YmdHis') . random_int(100, 999);

            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                INSERT INTO reservations (
                    booking_code, customer_id, table_id, booking_time,
                    guest_count, deposit_amount, special_request, status
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Pending')
            ");
            $stmt->execute([
                $bookingCode,
                $customerId,
                $tableId,
                $bookingTime,
                $guestCount,
                $deposit,
                $data['special_request'] ?? ''
            ]);

            $this->db->commit();
            return $bookingCode;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function confirmTestDeposit(string $bookingCode): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT id, special_request FROM reservations WHERE booking_code = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$bookingCode]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$row) {
            return false;
        }
        if (strpos((string)$row['special_request'], '[TEST MODE:') === false) {
            $note = trim(($row['special_request'] ?? '') . ' [TEST MODE: ÄÃ£ xÃ¡c nháº­n cá»c mÃ´ phá»ng]');
            $upd = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE reservations SET special_request = ? WHERE id = ?");
            return $upd->execute([$note, (int)$row['id']]);
        }
        return true;
    }

    public function getUpcomingReservedTableIds(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT DISTINCT table_id
            FROM reservations
            WHERE table_id IS NOT NULL
              AND status IN ('Pending', 'Confirmed')
              AND booking_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
        ";
        $stmt = $this->db->query($sql);
        return array_map('intval', $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN));
    }
    
    public function updateReservationStatus(int $id, string $status, int $actorUserId = 1): bool
    {
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $allowed = ['Confirmed', 'CheckedIn', 'Cancelled'];
            if (!in_array($status, $allowed, true)) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
                return false;
            }

            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
                SELECT id, booking_code, customer_id, table_id, booking_time, guest_count, deposit_amount, status
                FROM reservations
                WHERE id = ?
                FOR UPDATE
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$id]);
            $reservation = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (!$reservation) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
                return false;
            }

            $transitions = [
                'Pending'   => ['Confirmed', 'Cancelled'],
                'Confirmed' => ['CheckedIn', 'Cancelled']
            ];
            $current = $reservation['status'];

            if (!isset($transitions[$current]) || !in_array($status, $transitions[$current], true)) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
                return false;
            }

            $tableId = (int)($reservation['table_id'] ?? 0);

            if ($status === 'Confirmed' && $tableId > 0) {
                $tStmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT status FROM dining_tables WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE");
                $tStmt->execute([$tableId]);
                $tRow = $tStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$tRow || $tRow['status'] === 'Cleaning') {
                    $this->db->rollBack();
                    return false;
                }
                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Reserved' WHERE id = ? AND status = 'Available'")->execute([$tableId]);
            } elseif ($status === 'Cancelled' && $tableId > 0) {
                $otherActive = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE table_id = ? AND id <> ? AND status IN ('Pending', 'Confirmed')");
                $otherActive->execute([$tableId, $id]);
                if ((int)$otherActive->fetchColumn() === 0) {
                    $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Available' WHERE id = ? AND status = 'Reserved'")->execute([$tableId]);
                }
            } elseif ($status === 'CheckedIn') {
                if ($tableId <= 0) {
                    $this->db->rollBack();
                    return false;
                }

                $tableStmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT status, table_name, table_type FROM dining_tables WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE");
                $tableStmt->execute([$tableId]);
                $table = $tableStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

                if (!$table || !in_array($table['status'], ['Available', 'Reserved'], true)) {
                    $this->db->rollBack();
                    return false;
                }

                $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = 'Occupied' WHERE id = ?")->execute([$tableId]);

                $openOrderCheck = $this->db->prepare("SELECT id FROM orders WHERE table_id = ? AND status = 'Open' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE");
                $openOrderCheck->execute([$tableId]);
                if (!$openOrderCheck->fetch()) {
                    $orderCode = 'ORD-' . strtoupper(uniqid());
                    $insOrder = $this->db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO orders (
                            order_code, table_id, reservation_id, customer_id, waiter_id,
                            guest_count, deposit_deducted, status, opened_at
                        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Open', NOW())
                    ");
                    $insOrder->execute([
                        $orderCode,
                        $tableId,
                        (int)$reservation['id'],
                        (int)$reservation['customer_id'],
                        $actorUserId,
                        (int)$reservation['guest_count'],
                        (float)$reservation['deposit_amount']
                    ]);
                    $newOrderId = (int)$this->db->lastInsertId();

                    $insLog = $this->db->prepare("
                        INSERT INTO order_logs (order_id, user_id, action_type, description)
                        VALUES (?, ?, 'CreateOrder', ?)
                    ");
                    $insLog->execute([
                        $newOrderId,
                        $actorUserId,
                        "Check-in tá»± Ä‘á»™ng tá»« Booking {$reservation['booking_code']} táº¡i {$table['table_name']} (Cá»c: " . number_format((float)$reservation['deposit_amount']) . "Ä‘)"
                    ]);
                }
            }

            $update = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE reservations SET status = ? WHERE id = ?");
            $update->execute([$status, $id]);

            $this->db->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function getIngredients($search = '', $group_filter = '', $unit_filter = '', $status_filter = '', $limit = 10, $offset = 0) {
        $query = "SELECT ingredients.*, suppliers.name AS supplier_name 
                  FROM ingredients 
                  LEFT JOIN suppliers ON ingredients.supplier_id = suppliers.id 
                  WHERE (ingredients.name LIKE :search1 OR ingredients.ingredient_code LIKE :search2)";
        $params = [':search1' => "%$search%", ':search2' => "%$search%"];

        if (!empty($group_filter)) {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.group_name = :group";
            $params[':group'] = $group_filter;
        }
        if (!empty($unit_filter)) {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.unit = :unit";
            $params[':unit'] = $unit_filter;
        }
        if ($status_filter === 'low') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity <= ingredients.min_stock_level AND ingredients.stock_quantity > 0";
        } elseif ($status_filter === 'safe') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity > ingredients.min_stock_level";
        } elseif ($status_filter === 'out_of_stock') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity <= 0";
        }

        $query .= " ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(ingredients.ingredient_code, 4) AS UNSIGNED) ASC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($query);
        foreach ($params as $key => $val) {
            $stmt->bindValue($key, $val, PDO::PARAM_STR);
        }
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', (int)$limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':offset', (int)$offset, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function countIngredients($search = '', $group_filter = '', $unit_filter = '', $status_filter = '') {
        $query = "SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM ingredients WHERE (name LIKE :search1 OR ingredient_code LIKE :search2)";
        $params = [':search1' => "%$search%", ':search2' => "%$search%"];
        if (!empty($group_filter)) {
            $query .= " AND group_name = :group";
            $params[':group'] = $group_filter;
        }
        if (!empty($unit_filter)) {
            $query .= " AND unit = :unit";
            $params[':unit'] = $unit_filter;
        }
        if ($status_filter === 'low') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity <= ingredients.min_stock_level AND ingredients.stock_quantity > 0";
        } elseif ($status_filter === 'safe') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity > ingredients.min_stock_level";
        } elseif ($status_filter === 'out_of_stock') {
            $query .= " AND ingredients.stock_quantity <= 0";
        }
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($query);
        foreach ($params as $key => $val) {
            $stmt->bindValue($key, $val, PDO::PARAM_STR);
        }
        $stmt->execute();
        return (int)$stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['total'];
    }

    public function createImportReceipt($receiptData, $detailsData) {
        try {
            $this->conn->beginTransaction();

            $sqlReceipt = "INSERT INTO stock_receipts (receipt_code, supplier_id, user_id, receipt_type, total_amount, note, created_at) 
                           VALUES (:receipt_code, :supplier_id, :user_id, 'Import', :total_amount, :note, :created_at)";
            $stmtReceipt = $this->conn->prepare($sqlReceipt);
            $stmtReceipt->execute([
                ':receipt_code' => $receiptData['receipt_code'],
                ':supplier_id'  => $receiptData['supplier_id'],
                ':user_id'      => $receiptData['user_id'],
                ':total_amount' => $receiptData['total_amount'],
                ':note'         => $receiptData['note'],
                ':created_at'   => $receiptData['created_at']
            ]);
            $receiptId = $this->conn->lastInsertId();

            $sqlDetail = "INSERT INTO stock_receipt_details (stock_receipt_id, ingredient_id, quantity, unit_cost) 
                          VALUES (:stock_receipt_id, :ingredient_id, :quantity, :unit_cost)";
            $stmtDetail = $this->conn->prepare($sqlDetail);

            $sqlUpdateStock = "UPDATE ingredients 
                               SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + :quantity, cost_price = :unit_cost 
                               WHERE id = :ingredient_id";
            $stmtUpdateStock = $this->conn->prepare($sqlUpdateStock);

            foreach ($detailsData as $detail) {
                $stmtDetail->execute([
                    ':stock_receipt_id' => $receiptId,
                    ':ingredient_id'    => $detail['ingredient_id'],
                    ':quantity'         => $detail['quantity'],
                    ':unit_cost'        => $detail['unit_cost']
                ]);
                $stmtUpdateStock->execute([
                    ':quantity'      => $detail['quantity'],
                    ':unit_cost'     => $detail['unit_cost'],
                    ':ingredient_id' => $detail['ingredient_id']
                ]);
            }

            if (!empty($receiptData['supplier_id']) && (float)$receiptData['total_amount'] > 0) {
                $this->conn->prepare("UPDATE suppliers SET debt_balance = debt_balance + :amt WHERE id = :sid")
                    ->execute([':amt' => (float)$receiptData['total_amount'], ':sid' => (int)$receiptData['supplier_id']]);
            }

            $this->conn->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            if ($this->conn->inTransaction()) $this->conn->rollBack();
            error_log("Lá»—i LÆ°u Phiáº¿u Nháº­p: " . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function generateNextIngredientCode() {
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(ingredient_code, 4) AS UNSIGNED)) as max_id FROM ingredients WHERE ingredient_code LIKE 'NVL%'");
        $stmt->execute();
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $nextId = ($row['max_id'] ? (int)$row['max_id'] : 0) + 1;
        return 'NVL' . str_pad($nextId, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    }

    public function countReceiptHistory($search = '', $type = '', $date_filter = '') {
        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM stock_receipts r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE 1=1";
        if (!empty($search)) $sql .= " AND (r.receipt_code LIKE :search_code OR u.full_name LIKE :search_name)";
        if (!empty($type)) {
            if ($type === 'Import') $sql .= " AND r.receipt_type = 'Import'";
            elseif ($type === 'Export' || strtolower($type) === 'export') $sql .= " AND r.receipt_type IN ('Export_Sale', 'Export_Damage')";
            elseif ($type === 'Audit_Adjust') $sql .= " AND r.receipt_type = 'Audit_Adjust'";
            else $sql .= " AND r.receipt_type = :type";
        }
        if ($date_filter === 'today') $sql .= " AND DATE(r.created_at) = CURDATE()";
        $stmt = $this->conn->prepare($sql);
        if (!empty($search)) {
            $stmt->bindValue(':search_code', "%$search%");
            $stmt->bindValue(':search_name', "%$search%");
        }
        if (!empty($type) && !in_array($type, ['Import', 'Export', 'export', 'Audit_Adjust'], true)) {
            $stmt->bindValue(':type', $type);
        }
        $stmt->execute();
        return (int)$stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['total'];
    }
