    public function createExportReceipt($receiptData, $detailsData) {
        try {
            $this->conn->beginTransaction();
            $sqlReceipt = "INSERT INTO stock_receipts (receipt_code, supplier_id, user_id, receipt_type, total_amount, note, created_at) 
                           VALUES (:receipt_code, NULL, :user_id, :receipt_type, :total_amount, :note, :created_at)";
            $stmtReceipt = $this->conn->prepare($sqlReceipt);
            $stmtReceipt->execute([
                ':receipt_code' => $receiptData['receipt_code'],
                ':user_id'      => $receiptData['user_id'],
                ':receipt_type' => $receiptData['receipt_type'] ?? 'Export_Sale',
                ':total_amount' => $receiptData['total_amount'],
                ':note'         => $receiptData['note'],
                ':created_at'   => $receiptData['created_at']
            ]);
            $receiptId = $this->conn->lastInsertId();

            $sqlDetail = "INSERT INTO stock_receipt_details (stock_receipt_id, ingredient_id, quantity, unit_cost) 
                          VALUES (:stock_receipt_id, :ingredient_id, :quantity, :unit_cost)";
            $stmtDetail = $this->conn->prepare($sqlDetail);

            $sqlUpdateStock = "UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - :qty_sub WHERE id = :ingredient_id AND stock_quantity >= :qty_check";
            $stmtUpdateStock = $this->conn->prepare($sqlUpdateStock);

            foreach ($detailsData as $detail) {
                $stmtUpdateStock->execute([
                    ':qty_sub'       => $detail['quantity'],
                    ':qty_check'     => $detail['quantity'],
                    ':ingredient_id' => $detail['ingredient_id']
                ]);
                if ($stmtUpdateStock->rowCount() == 0) {
                    throw new Exception("NguyÃªn liá»‡u ID " . $detail['ingredient_id'] . " khÃ´ng Ä‘á»§ sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng trong kho Ä‘á»ƒ xuáº¥t!");
                }
                $stmtDetail->execute([
                    ':stock_receipt_id' => $receiptId,
                    ':ingredient_id'    => $detail['ingredient_id'],
                    ':quantity'         => $detail['quantity'],
                    ':unit_cost'        => $detail['unit_cost']
                ]);
            }
            $this->conn->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->conn->inTransaction()) $this->conn->rollBack();
            error_log("Lá»—i LÆ°u Phiáº¿u Xuáº¥t: " . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function createAuditReceipt($receiptData, $auditDetails) {
        try {
            $this->conn->beginTransaction();
            $sqlReceipt = "INSERT INTO stock_receipts (receipt_code, supplier_id, user_id, receipt_type, total_amount, note, created_at) 
                           VALUES (:receipt_code, NULL, :user_id, 'Audit_Adjust', 0, :note, :created_at)";
            $stmtReceipt = $this->conn->prepare($sqlReceipt);
            $stmtReceipt->execute([
                ':receipt_code' => $receiptData['receipt_code'],
                ':user_id'      => $receiptData['user_id'],
                ':note'         => $receiptData['note'],
                ':created_at'   => $receiptData['created_at']
            ]);
            $receiptId = $this->conn->lastInsertId();

            $stmtUpdateStock = $this->conn->prepare("UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = :actual_qty WHERE id = :ingredient_id");
            $stmtDetail = $this->conn->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_receipt_details (stock_receipt_id, ingredient_id, quantity, unit_cost, reason) VALUES (:stock_receipt_id, :ingredient_id, :quantity, :unit_cost, :reason)");

            foreach ($auditDetails as $detail) {
                $stmtUpdateStock->execute([
                    ':actual_qty'    => $detail['actual_qty'],
                    ':ingredient_id' => $detail['ingredient_id']
                ]);
                $stmtDetail->execute([
                    ':stock_receipt_id' => $receiptId,
                    ':ingredient_id'    => $detail['ingredient_id'],
                    ':quantity'         => $detail['difference'],
                    ':unit_cost'        => $detail['unit_cost'],
                    ':reason'           => $detail['reason'] ?? ''
                ]);
            }
            $this->conn->commit();
            return $receiptId;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->conn->inTransaction()) $this->conn->rollBack();
            error_log("Lá»—i LÆ°u Phiáº¿u Kiá»ƒm KÃª: " . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function deductStockByOrder($order_id, $user_id = 2, bool $enforceSufficientStock = true) {
        $dbConn = $this->conn ?? Database::getConnection();
        $ownTx = !$dbConn->inTransaction();
        if ($ownTx) {
            $dbConn->beginTransaction();
        }
        try {
            $order_id = (int)$order_id;
            $note = "Xuáº¥t kho tá»± Ä‘á»™ng cho hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n bÃ¡n hÃ ng #" . $order_id;
            $chk = $dbConn->prepare("
                SELECT id, receipt_code
                FROM stock_receipts
                WHERE receipt_type = 'Export_Sale' AND (note = :note OR order_id = :order_id)
                LIMIT 1
                FOR UPDATE
            ");
            $chk->execute([':note' => $note, ':order_id' => $order_id]);
            $existing = $chk->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if ($existing) {
                if ($ownTx) $dbConn->rollBack();
                return ['success' => true, 'duplicate' => true, 'receipt_code' => $existing['receipt_code'], 'warnings' => []];
            }

            $stmtOrder = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT menu_item_id, quantity FROM order_details WHERE order_id = :order_id AND kds_status <> 'Cancelled'");
            $stmtOrder->execute([':order_id' => $order_id]);
            $orderDetails = $stmtOrder->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (empty($orderDetails)) {
                if ($ownTx) $dbConn->rollBack();
                return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'ÄÆ¡n hÃ ng nÃ y trá»‘ng hoáº·c khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.'];
            }

            $ingredientsToDeduct = [];
            $stmtBom = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT ingredient_id, quantity_required, COALESCE(wastage_percent, 0) AS wastage_percent FROM recipes_bom WHERE menu_item_id = :menu_item_id");

            foreach ($orderDetails as $item) {
                $stmtBom->execute([':menu_item_id' => $item['menu_item_id']]);
                $boms = $stmtBom->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                foreach ($boms as $bom) {
                    $ing_id = (int)$bom['ingredient_id'];
                    $wastageFactor = 1 + ((float)$bom['wastage_percent'] / 100.0);
                    $total_req = round((float)$bom['quantity_required'] * (int)$item['quantity'] * $wastageFactor, 2);
                    $ingredientsToDeduct[$ing_id] = ($ingredientsToDeduct[$ing_id] ?? 0) + $total_req;
                }
            }

            if (empty($ingredientsToDeduct)) {
                if ($ownTx) $dbConn->rollBack();
                return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'CÃ¡c mÃ³n trong Ä‘Æ¡n khÃ´ng cáº§n trá»« Ä‘á»‹nh lÆ°á»£ng nguyÃªn liá»‡u.', 'warnings' => []];
            }

            $stmtCheckAlert = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT id, name, stock_quantity, min_stock_level, unit, cost_price FROM ingredients WHERE id = :ingredient_id FOR UPDATE");
            $lockedIngredients = [];
            foreach ($ingredientsToDeduct as $ing_id => $deduct_qty) {
                $stmtCheckAlert->execute([':ingredient_id' => $ing_id]);
                $ingData = $stmtCheckAlert->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                if (!$ingData) {
                    throw new Exception("NguyÃªn liá»‡u ID #$ing_id khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.");
                }
                if ($enforceSufficientStock && (float)$ingData['stock_quantity'] < $deduct_qty) {
                    throw new Exception("KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»§ tá»“n kho nguyÃªn liá»‡u [{$ingData['name']}]: cáº§n {$deduct_qty} {$ingData['unit']}, hiá»‡n cÃ²n {$ingData['stock_quantity']} {$ingData['unit']}.");
                }
                $lockedIngredients[$ing_id] = $ingData;
            }

            $receipt_code = 'VX' . date('ymdHis') . random_int(10, 99);
            $stmtReceipt = $dbConn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO stock_receipts (receipt_code, user_id, order_id, receipt_type, total_amount, note, created_at)
                VALUES (:code, :user_id, :order_id, 'Export_Sale', 0, :note, NOW())
            ");
            $stmtReceipt->execute([':code' => $receipt_code, ':user_id' => $user_id, ':order_id' => $order_id, ':note' => $note]);
            $receipt_id = $dbConn->lastInsertId();

            $stmtInsertDetail = $dbConn->prepare("INSERT INTO stock_receipt_details (stock_receipt_id, ingredient_id, quantity, unit_cost) VALUES (:receipt_id, :ingredient_id, :quantity, :unit_cost)");
            $stmtUpdateStock = $dbConn->prepare("UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - :deduct_qty WHERE id = :ingredient_id");

            $warnings = [];
            $totalCogs = 0;

            foreach ($ingredientsToDeduct as $ing_id => $deduct_qty) {
                $ingData = $lockedIngredients[$ing_id];
                $unitCost = (float)$ingData['cost_price'];
                $totalCogs += ($deduct_qty * $unitCost);

                $stmtInsertDetail->execute([
                    ':receipt_id'    => $receipt_id,
                    ':ingredient_id' => $ing_id,
                    ':quantity'      => $deduct_qty,
                    ':unit_cost'     => $unitCost
                ]);

                $stmtUpdateStock->execute([
                    ':deduct_qty'    => $deduct_qty,
                    ':ingredient_id' => $ing_id
                ]);

                $remaining = (float)$ingData['stock_quantity'] - $deduct_qty;
                if ($remaining <= (float)$ingData['min_stock_level']) {
                    $warnings[] = "NguyÃªn liá»‡u [{$ingData['name']}] sáº¯p háº¿t (CÃ²n: {$remaining} {$ingData['unit']})";
                }
            }

            $dbConn->prepare("UPDATE stock_receipts SET total_amount = ? WHERE id = ?")->execute([$totalCogs, $receipt_id]);
            if ($ownTx) {
                $dbConn->commit();
            }
            return ['success' => true, 'receipt_code' => $receipt_code, 'warnings' => $warnings];
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($ownTx && $dbConn->inTransaction()) {
                $dbConn->rollBack();
            }
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }

    public function getInventoryAndProfitReport($startDate, $endDate) {
        $dbConn = $this->conn ?? Database::getConnection();
        $start = !empty($startDate) ? date('Y-m-d 00:00:00', strtotime($startDate)) : '2020-01-01 00:00:00';
        $end   = !empty($endDate) ? date('Y-m-d 23:59:59', strtotime($endDate)) : '2030-12-31 23:59:59';

        $sqlXNT = "SELECT 
                    i.id, i.name, i.unit, i.cost_price,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.receipt_type = 'Import' AND sr.created_at BETWEEN :start1 AND :end1 THEN srd.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_imported,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.receipt_type LIKE 'Export%' AND sr.created_at BETWEEN :start2 AND :end2 THEN srd.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_exported
                   FROM ingredients i
                   LEFT JOIN stock_receipt_details srd ON i.id = srd.ingredient_id
                   LEFT JOIN stock_receipts sr ON srd.stock_receipt_id = sr.id
                   GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.unit, i.cost_price";
        $stmt = $dbConn->prepare($sqlXNT);
        $stmt->execute([':start1' => $start, ':end1' => $end, ':start2' => $start, ':end2' => $end]);
        $reportData = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        $totalCostOfGoodsSold = 0;
        foreach ($reportData as $row) {
            $totalCostOfGoodsSold += ((float)$row['total_exported'] * (float)$row['cost_price']);
        }

        $stmtRev = $dbConn->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE paid_at BETWEEN :start AND :end");
        $stmtRev->execute([':start' => $start, ':end' => $end]);
        $totalRevenue = (float)$stmtRev->fetchColumn();

        $grossProfit = $totalRevenue - $totalCostOfGoodsSold;
        $foodCostPercentage = ($totalRevenue > 0) ? ($totalCostOfGoodsSold / $totalRevenue) * 100 : 0;

        return [
            'items' => $reportData,
            'summary' => [
                'total_revenue'        => $totalRevenue,
                'total_cogs'           => $totalCostOfGoodsSold,
                'gross_profit'         => $grossProfit,
                'food_cost_percentage' => round($foodCostPercentage, 2)
            ]
        ];
    }

    public function deleteReceiptWithRevert($receiptId, $receiptType) {
        try {
            $this->conn->beginTransaction();
            $receipt = $this->getReceiptById($receiptId);
            if (!$receipt) {
                $this->conn->rollBack();
                return false;
            }
            $stmt = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT ingredient_id, quantity FROM stock_receipt_details WHERE stock_receipt_id = :id");
            $stmt->execute([':id' => $receiptId]);
            $details = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            foreach ($details as $detail) {
                $ingId = (int)$detail['ingredient_id'];
                $qty   = (float)$detail['quantity'];
                $lockIng = $this->conn->prepare("SELECT stock_quantity FROM ingredients WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE");
                $lockIng->execute([$ingId]);
                $currStock = (float)$lockIng->fetchColumn();

                if ($receiptType === 'Import') {
                    if ($currStock < $qty) {
                        throw new Exception("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ há»§y phiáº¿u nháº­p vÃ¬ nguyÃªn liá»‡u Ä‘Ã£ xuáº¥t dÃ¹ng.");
                    }
                    $this->conn->prepare("UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - ? WHERE id = ?")
                        ->execute([$qty, $ingId]);
                } elseif (strpos($receiptType, 'Export') === 0) {
                    $this->conn->prepare("UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + ? WHERE id = ?")
                        ->execute([$qty, $ingId]);
                } elseif ($receiptType === 'Audit_Adjust') {
                    $this->conn->prepare("UPDATE ingredients SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - ? WHERE id = ?")
                        ->execute([$qty, $ingId]);
                }
            }

            if ($receiptType === 'Import' && !empty($receipt['supplier_id']) && (float)$receipt['total_amount'] > 0) {
                $this->conn->prepare("UPDATE suppliers SET debt_balance = GREATEST(0, debt_balance - ?) WHERE id = ?")
                    ->execute([(float)$receipt['total_amount'], (int)$receipt['supplier_id']]);
            }

            $this->conn->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_receipt_details WHERE stock_receipt_id = :id")->execute([':id' => $receiptId]);
            $this->conn->prepare("DELETE FROM stock_receipts WHERE id = :id")->execute([':id' => $receiptId]);
            $this->conn->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            if ($this->conn->inTransaction()) $this->conn->rollBack();
            error_log("Lá»—i Há»§y Phiáº¿u: " . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/Database.php';

class TableModel
{
    private PDO $db;

    public const DEPOSIT_VIP     = 5000000;  // 5.000.000Ä‘ cho PhÃ²ng VIP
    public const DEPOSIT_PREMIUM = 10000000; // 10.000.000Ä‘ cho PhÃ²ng ThÆ°á»£ng Háº¡ng / President
    public const ALLOWED_CAPACITIES = [4, 8, 12];
    public const ALLOWED_TYPES = ['Standard', 'VIP', 'Premium'];

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->db = Database::getConnection();
        $this->ensureSchemaAndEncoding();
    }

    private function ensureSchemaAndEncoding(): void
    {
        try {
            $colFloor = $this->db->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM areas LIKE 'floor_number'")->fetch();
            if (!$colFloor) {
                $this->db->exec("ALTER TABLE areas ADD COLUMN floor_number INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 AFTER id");
            }

            $colType = $this->db->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM dining_tables LIKE 'table_type'")->fetch();
            if (!$colType) {
                $this->db->exec("ALTER TABLE dining_tables ADD COLUMN table_type ENUM('Standard', 'VIP', 'Premium') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Standard' AFTER table_name");
            }

            // Sá»­a lá»—i font chá»¯ tiáº¿ng Viá»‡t trong báº£ng areas náº¿u cÃ³
            $corrupted = $this->db->query("SELECT id, name FROM areas WHERE name LIKE '%?%'")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            foreach ($corrupted as $row) {
                $id = (int)$row['id'];
                if ($id === 1 || stripos($row['name'], 'Giao') !== false) {
                    $this->db->prepare("UPDATE areas SET name = 'Sáº£nh Giao HÆ°á»Ÿng', floor_number = 1 WHERE id = ?")->execute([$id]);
                } elseif ($id === 2 || stripos($row['name'], 'VIP') !== false) {
                    $this->db->prepare("UPDATE areas SET name = 'Khu PhÃ²ng VIP Háº§m RÆ°á»£u', floor_number = 1 WHERE id = ?")->execute([$id]);
                } elseif (stripos($row['name'], 'Presidential') !== false || stripos($row['name'], 'Th') !== false) {
                    $this->db->prepare("UPDATE areas SET name = 'Khu President ThÆ°á»£ng Háº¡ng', floor_number = 1 WHERE id = ?")->execute([$id]);
                } else {
                    $clean = trim(str_replace('?', '', $row['name']));
                    $this->db->prepare("UPDATE areas SET name = ? WHERE id = ?")->execute(['Khu vá»±c ' . $id . ' ' . $clean, $id]);
                }
            }

            $this->db->exec("UPDATE dining_tables SET table_type = 'VIP' WHERE (table_name LIKE 'VIP%' OR table_name LIKE '%VIP%') AND table_type = 'Standard'");
            $this->db->exec("UPDATE dining_tables SET table_type = 'Premium' WHERE (table_name LIKE 'PRES%' OR table_name LIKE 'SUP%' OR table_name LIKE '%PRESIDENT%') AND table_type = 'Standard'");
            $this->db->exec("UPDATE dining_tables SET capacity = 8 WHERE capacity NOT IN (4, 8, 12) AND capacity BETWEEN 5 AND 10");
            $this->db->exec("UPDATE dining_tables SET capacity = 12 WHERE capacity NOT IN (4, 8, 12) AND capacity > 10");
            $this->db->exec("UPDATE dining_tables SET capacity = 4 WHERE capacity NOT IN (4, 8, 12)");
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            error_log('[TableModel::ensureSchemaAndEncoding] ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    public static function calculateDepositByTable(array $table, int $guestCount = 4): float
    {
        $type = $table['table_type'] ?? 'Standard';
        if ($type === 'Premium') {
            return (float)self::DEPOSIT_PREMIUM;
        }
        if ($type === 'VIP') {
            return (float)self::DEPOSIT_VIP;
        }
        return match (true) {
            $guestCount <= 4  => 50000.0,
            $guestCount <= 8  => 100000.0,
            $guestCount <= 12 => 150000.0,
            default           => 200000.0
        };
    }

    /**
     * Láº¥y toÃ n bá»™ danh sÃ¡ch bÃ n kÃ¨m tráº¡ng thÃ¡i thá»±c táº¿ theo NGÃ€Y ÄÆ¯á»¢C CHá»ŒN ($selectedDate)
     */
    public function getAllTables(?int $floor = null, ?int $areaId = null, ?string $selectedDate = null): array
    {
        $selectedDate = ($selectedDate && preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $selectedDate))
            ? $selectedDate
            : date('Y-m-d');
        $isToday = ($selectedDate === date('Y-m-d'));

        $whereParts = [];
        $params = [];

        if ($floor !== null && $floor > 0) {
            $whereParts[] = 'a.floor_number = ?';
            $params[] = $floor;
        }
        if ($areaId !== null && $areaId > 0) {
            $whereParts[] = 'a.id = ?';
            $params[] = $areaId;
        }
        $whereSql = $whereParts ? ('WHERE ' . implode(' AND ', $whereParts)) : '';

        $sql = "
            SELECT
                a.id AS area_id,
                a.floor_number,
                a.name AS area_name,
                a.surcharge_percent,
                t.id AS table_id,
                t.table_name,
                t.table_type,
                t.capacity,
                t.status,
                o.id AS active_order_id,
                o.order_code AS active_order_code,
                o.guest_count AS active_guests,
                o.subtotal AS active_subtotal,
                o.opened_at AS active_opened_at,
                u.full_name AS waiter_name
            FROM areas a
            LEFT JOIN dining_tables t ON t.area_id = a.id
            LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.table_id = t.id AND o.status = 'Open'
            LEFT JOIN users u ON o.waiter_id = u.id
            $whereSql
            ORDER BY a.floor_number ASC, a.id ASC, FIELD(t.table_type, 'Standard', 'VIP', 'Premium'), t.table_name ASC
        ";
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        // Láº¥y cÃ¡c lá»‹ch Ä‘áº·t bÃ n trong ngÃ y $selectedDate
        $stmtRes = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT
                r.*,
                c.full_name AS customer_name,
                c.phone AS customer_phone
            FROM reservations r
            INNER JOIN customers c ON c.id = r.customer_id
            WHERE DATE(r.booking_time) = ?
              AND r.status IN ('Pending', 'Confirmed', 'CheckedIn')
            ORDER BY FIELD(r.status, 'CheckedIn', 'Confirmed', 'Pending'), r.booking_time ASC
        ");
        $stmtRes->execute([$selectedDate]);
        $reservationsByTable = [];
        foreach ($stmtRes->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $resRow) {
            $tid = (int)($resRow['table_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($tid > 0 && !isset($reservationsByTable[$tid])) {
                $reservationsByTable[$tid] = $resRow;
            }
        }

        // Gáº¯n tráº¡ng thÃ¡i hiá»ƒn thá»‹ theo ngÃ y (effective_status: Available | Reserved | Occupied)
        foreach ($rows as &$r) {
            $tid = (int)($r['table_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($tid <= 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $dayBooking = $reservationsByTable[$tid] ?? null;
            $r['day_booking'] = $dayBooking;

            if ($isToday && ($r['status'] === 'Occupied' || !empty($r['active_order_id']) || ($dayBooking && $dayBooking['status'] === 'CheckedIn'))) {
                $r['effective_status'] = 'Occupied'; // Äang dÃ¹ng
            } elseif ($dayBooking !== null || ($isToday && $r['status'] === 'Reserved')) {
                $r['effective_status'] = 'Reserved'; // ÄÃ£ Ä‘áº·t trong ngÃ y nÃ y
            } else {
                $r['effective_status'] = 'Available'; // Trá»‘ng trong ngÃ y nÃ y
            }
        }
        unset($r);

        return $rows;
    }

    public function getFloorsSummary(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                a.floor_number,
                COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS area_count,
                COUNT(t.id) AS total_units,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.table_type = 'Standard'), 0) AS standard_tables,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.table_type = 'VIP'), 0) AS vip_rooms,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.table_type = 'Premium'), 0) AS premium_rooms
            FROM areas a
            LEFT JOIN dining_tables t ON t.area_id = a.id
            GROUP BY a.floor_number
            ORDER BY a.floor_number ASC
        ";
        $rows = $this->db->query($sql)->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (empty($rows)) {
            return [[
                'floor_number' => 1,
                'area_count' => 0,
                'total_units' => 0,
                'standard_tables' => 0,
                'vip_rooms' => 0,
                'premium_rooms' => 0
            ]];
        }
        return $rows;
    }

    public function syncTotalFloors(int $targetFloors): void
    {
        if ($targetFloors < 1 || $targetFloors > 20) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng táº§ng pháº£i tá»« 1 Ä‘áº¿n 20.');
        }

        for ($f = 1; $f <= $targetFloors; $f++) {
            $chk = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM areas WHERE floor_number = ?");
            $chk->execute([$f]);
            if ((int)$chk->fetchColumn() === 0) {
                $defaultName = "Táº§ng $f - Sáº£nh Chung";
                $ins = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO areas (floor_number, name, surcharge_percent, description) VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?)");
                $ins->execute([$f, $defaultName, "KhÃ´ng gian phá»¥c vá»¥ táº¡i Táº§ng $f"]);
            }
        }

        $stmtCheck = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT COUNT(t.id)
            FROM areas a
            INNER JOIN dining_tables t ON t.area_id = a.id
            WHERE a.floor_number > ?
        ");
        $stmtCheck->execute([$targetFloors]);
        if ((int)$stmtCheck->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ giáº£m xuá»‘ng $targetFloors táº§ng vÃ¬ cÃ¡c táº§ng cao hÆ¡n Ä‘ang cÃ³ bÃ n/phÃ²ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng.");
        }

        $del = $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM areas WHERE floor_number > ?");
        $del->execute([$targetFloors]);
    }

    public function getTableStatistics(?int $floor = null): array
    {
        $where = '';
        $params = [];
        if ($floor !== null && $floor > 0) {
            $where = 'WHERE a.floor_number = ?';
            $params[] = $floor;
        }

        $sql = "
            SELECT
                COUNT(t.id) AS total,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.status = 'Available'), 0) AS available,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.status = 'Occupied'), 0) AS occupied,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.status = 'Reserved'), 0) AS reserved,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.status = 'Cleaning'), 0) AS cleaning,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.table_type = 'Standard'), 0) AS standard_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.table_type = 'VIP'), 0) AS vip_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.table_type = 'Premium'), 0) AS premium_count
            FROM dining_tables t
            INNER JOIN areas a ON a.id = t.area_id
            $where
        ";
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [
            'total' => 0, 'available' => 0, 'occupied' => 0, 'reserved' => 0, 'cleaning' => 0,
            'standard_count' => 0, 'vip_count' => 0, 'premium_count' => 0
        ];
    }

    public function getAreas(): array
    {
        $sql = "
            SELECT
                a.id,
                a.floor_number,
                a.name,
                a.surcharge_percent,
                COUNT(t.id) AS table_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.table_type = 'Standard'), 0) AS standard_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.table_type = 'VIP'), 0) AS vip_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(t.table_type = 'Premium'), 0) AS premium_count
            FROM areas a
            LEFT JOIN dining_tables t ON t.area_id = a.id
            GROUP BY a.id, a.floor_number, a.name, a.surcharge_percent
            ORDER BY a.floor_number ASC, a.id ASC
        ";
        return $this->db->query($sql)->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function findArea(int $areaId): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT * FROM areas WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$areaId]);
        $area = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $area ?: null;
    }

    public function addArea(string $name, float $surcharge, int $floorNumber = 1): bool
    {
        $name = trim($name);
        if ($name === '' || $surcharge < 0 || $surcharge > 100 || $floorNumber < 1 || $floorNumber > 20) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('TÃªn khu vá»±c, sá»‘ táº§ng hoáº·c phá»¥ thu khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }
        $chk = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM areas WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(?)");
        $chk->execute([$name]);
        if ((int)$chk->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('TÃªn khu vá»±c Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO areas (floor_number, name, surcharge_percent) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
        return $stmt->execute([$floorNumber, $name, $surcharge]);
    }

    public function updateArea(int $id, string $name, float $surcharge, int $floorNumber = 1): bool
    {
        $name = trim($name);
        if (!$this->findArea($id)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Khu vá»±c khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }
        if ($name === '' || $surcharge < 0 || $surcharge > 100 || $floorNumber < 1 || $floorNumber > 20) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('ThÃ´ng tin khu vá»±c hoáº·c táº§ng khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }
        $chk = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM areas WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(?) AND id <> ?");
        $chk->execute([$name, $id]);
        if ((int)$chk->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('TÃªn khu vá»±c Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE areas SET floor_number = ?, name = ?, surcharge_percent = ? WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$floorNumber, $name, $surcharge, $id]);
    }

    public function deleteArea(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dining_tables WHERE area_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        if ((int)$stmt->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a khu vá»±c Ä‘ang cÃ³ bÃ n hoáº·c phÃ²ng liÃªn káº¿t.');
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM areas WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function addTable(int $areaId, string $name, int $capacity, string $tableType = 'Standard'): bool
    {
        $name = trim($name);
        if (!$this->findArea($areaId)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Khu vá»±c Ä‘Ã£ chá»n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }
        if (!in_array($tableType, self::ALLOWED_TYPES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Loáº¡i bÃ n/phÃ²ng khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }
        if ($name === '' || !in_array($capacity, self::ALLOWED_CAPACITIES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('TÃªn bÃ n khÃ´ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c trá»‘ng vÃ  sá»©c chá»©a pháº£i thuá»™c 4, 8 hoáº·c 12 gháº¿.');
        }
        $dup = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dining_tables WHERE LOWER(table_name) = LOWER(?)");
        $dup->execute([$name]);
        if ((int)$dup->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("MÃ£ bÃ n/phÃ²ng '$name' Ä‘Ã£ tá»“n táº¡i.");
        }

        $qrToken = 'QR_' . strtoupper(preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9]/', '', $name)) . '_' . random_int(1000, 9999);
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            INSERT INTO dining_tables (area_id, table_name, table_type, capacity, qr_token, status)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Available')
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$areaId, $name, $tableType, $capacity, $qrToken]);
    }

    public function updateTable(int $id, int $areaId, string $name, int $capacity, string $tableType = 'Standard'): bool
    {
        $name = trim($name);
        if (!$this->findTable($id)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('BÃ n/PhÃ²ng cáº§n sá»­a khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }
        if (!$this->findArea($areaId)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Khu vá»±c Ä‘Ã£ chá»n khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }
        if (!in_array($tableType, self::ALLOWED_TYPES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Loáº¡i bÃ n/phÃ²ng khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡.');
        }
        if ($name === '' || !in_array($capacity, self::ALLOWED_CAPACITIES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Sá»©c chá»©a báº¯t buá»™c lÃ  4, 8 hoáº·c 12 gháº¿.');
        }
        $dup = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dining_tables WHERE LOWER(table_name) = LOWER(?) AND id <> ?");
        $dup->execute([$name, $id]);
        if ((int)$dup->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("MÃ£ bÃ n/phÃ²ng '$name' Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c sá»­ dá»¥ng.");
        }

        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            UPDATE dining_tables
            SET area_id = ?, table_name = ?, table_type = ?, capacity = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$areaId, $name, $tableType, $capacity, $id]);
    }

    public function deleteTable(int $id): bool
    {
        $table = $this->findTable($id);
        if (!$table) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('BÃ n/PhÃ²ng khÃ´ng tá»“n táº¡i.');
        }
        $openOrd = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE table_id = ? AND status = 'Open'");
        $openOrd->execute([$id]);
        if ((int)$openOrd->fetchColumn() > 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a bÃ n/phÃ²ng Ä‘ang cÃ³ hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n POS má»Ÿ.');
        }
        try {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM dining_tables WHERE id = ?");
            return $stmt->execute([$id]);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('BÃ n/PhÃ²ng nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ lá»‹ch sá»­ Ä‘áº·t bÃ n hoáº·c hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ xÃ³a vÄ©nh viá»…n.');
        }
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $id, string $status): bool
    {
        $allowedStatuses = ['Available', 'Occupied', 'Reserved', 'Cleaning'];
        if (!in_array($status, $allowedStatuses, true)) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($status !== 'Occupied') {
            $openOrder = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE table_id = ? AND status = 'Open'");
            $openOrder->execute([$id]);
            if ((int)$openOrder->fetchColumn() > 0) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('BÃ n Ä‘ang cÃ³ hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n POS chÆ°a thanh toÃ¡n, khÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘á»•i tráº¡ng thÃ¡i thá»§ cÃ´ng.');
            }
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE dining_tables SET status = ? WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$status, $id]);
    }

    public function findTable(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("
            SELECT t.*, a.name AS area_name, a.floor_number, a.surcharge_percent
            FROM dining_tables t
            LEFT JOIN areas a ON a.id = t.area_id
            WHERE t.id = ?
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $table = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $table ?: null;
    }
}

function assertCheck(bool $condition, string $step, string $detail = ''): void {
    global $passed, $failed;
    if ($condition) {
        echo " [PASS] $step" . ($detail !== '' ? " -> $detail" : "") . "\n";
        $passed++;
    } else {
        echo " [FAIL] $step" . ($detail !== '' ? " -> $detail" : "") . "\n";
        $failed++;
    }
}

function renderCustChairsLight(int $capacity): array {
    $cap = in_array($capacity, [4, 8, 12], true) ? $capacity : 4;
    if ($cap === 4) return ['top' => 2, 'bottom' => 2, 'side' => 0];
    if ($cap === 8) return ['top' => 3, 'bottom' => 3, 'side' => 1];
    return ['top' => 5, 'bottom' => 5, 'side' => 1];
}

<script>
const CUST_SELECTED_DATE = <?= json_encode($selectedDate) ?>;

function handleCustomerPick(tableId, tableName, tableType, capacity, deposit, effStatus) {
    if (effStatus !== 'Available') {
        alert('BÃ n/PhÃ²ng [' + tableName + '] Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ khÃ¡ch Ä‘áº·t hoáº·c Ä‘ang sá»­ dá»¥ng trong ngÃ y nÃ y. QuÃ½ khÃ¡ch vui lÃ²ng chá»n bÃ n Ä‘ang Trá»‘ng!');
        return;
    }

    document.getElementById('custModalTitle').textContent = 'Äáº·t chá»—: ' + tableName;
    document.getElementById('custFormTableId').value = tableId;
    document.getElementById('custFormTableLabel').textContent = tableName + ' (Tá»‘i Ä‘a ' + capacity + ' gháº¿)';
    document.getElementById('custFormDepositLabel').textContent = Number(deposit).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'Ä‘';

    const guestEl = document.getElementById('custFormGuestCount');
    guestEl.max = capacity;
    guestEl.value = Math.min(4, capacity);

    document.getElementById('custFormTime').value = CUST_SELECTED_DATE + 'T19:00';

    const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('customerBookingModal'));
    modal.show();
}
</script>

        $specialRooms[] = $row;

    }

function renderChairsAroundLight(int $capacity): array {
    $cap = in_array($capacity, [4, 8, 12], true) ? $capacity : 4;
    if ($cap === 4) return ['top' => 2, 'bottom' => 2, 'side' => 0];
    if ($cap === 8) return ['top' => 3, 'bottom' => 3, 'side' => 1];
    return ['top' => 5, 'bottom' => 5, 'side' => 1];
}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const tableSelect = document.getElementById('vipTableSelect');
    const guestInput  = document.getElementById('vipGuestCount');
    const depositInput= document.getElementById('vipDepositAmount');
    const hintEl      = document.getElementById('vipTableHint');

    function syncTableSelection() {
        const guests = parseInt(guestInput.value || '1', 10);
        const opt = tableSelect.options[tableSelect.selectedIndex];
        if (!opt || !opt.value) {
            hintEl.textContent = 'Chá»n bÃ n vÃ  sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng khÃ¡ch Ä‘á»ƒ há»‡ thá»‘ng kiá»ƒm tra sá»©c chá»©a vÃ  gá»£i Ã½ má»©c cá»c.';
            hintEl.className = 'small text-muted';
            return;
        }
        const cap = parseInt(opt.dataset.capacity || '0', 10);
        const surcharge = parseFloat(opt.dataset.surcharge || '0');
        let suggestedDeposit = guests <= 4 ? 50000 : (guests <= 8 ? 100000 : 200000);
        if (surcharge >= 20) suggestedDeposit = Math.max(suggestedDeposit, 500000);
        else if (surcharge >= 10) suggestedDeposit = Math.max(suggestedDeposit, 200000);

        if (parseInt(depositInput.value || '0', 10) === 0 || parseInt(depositInput.value || '0', 10) === 50000) {
            depositInput.value = suggestedDeposit;
        }

        if (guests > cap) {
            hintEl.textContent = 'Cáº£nh bÃ¡o: Sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng khÃ¡ch (' + guests + ') Ä‘ang vÆ°á»£t sá»©c chá»©a chuáº©n cá»§a bÃ n (' + cap + ' gháº¿). HÃ£y chá»n bÃ n lá»›n hÆ¡n.';
            hintEl.className = 'small text-danger fw-semibold';
        } else {
            hintEl.textContent = 'BÃ n há»£p lá»‡ (Sá»©c chá»©a ' + cap + ' gháº¿, phá»¥ thu khu vá»±c ' + surcharge + '%). Tiá»n cá»c gá»£i Ã½: ' + suggestedDeposit.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + 'Ä‘.';
            hintEl.className = 'small text-success fw-semibold';
        }
    }

    tableSelect?.addEventListener('change', syncTableSelection);
    guestInput?.addEventListener('input', syncTableSelection);
    syncTableSelection();
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const guestInput = document.getElementById('vipGuestCount');
    const depositInput = document.getElementById('vipDepositAmount');
    const tableSelect = document.getElementById('vipTableSelect');

    function updateSuggestedDeposit() {
        if (!guestInput || !depositInput) return;
        const count = parseInt(guestInput.value || '1', 10);
        let suggested = 50000;
        if (count > 20) suggested = 300000;
        else if (count > 12) suggested = 200000;
        else if (count > 8) suggested = 150000;
        else if (count > 4) suggested = 100000;

        if (tableSelect && tableSelect.selectedIndex > 0) {
            const opt = tableSelect.options[tableSelect.selectedIndex];
            const tType = opt.getAttribute('data-type') || 'Standard';
            if (tType === 'VIP') suggested = Math.max(suggested, 500000);
            else if (tType === 'Premium') suggested = Math.max(suggested, 200000);
        }
        depositInput.value = suggested;
    }

    if (guestInput) guestInput.addEventListener('change', updateSuggestedDeposit);
    if (tableSelect) tableSelect.addEventListener('change', updateSuggestedDeposit);

    const searchInput = document.getElementById('vipSearchInput');
    const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('#vipStatusTabs .rd-tab-btn');
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#vipReservationTable tbody .vip-row');
    let activeStatus = 'ALL';

    function filterTable() {
        const keyword = (searchInput ? searchInput.value : '').trim().toLowerCase();
        rows.forEach(function (row) {
            const rowStatus = row.getAttribute('data-status') || '';
            const rowSearch = row.getAttribute('data-search') || '';
            const matchStatus = activeStatus === 'ALL' || rowStatus === activeStatus;
            const matchKeyword = keyword === '' || rowSearch.indexOf(keyword) !== -1;
            row.style.display = (matchStatus && matchKeyword) ? '' : 'none';
        });
    }

    if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', filterTable);
    }

    tabButtons.forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            tabButtons.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
            this.classList.add('active');
            activeStatus = this.getAttribute('data-status') || 'ALL';
            filterTable();
        });
    });
});
</script>

<script>
function openCrmCustomerModal(data = null) {
    const modal     = document.getElementById('crmCustomerModal');
    const idInput   = document.getElementById('crmModalCustomerId');
    const nameInput = document.getElementById('crmModalFullName');
    const phoneInput= document.getElementById('crmModalPhone');
    const emailInput= document.getElementById('crmModalEmail');
    const submitBtn = document.getElementById('crmModalSubmitBtn');

    if (data && data.id) {
        idInput.value         = data.id;
        nameInput.value       = data.full_name || '';
        phoneInput.value      = data.phone || '';
        emailInput.value      = data.email || '';
        submitBtn.textContent = 'LÆ°u cáº­p nháº­t';
    } else {
        idInput.value         = '';
        nameInput.value       = '';
        phoneInput.value      = '';
        emailInput.value      = '';
        submitBtn.textContent = 'Táº¡o há»“ sÆ¡ khÃ¡ch hÃ ng';
    }

    modal.classList.add('on');
    setTimeout(() => nameInput.focus(), 50);
}

function closeCrmCustomerModal() {
    document.getElementById('crmCustomerModal').classList.remove('on');
}

document.getElementById('crmCustomerModal').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (e.target === this) {
        closeCrmCustomerModal();
    }
});
</script>

function rdCleanText($text) {
    $clean = str_replace(['(', ')'], ['', ''], (string)$text);
    return htmlspecialchars(trim($clean), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
}

    }

function switchRevenueMode(mode) {
    var btnDaily = document.getElementById('btnRevDaily');
    var btnMonthly = document.getElementById('btnRevMonthly');
    var title = document.getElementById('revChartTitle');

    if (mode === 'monthly') {
        revenueChart.config.type = 'line';
        revenueChart.data.labels = monthlyLabels;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].data = monthlyRevenue;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].fill = true;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = 'rgba(201, 158, 50, 0.16)';
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].borderColor = '#b88b22';
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].borderWidth = 2;
        title.textContent = 'Biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ doanh thu 6 thÃ¡ng gáº§n nháº¥t';
        btnMonthly.className = 'btn btn-primary-navy btn-sm';
        btnDaily.className = 'btn btn-outline-slate btn-sm';
    } else {
        revenueChart.config.type = 'bar';
        revenueChart.data.labels = dailyLabels;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].data = dailyRevenue;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].fill = false;
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = '#111c33';
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].borderColor = '#111c33';
        revenueChart.data.datasets[0].borderWidth = 1;
        title.textContent = 'Biá»ƒu Ä‘á»“ doanh thu 7 ngÃ y gáº§n nháº¥t';
        btnDaily.className = 'btn btn-primary-navy btn-sm';
        btnMonthly.className = 'btn btn-outline-slate btn-sm';
    }
    revenueChart.update();
}

<script>
const bomData = <?= json_encode($bomByItem, JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>;
const modData = <?= json_encode($modByItem, JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_QUOT) ?>;

function openAddMenuItem() {
    document.getElementById('menuItemModalTitle').innerText = 'âž• ThÃªm MÃ³n Ä‚n / Set Menu 5 Sao';
    document.getElementById('form_item_id').value = '0';
    document.getElementById('form_item_code').value = '';
    document.getElementById('form_name').value = '';
    document.getElementById('form_unit').value = 'Pháº§n';
    document.getElementById('form_price').value = '';
    document.getElementById('form_status').value = 'Available';
}

function openEditMenuItem(item) {
    document.getElementById('menuItemModalTitle').innerText = 'âœï¸ Cáº­p Nháº­t MÃ³n Ä‚n: ' + item.name;
    document.getElementById('form_item_id').value = item.id;
    document.getElementById('form_item_code').value = item.item_code;
    document.getElementById('form_category_id').value = item.category_id;
    document.getElementById('form_name').value = item.name;
    document.getElementById('form_unit').value = item.unit;
    document.getElementById('form_price').value = parseFloat(item.price);
    document.getElementById('form_status').value = item.status;
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('menuItemModal')).show();
}

function openBomModal(itemId, itemName) {
    document.getElementById('bom_menu_item_id').value = itemId;
    document.getElementById('bom_item_title').innerText = itemName;
    const tbody = document.getElementById('bom_table_body');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    const list = bomData[itemId] || [];

    if (list.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted py-3">ChÆ°a cÃ³ nguyÃªn liá»‡u nÃ o trong cÃ´ng thá»©c cá»§a mÃ³n nÃ y.</td></tr>';
    } else {
        list.forEach(row => {
            tbody.innerHTML += `
                <tr>
                    <td class="fw-semibold">${row.ingredient_name}</td>
                    <td class="text-center fw-bold text-success">${row.quantity_required}</td>
                    <td class="text-center"><code>${row.unit}</code></td>
                    <td class="text-center">
                        <a href="index.php?c=menu&a=deleteBom&menu_item_id=${itemId}&ingredient_id=${row.ingredient_id}" 
                           class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger py-0">âœ–</a>
                    </td>
                </tr>`;
        });
    }
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('bomModal')).show();
}

function openModModal(itemId, itemName) {
    document.getElementById('mod_menu_item_id').value = itemId;
    document.getElementById('mod_item_title').innerText = itemName;
    const tbody = document.getElementById('mod_table_body');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    const list = modData[itemId] || [];

    if (list.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center text-muted py-3">ChÆ°a cÃ³ sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch phá»¥c vá»¥ nÃ o cho mÃ³n nÃ y.</td></tr>';
    } else {
        list.forEach(row => {
            const priceText = parseFloat(row.extra_price) > 0 
                ? '+' + Number(row.extra_price).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' Ä‘' 
                : '<span class="text-muted">Miá»…n phÃ­</span>';
            tbody.innerHTML += `
                <tr>
                    <td><span class="badge bg-dark">${row.modifier_group}</span></td>
                    <td class="fw-semibold">${row.modifier_name}</td>
                    <td class="text-end fw-bold text-danger">${priceText}</td>
                    <td class="text-center">
                        <a href="index.php?c=menu&a=deleteModifier&id=${row.id}&menu_item_id=${itemId}" 
                           class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger py-0">âœ–</a>
                    </td>
                </tr>`;
        });
    }
    new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('modModal')).show();
}

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (params.has('open_bom')) {
        const id = params.get('open_bom');
        openBomModal(id, 'MÃ³n #' + id);
    } else if (params.has('open_mod')) {
        const id = params.get('open_mod');
        openModModal(id, 'MÃ³n #' + id);
    }
});

function openAddUser() {
    document.getElementById('userModalTitle').innerText = '➕ Thêm Nhân Viên Mới';
    document.getElementById('modal_user_id').value = '0';
    document.getElementById('modal_full_name').value = '';
    document.getElementById('modal_username').value = '';
    document.getElementById('modal_username').readOnly = false;
    document.getElementById('modal_phone').value = '';
    document.getElementById('password_group').style.display = 'block';
}

function openEditUser(user) {
    document.getElementById('userModalTitle').innerText = '✏️ Cập Nhật Hồ Sơ & Phân Quyền: ' + user.full_name;
    document.getElementById('modal_user_id').value = user.id;
    document.getElementById('modal_full_name').value = user.full_name;
    document.getElementById('modal_username').value = user.username;
    document.getElementById('modal_username').readOnly = true;
    document.getElementById('modal_phone').value = user.phone || '';
    document.getElementById('modal_role_id').value = user.role_id;
    document.getElementById('password_group').style.display = 'none';
    var modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('userModal'));
    modal.show();
}

                               FROM dining_tables dt JOIN areas a ON dt.area_id = a.id ORDER BY a.id, dt.table_name");

                           od.cancel_reason, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(od.ordered_at) AS ts,
                           TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, od.ordered_at, NOW()) AS wait, c.course_type
                    FROM order_details od
                    JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id AND o.status = 'Open'

                    JOIN categories c ON mi.category_id = c.id

// cÃ¡c mÃ³n cÃ¡ch nhau quÃ¡ 20 giÃ¢y Ä‘Æ°á»£c tÃ­nh lÃ  láº§n gá»i khÃ¡c
function batches(items) {
    const out = []; let last = null;
    items.forEach(i => { if (last === null || i.ts - last > 20) out.push([]); out[out.length - 1].push(i); last = i.ts; });
    return out;
}
function sentRow(i) {
    const c = i.kds_status == 'Cancelled';
    return `<div class="rd-ln ${c ? 'void' : ''}"><div><span class="nm">${i.quantity}Ã— ${esc(i.name)}</span> <span class="rd-bg s-${i.kds_status}">${STL[i.kds_status] || i.kds_status}</span></div>
        <div>${money(i.quantity * i.unit_price)}</div>
        <small>${i.modifier_notes ? 'Ghi chÃº: ' + esc(i.modifier_notes) : ''}${c ? ' Â· LÃ½ do há»§y: ' + esc(i.cancel_reason) : ''}&nbsp;</small>
        <div class="rd-row" style="margin:0;justify-content:flex-end">${i.kds_status == 'Ready' ? `<button class="rd-btn rd-btn-line" style="padding:3px 9px;font-size:12px" onclick="adv(${i.id},'Served')">ÄÃ£ bÆ°ng</button><button class="rd-btn rd-btn-line" style="padding:3px 9px;font-size:12px" onclick="adv(${i.id},'Served',true)">Mang vá»</button>` : ''}${['Waiting', 'Ready'].includes(i.kds_status) ? `<button class="rd-btn rd-btn-del" onclick="cancelM(${i.id})">Há»§y</button>` : ''}</div></div>`;
}
// Má»—i mÃ³n chÆ°a gá»­i báº¿p cÃ³ Ã´ ghi chÃº ngay bÃªn dÆ°á»›i (gá»£i Ã½ nhanh: Ã­t cay, khÃ´ng hÃ nh, dá»‹ á»©ng...)
function draftRow(d, i) {
    return `<div class="rd-ln"><div><span class="nm">${esc(d.name)}</span></div><div>${money(d.qty * d.price)}</div>
        <div style="grid-column:1/-1"><input class="rd-note" maxlength="200" list="noteList" value="${esc(d.notes)}" placeholder="Ghi chÃº cho báº¿p: Ã­t cay, khÃ´ng hÃ nh, dá»‹ á»©ng..." oninput="DRAFTS[curId][${i}].notes=this.value"></div>
        <small>${money(d.price)} / mÃ³n</small>
        <div class="rd-q"><button onclick="dq(${i},-1)" aria-label="Giáº£m">âˆ’</button>${d.qty}<button onclick="dq(${i},1)" aria-label="TÄƒng">+</button></div></div>`;
}
function rOrder() {
    const el = $('#ord'), t = curT();
    if (!t) { el.innerHTML = '<h3>HÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n</h3><div class="rd-empty">Chá»n má»™t bÃ n Ä‘á»ƒ báº¯t Ä‘áº§u gá»i mÃ³n.</div>'; return; }
    const o = ordOf(t.id), dr = DRAFTS[t.id] || [], sur = +t.surcharge_percent;
    let h = `<h3>BÃ n ${esc(t.table_name)}</h3><div class="rd-hint">${esc(t.area_name)}${sur > 0 ? ' Â· phá»¥ thu ' + sur + '%' : ''}${o ? ' Â· ' + esc(sc(o.order_code)) : ''}</div>`;
    if (o) {
        h += `<div class="rd-row"><button class="rd-btn rd-btn-line" onclick="transferM('transfer')">Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n</button><button class="rd-btn rd-btn-line" onclick="transferM('merge')">Gá»™p bÃ n</button></div>`;
        batches(o.items).forEach((b, k) => { h += `<h4>Láº§n gá»i ${k + 1}</h4>` + b.map(sentRow).join(''); });
    }
    if (dr.length) h += '<h4>MÃ³n má»›i, chÆ°a gá»­i báº¿p</h4>' + dr.map(draftRow).join('');
    if (!o && !dr.length) h += '<div class="rd-empty">BÃ n trá»‘ng. Cháº¡m vÃ o mÃ³n Ä‘á»ƒ má»Ÿ hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n.</div>';
    const sent = o ? sumO(o) : 0, pend = dr.reduce((s, d) => s + d.qty * d.price, 0);
    const emptyOrder = o && live(o).length == 0 && !dr.length;
    h += `<div style="margin-top:12px"><div class="rd-tot"><span>ÄÃ£ gá»­i báº¿p</span><span>${money(sent)}</span></div>
        ${dr.length ? `<div class="rd-tot"><span>Chá» gá»­i</span><span>${money(pend)}</span></div>` : ''}
        <div class="rd-tot big"><span>Táº¡m tÃ­nh</span><span>${money(sent + pend)}</span></div></div>
        ${emptyOrder ? '<p class="rd-hint">ÄÆ¡n nÃ y khÃ´ng cÃ²n mÃ³n nÃ o. Báº¡n cÃ³ thá»ƒ Ä‘Ã³ng bÃ n Ä‘á»ƒ tráº£ bÃ n cho khÃ¡ch khÃ¡c.</p>' : ''}
        <div class="rd-row end">${emptyOrder ? `<button class="rd-btn rd-btn-del" style="padding:8px 14px" onclick="closeTable(${o.id})">ÄÃ³ng bÃ n</button>` : ''}
        <button class="rd-btn rd-btn-gold" ${dr.length ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="sendOrder()">Gá»­i xuá»‘ng Báº¿p/Bar (${dr.reduce((s, d) => s + d.qty, 0)} mÃ³n)</button>
        ${o && !emptyOrder ? `<button class="rd-btn rd-btn-line" onclick="goPay(${o.id})">Thanh toÃ¡n</button>` : ''}</div>
        <p class="rd-hint">Phá»¥ thu, phÃ­ phá»¥c vá»¥, giáº£m giÃ¡ vÃ  VAT Ä‘Æ°á»£c tÃ­nh á»Ÿ bÆ°á»›c Thanh toÃ¡n.</p>`;
    el.innerHTML = h;
}
async function sendOrder() {
    const t = curT(), dr = DRAFTS[t.id] || [];
    const r = await api('createOrder', {table_id: t.id, items: dr.map(d => ({menu_item_id: d.id, quantity: d.qty, modifier_notes: (d.notes || '').trim()}))});
    if (r.status != 'success') return toast(r.message || 'Gá»­i order tháº¥t báº¡i', 1);
    DRAFTS[t.id] = [];
    toast('ÄÃ£ gá»­i order bÃ n ' + t.table_name + ' xuá»‘ng Báº¿p/Bar');
    await refreshAll();
}

/* ---------------- Há»§y mÃ³n / Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n / Gá»™p bÃ n / ÄÃ³ng bÃ n ---------------- */
function findItem(id) {
    for (const o of S.orders) { const i = o.items.find(x => x.id == id); if (i) return i; }
    return {};
}
function cancelM(id) {
    const it = findItem(id);
    const cooked = it.kds_status == 'Ready';
    const reasons = cooked ? ['KhÃ¡ch bá» mÃ³n / khÃ´ng dÃ¹ng ná»¯a', 'MÃ³n sai yÃªu cáº§u', 'Chá» quÃ¡ lÃ¢u', 'KhÃ¡c'] : ['KhÃ¡ch Ä‘á»•i Ã½', 'Nháº­p nháº§m mÃ³n', 'Háº¿t nguyÃªn liá»‡u', 'KhÃ¡c'];
    modal('Há»§y mÃ³n', `<p>${esc(it.quantity || '')}Ã— ${esc(it.name || '')}. ${cooked ? 'MÃ³n Ä‘Ã£ náº¥u xong nÃªn há»§y sáº½ gÃ¢y hao há»¥t nguyÃªn liá»‡u. LÃ½ do Ä‘Æ°á»£c ghi vÃ o nháº­t kÃ½ Ä‘á»ƒ quáº£n lÃ½ Ä‘á»‘i chiáº¿u.' : 'Báº¿p/Bar chÆ°a lÃ m mÃ³n nÃ y. LÃ½ do Ä‘Æ°á»£c ghi vÃ o nháº­t kÃ½.'}</p>
        <label>LÃ½ do há»§y (báº¯t buá»™c)</label><select id="rs"><option value="">Chá»n lÃ½ do</option>${reasons.map(x => `<option>${x}</option>`).join('')}</select>
        <label>Ghi chÃº thÃªm</label><input id="rn" maxlength="150" placeholder="Báº¯t buá»™c náº¿u chá»n KhÃ¡c">`, 'XÃ¡c nháº­n há»§y', async () => {
        const r = $('#rs').value, n = $('#rn').value.trim();
        if (!r) return 'Vui lÃ²ng chá»n lÃ½ do há»§y.';
        if (r == 'KhÃ¡c' && n.length < 5) return 'Vui lÃ²ng ghi rÃµ lÃ½ do (Ã­t nháº¥t 5 kÃ½ tá»±).';
        const res = await api('cancelItem', {order_detail_id: id, reason: r + (n ? ': ' + n : '')});
        if (res.status != 'success') return res.message;
        toast(res.message); refreshAll();
    });
}
function transferM(mode) {
    const t = curT(), m = mode == 'merge';
    const opts = S.tables.filter(x => x.id != t.id && (m ? ordOf(x.id) : (!ordOf(x.id) && x.status == 'Available')));
    modal(m ? 'Gá»™p bÃ n' : 'Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n',
        `<p>${m ? 'Gá»™p toÃ n bá»™ mÃ³n cá»§a bÃ n ' + esc(t.table_name) + ' vÃ o bÃ n Ä‘ang cÃ³ khÃ¡ch (dÃ¹ng cho khÃ¡ch Ä‘i Ä‘oÃ n). HÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n gá»™p tÃ­nh phá»¥ thu theo khu vá»±c cá»§a bÃ n Ä‘Ã­ch.' : 'Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n ' + esc(t.table_name) + ' sang bÃ n trá»‘ng. MÃ³n Ä‘Ã£ gá»­i báº¿p giá»¯ nguyÃªn tráº¡ng thÃ¡i, phá»¥ thu tá»± Ä‘á»•i theo khu vá»±c má»›i.'}</p>
        <label>${m ? 'Gá»™p vÃ o bÃ n' : 'BÃ n Ä‘Ã­ch'}</label><select id="to">${opts.map(x => `<option value="${x.id}">${esc(x.table_name)} Â· ${esc(x.area_name)}${+x.surcharge_percent > 0 ? ' Â· phá»¥ thu ' + (+x.surcharge_percent) + '%' : ''}${m ? '' : ' Â· ' + x.capacity + ' chá»—'}</option>`).join('')}</select>`,
        m ? 'Gá»™p bÃ n' : 'Chuyá»ƒn bÃ n', async () => {
            const to = +$('#to').value;
            if (!to) return m ? 'KhÃ´ng cÃ³ bÃ n nÃ o Ä‘ang má»Ÿ Ä‘á»ƒ gá»™p.' : 'KhÃ´ng cÃ²n bÃ n trá»‘ng.';
            const r = await api('transferTable', {from_table_id: t.id, to_table_id: to, mode});
            if (r.status != 'success') return r.message;
            DRAFTS[to] = (DRAFTS[to] || []).concat(DRAFTS[t.id] || []); delete DRAFTS[t.id];
            toast(r.message); curId = to; await refreshAll();
        });
}
function closeTable(orderId) {
    modal('ÄÃ³ng bÃ n', '<p>ÄÆ¡n nÃ y Ä‘Ã£ há»§y háº¿t mÃ³n (0â‚«). ÄÃ³ng bÃ n Ä‘á»ƒ tráº£ bÃ n cho khÃ¡ch má»›i. Thao tÃ¡c Ä‘Æ°á»£c ghi nháº­t kÃ½.</p>', 'ÄÃ³ng bÃ n', async () => {
        const r = await api('closeEmptyOrder', {order_id: orderId});
        if (r.status != 'success') return r.message;
        toast(r.message);
        if (payId == orderId) { payId = null; PB = null; }
        curId = null; await refreshAll();
    });
}

/* ---------------- KDS Báº¿p / Bar ---------------- */
function kdsItems() {
    const out = [];
    S.orders.forEach(o => { const t = S.tables.find(x => x.id == o.table_id);
        o.items.forEach(i => { if (['Waiting', 'Cooking', 'Ready'].includes(i.kds_status))
            out.push({...i, table_name: t ? t.table_name : '?', station: i.course_type == 'Beverage' ? 'Bar' : 'Kitchen'}); }); });
    return out.sort((a, b) => a.ts - b.ts || a.id - b.id);
}
function rKDS() {
    const all = kdsItems();
    $('#kdsCount').textContent = all.filter(i => i.kds_status == 'Waiting').length;
    if (!paneOn('kds')) return;
    $('#stn').innerHTML = [['ALL', 'Táº¥t cáº£'], ['Kitchen', 'Báº¿p'], ['Bar', 'Bar']].map(a => `<button class="rd-chip ${stn == a[0] ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="stn='${a[0]}';rKDS()">${a[1]}</button>`).join('');
    const L = all.filter(i => stn == 'ALL' || i.station == stn);
    const col = (st, title, btn, to) => {
        const l = L.filter(i => i.kds_status == st);
        return `<div class="rd-card"><h3>${title} (${l.length})</h3>` + (l.length ? l.map(i => {
            const late = i.wait >= 15 && st != 'Ready';
            return `<div class="rd-tk ${late ? 'late' : ''}"><div class="tt"><span>BÃ n ${esc(i.table_name)}</span><span>${i.wait} phÃºt</span></div>
                <div class="qty">${i.quantity}Ã— ${esc(i.name)}</div>
                <small>${i.modifier_notes ? `<b style="color:var(--g)">Ghi chÃº: ${esc(i.modifier_notes)}</b>` : 'KhÃ´ng ghi chÃº'} Â· ${i.station == 'Bar' ? 'Bar' : 'Báº¿p'}</small>
                <button class="rd-btn rd-btn-gold" onclick="adv(${i.id},'${to}')">${btn}</button>
                ${st == 'Ready' ? `<button class="rd-btn rd-btn-line" onclick="adv(${i.id},'Served',true)">Mang vá» (Ä‘Ã³ng há»™p)</button>` : ''}
                ${st == 'Waiting' || st == 'Ready' ? `<button class="rd-btn rd-btn-del" onclick="cancelM(${i.id})">${st == 'Ready' ? 'Há»§y mÃ³n Ä‘Ã£ náº¥u' : 'Há»§y mÃ³n'}</button>` : ''}</div>`;
        }).join('') : '<div class="rd-empty">KhÃ´ng cÃ³ mÃ³n</div>') + '</div>';
    };
    $('#kc').innerHTML = col('Waiting', 'Chá» cháº¿ biáº¿n', 'Báº¯t Ä‘áº§u náº¥u', 'Cooking') + col('Cooking', 'Äang náº¥u', 'HoÃ n thÃ nh Â· BÃ¡o phá»¥c vá»¥', 'Ready') + col('Ready', 'Sáºµn sÃ ng bÆ°ng', 'ÄÃ£ bÆ°ng ra bÃ n', 'Served');
}
async function adv(id, to, takeaway = false) {
    const i = kdsItems().find(x => x.id == id);
    const r = await api('updateKds', {order_detail_id: id, status: to, takeaway});
    if (r.status != 'success') toast(r.message || 'Cáº­p nháº­t tháº¥t báº¡i', 1);
    else if (to == 'Ready' && i) toast(`BÃ¡o phá»¥c vá»¥: bÃ n ${i.table_name} cÃ³ ${i.quantity}Ã— ${i.name} sáºµn sÃ ng`);
    await refreshAll();
}

/* ---------------- Thanh toÃ¡n (sá»‘ tiá»n do server tÃ­nh) ---------------- */
function rPayList() {
    const l = S.orders.map(o => ({o, t: S.tables.find(x => x.id == o.table_id)})).filter(x => x.t);
    $('#payList').innerHTML = l.length ? l.map(({o, t}) => `<button class="rd-tb busy wide ${+t.surcharge_percent > 0 ? 'vip' : ''} ${payId == o.id ? 'sel' : ''}" onclick="goPay(${o.id})"><b>BÃ n ${esc(t.table_name)}</b><small>${esc(sc(o.order_code))} Â· ${money(sumO(o))}</small></button>`).join('')
        : '<div class="rd-empty">KhÃ´ng cÃ³ bÃ n nÃ o Ä‘ang dÃ¹ng bá»¯a.</div>';
}
function goPay(id) {
    if (payId != id) { PH = ''; VC = ''; REF = ''; PB = null; }
    payId = id; showPane('pay'); loadBill();
}
async function loadBill() {
    if (!payId) { PB = null; rPayList(); rBill(); return; }
    const r = await apiGet('previewBill', `&order_id=${payId}&customer_phone=${encodeURIComponent(PH)}&voucher_code=${encodeURIComponent(VC)}`);
    PB = r.status == 'success' ? r.data : null;
    if (!PB || PB.status != 'Open') { if (!PB) toast(r.message || 'KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n', 1); PB = null; payId = null; }
    rPayList(); rBill();
}
// Thay tháº¿ hÃ m rBill() trong views/pos/index.php báº±ng Ä‘oáº¡n code sau:
function rBill() {
    const el = $('#bill'), c = $('#payCtl');
    if (!PB) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="rd-empty">Chá»n má»™t bÃ n bÃªn trÃ¡i Ä‘á»ƒ xem hÃ³a Ä‘Æ¡n.</div>'; c.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    const L = (a, v, x = '') => `<div class="rd-tot ${x}"><span>${a}</span><span>${v}</span></div>`;
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="rd-bh"><h3 style="margin:0">RoyalDine 5S</h3><small>BÃ n ${esc(PB.table_name)} Â· ${esc(sc(PB.order_code))}</small></div>`

                    + Táº¡o khÃ¡ch hÃ ng má»›i
                </button>
            </div>
        ` : ''}
        <label>Voucher</label>
        <select onchange="VC=this.value;loadBill()">

        <div class="rd-row end">${PB.subtotal <= 0 ? `<button class="rd-btn rd-btn-del" style="padding:8px 14px" onclick="closeTable(${PB.order_id})">ÄÃ³ng bÃ n</button>` : ''}
        <button class="rd-btn rd-btn-gold" ${blocked ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="payM()">XÃ¡c nháº­n Ä‘Ã£ thu</button></div>`;

function quick(days) {
    const d = x => x.toISOString().slice(0, 10), now = new Date(), off = n => new Date(now.getTime() - now.getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4 - n * 864e5);
    document.getElementById('td').value = d(off(0));
    document.getElementById('fd').value = days < 0 ? d(off(0)).slice(0, 8) + '01' : d(off(days));
    document.getElementById('td').form.submit();
}
function exportCsv() {
    const D = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('rpt').textContent);
    const cell = v => { v = String(v ?? ''); if (/^[=+\-@]/.test(v)) v = "'" + v; return '"' + v.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; };
    const line = a => a.map(cell).join(',') + '\n';
    let c = '\uFEFF' + line(['BÃO CÃO DOANH THU VÃ€ NHáº¬T KÃ Há»¦Y MÃ“N']) + line(['Tá»« ngÃ y', D.from, 'Äáº¿n ngÃ y', D.to]) + '\n';
    c += line(['DOANH THU THEO PHÆ¯Æ NG THá»¨C']) + line(['PhÆ°Æ¡ng thá»©c', 'Sá»‘ giao dá»‹ch', 'Doanh thu (VND)']);
    D.pay.forEach(r => c += line([r.payment_method, r.n, r.total]));
    c += '\n' + line(['DOANH THU THEO CA']) + line(['Ca', 'Sá»‘ giao dá»‹ch', 'Doanh thu (VND)']);
    D.time.forEach(r => c += line([r.shift_name, r.n, r.total]));
    c += '\n' + line(['NHáº¬T KÃ Há»¦Y MÃ“N']) + line(['Thá»i gian', 'NhÃ¢n viÃªn', 'BÃ n', 'MÃ£ Ä‘Æ¡n', 'MÃ³n', 'LÃ½ do']);

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    let phoneTimer = null;

    document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
        const el = e.target;
        if (!el || el.tagName !== 'INPUT') return;

        const placeholder = (el.getAttribute('placeholder') || '').toLowerCase();
        const idOrName = ((el.id || '') + ' ' + (el.name || '')).toLowerCase();
        const isPhoneInput = placeholder.indexOf('09') !== -1 || idOrName.indexOf('phone') !== -1;

        if (!isPhoneInput) return;

        clearTimeout(phoneTimer);
        const digits = el.value.replace(/\D/g, '');

        // Tự động áp dụng ngay khi gõ đủ 9-11 số hoặc khi xóa trắng hoàn toàn ô SĐT
        if (digits.length >= 9 || digits.length === 0) {
            phoneTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                const container = el.closest('.pay-box, .pos-panel, .pos-card, div') || document;
                const buttons = container.parentElement
                    ? container.parentElement.querySelectorAll('button')
                    : document.querySelectorAll('button');

                for (let i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
                    const txt = (buttons[i].textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                    if (txt.indexOf('áp dụng') !== -1) {
                        buttons[i].click();
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }, 300);
        }
    });
});
</script>

{

{

<script>
const rowsPerPage = 10;
const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.audit-row');
const totalPages = Math.ceil(rows.length / rowsPerPage);
let currentPage = 1;

function renderTable(page) {
    if (page < 1 || page > totalPages) return;
    currentPage = page;
    let start = (page - 1) * rowsPerPage;
    let end = start + rowsPerPage;

    rows.forEach((row, index) => {
        row.style.display = (index >= start && index < end) ? '' : 'none';
    });

    let endInfo = end > rows.length ? rows.length : end;
    document.getElementById('pageInfo').innerText = `Hiá»ƒn thá»‹ ${start + 1} Ä‘áº¿n ${endInfo} trÃªn tá»•ng ${rows.length} máº·t hÃ ng`;
    renderPagination();
}

function renderPagination() {
    const ul = document.getElementById('paginationControls');
    ul.innerHTML = '';
    ul.innerHTML += `<li class="page-item ${currentPage === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}"><a class="page-link" onclick="renderTable(${currentPage - 1})">TrÆ°á»›c</a></li>`;
    for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
        ul.innerHTML += `<li class="page-item ${currentPage === i ? 'active' : ''}"><a class="page-link" onclick="renderTable(${i})">${i}</a></li>`;
    }
    ul.innerHTML += `<li class="page-item ${currentPage === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''}"><a class="page-link" onclick="renderTable(${currentPage + 1})">Sau</a></li>`;
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    if (rows.length > 0) renderTable(1);
    else document.getElementById('pageInfo').innerText = "KhÃ´ng cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u nguyÃªn váº­t liá»‡u.";
});

document.querySelectorAll('.actual-input').forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener('input', function() {
        let currentQty = parseFloat(this.getAttribute('data-current'));
        let actualQty = parseFloat(this.value);
        let diffCol = this.closest('tr').querySelector('.diff-col');
        
        if (isNaN(actualQty)) {
            diffCol.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">-</span>';
        } else {
            let diff = actualQty - currentQty;
            if (diff > 0) diffCol.innerHTML = `<span class="text-success">+${diff.toFixed(2)} (DÆ°)</span>`;
            else if (diff < 0) diffCol.innerHTML = `<span class="text-danger">${diff.toFixed(2)} (Há»¥t)</span>`;
            else diffCol.innerHTML = `<span class="text-secondary">Khá»›p 100%</span>`;
        }
    });
});

function exportToExcel() {
    var wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
    var ws_data = [
        ["BIÃŠN Báº¢N KIá»‚M Äáº¾M KHO", "", "", "", "", ""],
        ["NgÃ y xuáº¥t phiáº¿u:", new Date().toLocaleDateString('vi-VN'), "", "", "", ""],
        [""],
        ["MÃƒ NVL", "TÃŠN HÃ€NG HÃ“A", "ÄVT", "Tá»’N Há»† THá»NG", "Sá» LÆ¯á»¢NG THá»°C Táº¾ (ÄIá»€N TAY)", "LÃ DO / GHI CHÃš Lá»†CH"]
    ];
    
    rows.forEach(row => {
        let code = row.cells[0].innerText.trim();
        let name = row.cells[1].innerText.trim();
        let stock = row.cells[2].innerText.trim();
        let unit = row.cells[3].innerText.trim();
        ws_data.push([code, name, unit, stock, "", ""]); 
    });

    var ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(ws_data);
    ws['!cols'] = [{wch: 12}, {wch: 40}, {wch: 10}, {wch: 15}, {wch: 32}, {wch: 30}];
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, "PhieuKiemKe");
    XLSX.writeFile(wb, "Phieu_Kiem_Ke_Kho_" + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) + ".xlsx");
}
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.item-checkbox');
        const exportForm = document.getElementById('exportForm');

        checkboxes.forEach(chk => {
            chk.addEventListener('change', function () {
                const row = this.closest('tr');
                const qtyInput = row.querySelector('.quantity-input');
                const costInput = row.querySelector('.cost-input');

                qtyInput.disabled = !this.checked;
                costInput.disabled = !this.checked;

                if (this.checked) {
                    qtyInput.focus();
                    row.style.backgroundColor = '#fff8e1';
                } else {
                    qtyInput.value = '1';
                    row.style.backgroundColor = '';
                }
            });
        });

        const rowsPerPage = 10;
        const tableBody = document.getElementById('ingredientTableBody');
        const tableRows = Array.from(tableBody.querySelectorAll('tr.ing-row'));
        const paginationControls = document.getElementById('paginationControls');

        function displayPage(page) {
            const start = (page - 1) * rowsPerPage;
            const end = start + rowsPerPage;

            tableRows.forEach((row, index) => {
                if (index >= start && index < end) {
                    row.style.display = '';
                } else {
                    row.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
            updatePaginationUI(page);
        }

        function updatePaginationUI(page) {
            const totalPages = Math.ceil(tableRows.length / rowsPerPage);
            paginationControls.innerHTML = '';

            if (totalPages <= 1) return;

            // NÃºt "TrÆ°á»›c"
            const prevLi = document.createElement('li');
            prevLi.className = page === 1 ? 'disabled' : '';
            prevLi.innerHTML = `<a href="#">TrÆ°á»›c</a>`;
            prevLi.addEventListener('click', (e) => { 
                e.preventDefault(); if (page > 1) displayPage(page - 1); 
            });
            paginationControls.appendChild(prevLi);

            // NÃºt Sá»‘
            for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
                const li = document.createElement('li');
                li.className = i === page ? 'active' : '';
                li.innerHTML = `<a href="#">${i}</a>`;
                li.addEventListener('click', (e) => { 
                    e.preventDefault(); displayPage(i); 
                });
                paginationControls.appendChild(li);
            }

            const nextLi = document.createElement('li');
            nextLi.className = page === totalPages ? 'disabled' : '';
            nextLi.innerHTML = `<a href="#">Sau</a>`;
            nextLi.addEventListener('click', (e) => { 
                e.preventDefault(); if (page < totalPages) displayPage(page + 1); 
            });
            paginationControls.appendChild(nextLi);
        }

        if (tableRows.length > 0) displayPage(1);

        exportForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            const checkedBoxes = document.querySelectorAll('.item-checkbox:checked');
            if (checkedBoxes.length === 0) {
                alert('Vui lÃ²ng tÃ­ch chá»n Ã­t nháº¥t má»™t nguyÃªn liá»‡u Ä‘á»ƒ xuáº¥t kho!');
                e.preventDefault();
                return;
            }

            let valid = true;
            checkedBoxes.forEach(chk => {
                const row = chk.closest('tr');
                const qtyInput = row.querySelector('.quantity-input');
                const quantity = parseFloat(qtyInput.value);
                const maxStock = parseFloat(qtyInput.max);

                if (!Number.isFinite(quantity) || quantity <= 0 || quantity > maxStock) {
                    valid = false;
                    row.style.display = ''; 
                    qtyInput.reportValidity();
                }
            });

            if (!valid) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    const ingredients = <?php echo json_encode($ingredients); ?>;
    
    function addRow() {
        let optionsHtml = '<option value="">- Chá»n NVL -</option>';
        ingredients.forEach(ing => {
            optionsHtml += `<option value="${ing.id}" data-unit="${ing.unit}" data-price="${ing.cost_price}">#${ing.ingredient_code} - ${ing.name}</option>`;
        });

        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.innerHTML = `
            <td class="ps-4"><select class="form-select ingredient-select fw-semibold text-dark" name="ingredient_id[]" onchange="updateUnit(this)" required>${optionsHtml}</select></td>
            <td class="text-center unit-display fw-bold text-muted">-</td>
            <td><input type="number" step="0.01" min="0.01" class="form-control qty-input text-center fw-bold text-primary" name="quantity[]" value="1" oninput="calcRow(this)" onkeydown="return event.keyCode !== 69 && event.keyCode !== 189" required></td>
            <td><input type="number" step="1" min="0" class="form-control price-input text-end fw-bold" name="unit_cost[]" value="0" oninput="calcRow(this)" onkeydown="return event.keyCode !== 69 && event.keyCode !== 189" required></td>
            <td class="text-end row-total">0</td>
            <td class="text-center pe-4"><button type="button" class="btn-remove" onclick="removeRow(this)">Ã—</button></td>
        `;
        document.querySelector('#detailTable tbody').appendChild(tr);
        updateTotals();
    }

    function removeRow(btn) {
        const tbody = document.querySelector('#detailTable tbody');
        if (tbody.children.length > 1) {
            btn.closest('tr').remove();
            updateTotals();
        } else {
            alert("Phiáº¿u nháº­p pháº£i cÃ³ Ã­t nháº¥t 1 dÃ²ng nguyÃªn váº­t liá»‡u!");
        }
    }

    function updateUnit(selectElem) {
        const selectedOption = selectElem.options[selectElem.selectedIndex];
        const unit = selectedOption.getAttribute('data-unit') || '-';
        const price = selectedOption.getAttribute('data-price') || 0;
        
        const tr = selectElem.closest('tr');
        tr.querySelector('.unit-display').textContent = unit;
        
        const priceInput = tr.querySelector('.price-input');
        if (priceInput.value == 0 || priceInput.value === "") {
            priceInput.value = parseFloat(price).toFixed(0);
        }
        calcRow(selectElem);
    }

    function calcRow(elem) {
        const tr = elem.closest('tr');
        let qty = parseFloat(tr.querySelector('.qty-input').value);
        let price = parseFloat(tr.querySelector('.price-input').value);
        
        if(qty < 0) { tr.querySelector('.qty-input').value = 1; qty = 1; }
        if(price < 0) { tr.querySelector('.price-input').value = 0; price = 0; }
        
        qty = qty || 0; price = price || 0;
        const total = qty * price;
        tr.querySelector('.row-total').textContent = total.toLocaleString('vi-VN');
        updateTotals();
    }

    function updateTotals() {
        const tbody = document.querySelector('#detailTable tbody');
        document.getElementById('totalLines').textContent = tbody.children.length;
        
        let grandTotal = 0;
        document.querySelectorAll('.row-total').forEach(td => {
            let val = td.textContent.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/,/g, '');
            grandTotal += parseFloat(val) || 0;
        });
        document.getElementById('grandTotal').textContent = grandTotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN');
    }

    function validateForm() {
        const tbody = document.querySelector('#detailTable tbody');
        const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
        
        if(rows.length === 0) {
            alert("Vui lÃ²ng thÃªm Ã­t nháº¥t má»™t loáº¡i nguyÃªn liá»‡u Ä‘á»ƒ nháº­p kho!");
            return false;
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            const select = rows[i].querySelector('.ingredient-select');
            const qty = parseFloat(rows[i].querySelector('.qty-input').value);
            
            if (select.value === "") {
                alert(`DÃ²ng thá»© ${i+1} chÆ°a chá»n NguyÃªn váº­t liá»‡u. Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i!`);
                select.focus();
                return false;
            }
            if (isNaN(qty) || qty <= 0) {
                alert(`DÃ²ng thá»© ${i+1} cÃ³ sá»‘ lÆ°á»£ng khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡ (pháº£i lá»›n hÆ¡n 0). Vui lÃ²ng kiá»ƒm tra láº¡i!`);
                rows[i].querySelector('.qty-input').focus();
                return false;
            }
        }

        const btn = document.getElementById('btnSubmit');
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = 'â³ ÄANG Xá»¬ LÃ...';
        
        return true;
    }
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const numberInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.number-format');
    numberInputs.forEach(function (input) {
        input.addEventListener('input', function () { this.value = this.value.replace(/\D/g, ''); });
        input.addEventListener('blur', function () {
            if (this.value !== '') {
                const number = Number(this.value);
                this.value = new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(number);
            }
        });
        input.addEventListener('focus', function () { this.value = this.value.replace(/\D/g, ''); });
        if (input.form) {
            input.form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
                numberInputs.forEach(inp => { inp.value = inp.value.replace(/\D/g, ''); });
            });
        }
    });
});
</script>

<script>
function validateSearch(form) {
    const searchInput = form.querySelector('input[name="search"]');
    if(searchInput) {
        let val = searchInput.value.trim();
        val = val.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\sÃ€-á»¹-]/g, ""); 
        searchInput.value = val;
        if (val === "") { searchInput.removeAttribute("name"); }
    }
    const selects = form.querySelectorAll('select');
    selects.forEach(select => {
        if (select.value === "") select.removeAttribute("name");
    });
    
    return true;
}
</script>

function confirmDelete(id, name) {
    var msg = 'âš ï¸ Báº¡n cÃ³ cháº¯c cháº¯n muá»‘n xÃ³a nguyÃªn liá»‡u: "' + name + '"?\n\n' +
              'LÆ°u Ã½: Há»‡ thá»‘ng chá»‰ cho phÃ©p xÃ³a nhá»¯ng nguyÃªn liá»‡u chÆ°a phÃ¡t sinh giao dá»‹ch nháº­p kho vÃ  chÆ°a Ä‘Æ°á»£c ghÃ©p vÃ o cÃ´ng thá»©c mÃ³n Äƒn.';
              
    if(confirm(msg)) {
        window.location.href = 'index.php?c=stock&a=delete_ingredient&id=' + id;
    }
}
function exportToExcel() {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    urlParams.set('a', 'export_excel'); 
    window.location.href = 'index.php?' + urlParams.toString();
}
</script>

<?php
    $startDate     = $_GET['start_date'] ?? date('Y-m-01 00:00:00');
    $endDate       = $_GET['end_date'] ?? date('Y-m-t 23:59:59');
    
    if (strtotime($startDate) > strtotime($endDate)) {
        $temp = $startDate;
        $startDate = $endDate;
        $endDate = $temp;
    }

    $filterIng     = $_GET['ingredient_id'] ?? '';
    $filterSup     = $_GET['supplier_id'] ?? '';
    
    $limit         = 10;
    $page          = isset($_GET['page']) ? (int)$_GET['page'] : 1;
    if ($page < 1) $page = 1;
    $offset        = ($page - 1) * $limit;

    require_once __DIR__ . '/../../models/StockModel.php';
    $stockModel = new StockModel();

    $report = $stockModel->getInventoryAndProfitReport($startDate, $endDate);
    $summary = $report['summary'];
    $allItems = $report['items'];

    $allIngredients = $stockModel->getIngredients('', '', '', '', 1000, 0);
    $allSuppliers   = $stockModel->getSuppliers('', 'active', 1000, 0);

    $filteredItems = $allItems;
    if (!empty($filterIng)) {
        $filteredItems = array_filter($filteredItems, function($it) use ($filterIng) {
            return $it['id'] == $filterIng;
        });
    }
    if (!empty($filterSup)) {
        $filteredItems = array_filter($filteredItems, function($it) use ($filterSup, $stockModel) {
            $ingDetail = $stockModel->getIngredientById($it['id']);
            return $ingDetail && $ingDetail['supplier_id'] == $filterSup;
        });
    }

    $totalRows = count($filteredItems);
    $totalPages = ceil($totalRows / $limit);
    $pagedItems = array_slice(array_values($filteredItems), $offset, $limit);

    $chartLabels = [];
    $chartImport = [];
    $chartExport = [];
    $chartConsumptionCost = [];

    $chartSourceItems = !empty($filterIng) ? $filteredItems : array_slice($filteredItems, 0, 15);
    foreach ($chartSourceItems as $it) {
        $chartLabels[] = $it['name'];
        $chartImport[] = (float)$it['total_imported'];
        $chartExport[] = (float)$it['total_exported'];
        $chartConsumptionCost[] = (float)($it['total_exported'] * $it['cost_price']);
    }

    $totalFilteredCogs = 0;
    foreach ($filteredItems as $it) {
        $totalFilteredCogs += ($it['total_exported'] * $it['cost_price']);
    }
    $displayCogs = $totalFilteredCogs > 0 ? $totalFilteredCogs : (float)$summary['total_cogs'];
    $displayRev = (float)$summary['total_revenue'] > 0 ? (float)$summary['total_revenue'] : 1;
    $displayGrossProfit = $displayRev - $displayCogs;
?>
